--     so the first video of every SUBJECT is flagged - see the notes in
--     docs/security/SECURITY_FIX_NOTES.md.
--   * user_can_access_note / user_can_access_video: the entitlement decision the
--     signed-URL Edge Functions call (service_role only). Preview = any signed-in,
--     non-blocked user. Otherwise: an active purchase that covers the chapter /
--     subject (chapter, subject, year or bundle scope), same rule as
--     user_owns_chapter(), but for an explicit user id.
--   * Quizzes stay free (unchanged).
-- Existing purchases are untouched. Idempotent: re-running does not re-flag
-- notes an admin has since un-flagged unless a chapter has NO flagged note left
-- AND this migration is re-applied by hand.
begin;

alter table public.notes  add column if not exists is_free_preview boolean not null default false;
alter table public.videos add column if not exists is_free_preview boolean not null default false;

-- Backfill (only rows currently false, only for chapters/subjects with no preview yet)
with ranked as (
  select n.id,
         row_number() over (partition by n.chapter_id order by n."order", n.created_at, n.id) as rn,
         bool_or(n.is_free_preview) over (partition by n.chapter_id) as has_preview
  from public.notes n
  where n.active
)
update public.notes n set is_free_preview = true
from ranked r
where r.id = n.id and r.rn = 1 and not r.has_preview;

with ranked as (
  select v.id,
         row_number() over (partition by v.subject_id order by v."order", v.created_at, v.id) as rn,
         bool_or(v.is_free_preview) over (partition by v.subject_id) as has_preview
  from public.videos v
  where v.active
)
update public.videos v set is_free_preview = true
from ranked r
where r.id = v.id and r.rn = 1 and not r.has_preview;

create index if not exists idx_notes_free_preview  on public.notes(chapter_id)  where is_free_preview;
create index if not exists idx_videos_free_preview on public.videos(subject_id) where is_free_preview;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Entitlement functions (server-side only)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.user_can_access_note(p_user uuid, p_note_id text)
returns boolean
language sql
security definer
stable
set search_path = public
as $$
  select
    p_user is not null
    and exists (select 1 from public.profiles pr where pr.id = p_user and not coalesce(pr.blocked, false))
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.notes n
      join public.chapters c on c.id = n.chapter_id
      where n.id = p_note_id
        and n.active
        and (
          n.is_free_preview
          or exists (select 1 from public.admins a where a.id = p_user)
          or exists (
            select 1
            from public.purchases p
            where p.user_id = p_user
              and p.status = 'success'
              and p.course_id = c.course_id
              and (
                (p.scope = 'chapter' and p.chapter_id = c.id)
                or (p.scope = 'subject' and p.subject_id = c.subject_id)
                or (p.scope = 'year' and p.year_id = c.year_id)
                or (p.scope = 'bundle' and c.year_id = any (p.year_ids))
              )
          )
        )
    );
$$;

create or replace function public.user_can_access_video(p_user uuid, p_video_id text)
returns boolean
language sql
security definer
stable
set search_path = public
as $$
  select
    p_user is not null
    and exists (select 1 from public.profiles pr where pr.id = p_user and not coalesce(pr.blocked, false))
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.videos v
      join public.subjects s on s.id = v.subject_id
      where v.id = p_video_id
        and v.active
        and (
          v.is_free_preview
          or exists (select 1 from public.admins a where a.id = p_user)
          or exists (
            select 1
            from public.purchases p
            where p.user_id = p_user
              and p.status = 'success'
              and p.course_id = s.course_id
              and (
                (p.scope = 'subject' and p.subject_id = s.id)
                or (p.scope = 'year' and p.year_id = s.year_id)
                or (p.scope = 'bundle' and s.year_id = any (p.year_ids))
                or (p.scope = 'chapter' and exists (
                      select 1 from public.chapters c
                      where c.id = p.chapter_id and c.subject_id = s.id))
              )
          )
        )
    );
$$;

revoke all on function public.user_can_access_note(uuid, text)  from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all on function public.user_can_access_video(uuid, text) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.user_can_access_note(uuid, text)  to service_role;
grant execute on function public.user_can_access_video(uuid, text) to service_role;

commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20260925100000_phase2_referral_config_and_product_type.sql =====
-- ============================================================================
-- PHASE 2 (1/3) — referral reward config + products.product_type
-- ============================================================================
-- Additive only. Nothing existing is dropped, renamed or rewritten.
--
--   * products.product_type: what the wallet rule keys on. Existing products are
--     backfilled to 'other' on purpose - wallet credit stays OFF for a product
--     until an admin tags it 'notes' / 'notes_bundle' in the admin panel. The
--     server never guesses from `scope` (a chapter/subject/year/bundle product
--     unlocks notes AND videos together).
--   * referral_settings: every reward number lives here and is edited from the
--     admin panel. Defaults mirror the launch rules, but `enabled` stays false.
--     The legacy columns (reward_type, referrer_reward_value,
--     referee_reward_value, qualify_on) are kept for old builds and no longer
--     read by any reward logic.
-- Idempotent.
begin;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. products.product_type
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.products
  add column if not exists product_type text not null default 'other';

alter table public.products drop constraint if exists products_product_type_check;
alter table public.products
  add constraint products_product_type_check
  check (product_type in ('notes', 'notes_bundle', 'video', 'other'));

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. referral_settings: reward config
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.referral_settings
  add column if not exists friend_discount_percent   numeric      not null default 10,
  add column if not exists friend_discount_max       numeric               default 100,   -- null = no cap
  add column if not exists referrer_credit_amount    numeric      not null default 50,
  add column if not exists credit_hold_days          integer      not null default 7,
  add column if not exists credit_expiry_days        integer,                           -- null = never expires
  add column if not exists wallet_max_percent        numeric      not null default 50,
  add column if not exists wallet_product_types      text[]       not null default array['notes', 'notes_bundle'],
  add column if not exists apply_window_days         integer      not null default 2,   -- code usable only right after signup
  add column if not exists checkout_expiry_minutes   integer      not null default 30,  -- unpaid order lifetime
  add column if not exists terms_url                 text;

alter table public.referral_settings drop constraint if exists referral_settings_phase2_ranges;
alter table public.referral_settings
  add constraint referral_settings_phase2_ranges check (
        friend_discount_percent between 0 and 100
    and (friend_discount_max is null or friend_discount_max >= 0)
    and referrer_credit_amount >= 0
    and credit_hold_days between 0 and 365
    and (credit_expiry_days is null or credit_expiry_days > 0)
    and wallet_max_percent between 0 and 100
    and apply_window_days between 1 and 30
    and checkout_expiry_minutes between 5 and 240
    and wallet_product_types <@ array['notes', 'notes_bundle', 'video', 'other']
  );

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. referrals: which order was the friend's first paid purchase
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.referrals
  add column if not exists first_order_id text;

create unique index if not exists referrals_first_order_unique
  on public.referrals (first_order_id) where first_order_id is not null;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. Self-check
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
do $$
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from public.referral_settings where id = true) then
    raise exception 'PHASE2 self-check: referral_settings row missing';
  end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.products where product_type not in ('notes','notes_bundle','video','other')) then
    raise exception 'PHASE2 self-check: bad product_type';
  end if;
end;
$$;

commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20260925110000_phase2_wallet_ledger.sql =====
-- ============================================================================
-- PHASE 2 (2/3) — referral wallet: append-only ledger + read RPCs
-- ============================================================================
-- There is NO balance column anywhere. The balance is always computed from the
-- ledger, so it can't be edited, only appended to.
--
--   entry_type   status                    meaning
--   credit       pending                   referral reward, held until available_at
--   credit       available                 spendable (unless expires_at has passed)
--   credit       cancelled                 friend's payment refunded inside the hold
--   debit        available                 wallet used to pay for an order ("posted")
--   credit       available (order_refund)  wallet amount restored after a full refund
--   reversal     available                 claws back a credit that was already
--                                          available (admin / refund after the hold)
--
-- Writes: service_role and SECURITY DEFINER functions only. Students and admins
-- get SELECT (own rows / all rows) and nothing else, enforced four ways: table
-- privileges, RLS (no write policy), block_client_writes trigger, and the
-- append-only trigger (which also stops service_role from editing history).
-- Idempotent.
begin;

create table if not exists public.wallet_ledger (
  id                uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id           uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,
  entry_type        text not null check (entry_type in ('credit', 'debit', 'reversal')),
  status            text not null check (status in ('pending', 'available', 'cancelled')),
  amount            numeric(10, 2) not null check (amount > 0),
  source            text not null check (source in ('referral_reward', 'order_payment', 'order_refund', 'admin_adjustment')),
  referral_id       uuid references public.referrals(id) on delete set null,
  order_id          text references public.orders(id) on delete set null,
  reverses_id       uuid references public.wallet_ledger(id) on delete set null,
  available_at      timestamptz,
  expires_at        timestamptz,
  note              text,
  created_at        timestamptz not null default now(),
  status_changed_at timestamptz,
  constraint wallet_ledger_pending_needs_date check (status <> 'pending' or available_at is not null),
  constraint wallet_ledger_only_credits_pend check (entry_type = 'credit' or status <> 'pending')
);

-- Abuse guards, enforced by the database rather than by application code:
--   one referral credit per friend (referrals.referred_id is already unique)
create unique index if not exists wallet_ledger_one_credit_per_referral
  on public.wallet_ledger (referral_id)
  where entry_type = 'credit' and source = 'referral_reward';
--   one wallet debit per order (idempotent settlement)
create unique index if not exists wallet_ledger_one_debit_per_order
  on public.wallet_ledger (order_id)
  where entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment';
--   wallet amount is restored at most once per refunded order
create unique index if not exists wallet_ledger_one_restore_per_order
  on public.wallet_ledger (order_id)
  where entry_type = 'credit' and source = 'order_refund';
--   a credit can be reversed at most once
create unique index if not exists wallet_ledger_one_reversal_per_entry
  on public.wallet_ledger (reverses_id)
  where entry_type = 'reversal';

create index if not exists wallet_ledger_user_idx on public.wallet_ledger (user_id, created_at desc);
create index if not exists wallet_ledger_due_idx  on public.wallet_ledger (available_at) where status = 'pending';

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Append-only: no deletes, no truncate, and the only allowed UPDATE is
--   * status pending -> available | cancelled (stamping status_changed_at), or
--   * user_id / referral_id / order_id -> NULL (account deletion anonymises).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.wallet_ledger_append_only()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
as $$
begin
  if tg_op = 'DELETE' then
    raise exception 'wallet_ledger is append-only' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if new.id            is distinct from old.id
  or new.entry_type    is distinct from old.entry_type
  or new.amount        is distinct from old.amount
  or new.source        is distinct from old.source
  or new.reverses_id   is distinct from old.reverses_id and new.reverses_id is not null
  or new.available_at  is distinct from old.available_at
  or new.expires_at    is distinct from old.expires_at
  or new.note          is distinct from old.note
  or new.created_at    is distinct from old.created_at
  or (new.user_id      is distinct from old.user_id     and new.user_id     is not null)
  or (new.referral_id  is distinct from old.referral_id and new.referral_id is not null)
  or (new.order_id     is distinct from old.order_id    and new.order_id    is not null) then
    raise exception 'wallet_ledger rows are immutable except status' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if new.status is distinct from old.status then
    if not (old.status = 'pending' and new.status in ('available', 'cancelled')) then
      raise exception 'wallet_ledger: illegal status change % -> %', old.status, new.status
        using errcode = '42501';
    end if;
    new.status_changed_at := now();
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;

drop trigger if exists wallet_ledger_01_append_only on public.wallet_ledger;
create trigger wallet_ledger_01_append_only
  before update or delete on public.wallet_ledger
  for each row execute function public.wallet_ledger_append_only();

create or replace function public.wallet_ledger_no_truncate()
returns trigger language plpgsql as $$
begin
  raise exception 'wallet_ledger is append-only' using errcode = '42501';
end;
$$;

drop trigger if exists wallet_ledger_02_no_truncate on public.wallet_ledger;
create trigger wallet_ledger_02_no_truncate
  before truncate on public.wallet_ledger
  for each statement execute function public.wallet_ledger_no_truncate();

drop trigger if exists wallet_ledger_00_block_client_writes on public.wallet_ledger;
create trigger wallet_ledger_00_block_client_writes
  before insert or update or delete on public.wallet_ledger
  for each row execute function public.block_client_writes();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- RLS / privileges: SELECT only
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.wallet_ledger enable row level security;

drop policy if exists "wallet_ledger_select_own" on public.wallet_ledger;
create policy "wallet_ledger_select_own" on public.wallet_ledger
  for select to authenticated using (user_id = auth.uid());
drop policy if exists "wallet_ledger_select_admin" on public.wallet_ledger;
create policy "wallet_ledger_select_admin" on public.wallet_ledger
  for select to authenticated using (public.am_i_admin());

revoke all on public.wallet_ledger from public, anon, authenticated;
grant select on public.wallet_ledger to authenticated;
grant all on public.wallet_ledger to service_role;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Moves credits whose hold has elapsed from pending -> available, and marks the
-- referral as rewarded. Idempotent. p_user = null sweeps everyone (cron).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.release_due_wallet_credits(p_user uuid default null)
returns integer
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_ids uuid[];
  n integer;
begin
  -- Called from get_my_wallet() under the student's role: tell the
  -- block_client_writes backstop this write is ours (transaction-local).
  perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'true', true);
  with due as (
    update public.wallet_ledger
       set status = 'available'
     where entry_type = 'credit'
       and status = 'pending'
       and available_at <= now()
       and (p_user is null or user_id = p_user)
    returning id, referral_id
  )
  select array_agg(id), count(*) into v_ids, n from due;

  update public.referrals r
     set status = 'rewarded', rewarded_at = now()
   where r.status = 'qualified'
     and exists (
       select 1 from public.wallet_ledger l
        where l.referral_id = r.id and l.source = 'referral_reward'
          and l.entry_type = 'credit' and l.status = 'available'
     );

  perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'false', true);
  return coalesce(n, 0);
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.release_due_wallet_credits(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.release_due_wallet_credits(uuid) to service_role;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Balance. Internal: the same maths is used to PRICE an order and to DISPLAY.
-- Callers must run release_due_wallet_credits(user) first.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.wallet_balance_of(p_user uuid)
returns table (available numeric, pending numeric, total_earned numeric, next_available_at timestamptz)
language sql
security definer
stable
set search_path = public
as $$
  select
    greatest(0,
      coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where entry_type = 'credit' and status = 'available'
                                     and (expires_at is null or expires_at > now())), 0)
      - coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where entry_type in ('debit', 'reversal') and status = 'available'), 0)
    )::numeric(10, 2) as available,
    coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where entry_type = 'credit' and status = 'pending'), 0)::numeric(10, 2) as pending,
    coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where entry_type = 'credit' and status in ('pending', 'available')
                                   and source = 'referral_reward'), 0)::numeric(10, 2) as total_earned,
    min(available_at) filter (where entry_type = 'credit' and status = 'pending') as next_available_at
  from public.wallet_ledger
  where user_id = p_user;
$$;

revoke all on function public.wallet_balance_of(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.wallet_balance_of(uuid) to service_role;

-- What the app calls. Own balance only; the user id comes from the JWT.
create or replace function public.get_my_wallet()
returns table (available numeric, pending numeric, total_earned numeric, next_available_at timestamptz)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'not authenticated' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  perform public.release_due_wallet_credits(auth.uid());
  return query select * from public.wallet_balance_of(auth.uid());
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.get_my_wallet() from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.get_my_wallet() to authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Referral list for the referrer: masked name, status, amount. (The old
-- get_my_referrals() is left untouched for released builds.)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.get_my_referral_list()
returns table (
  id uuid,
  friend_name text,
  joined_at timestamptz,
  status text,
  amount numeric,
  available_at timestamptz
)
language sql
security definer
stable
set search_path = public
as $$
  select
    r.id,
    case
      when nullif(trim(coalesce(p.name, '')), '') is null then 'A friend'
      else initcap(split_part(trim(p.name), ' ', 1))
           || case when array_length(regexp_split_to_array(trim(p.name), '\s+'), 1) > 1
                   then ' ' || upper(left((regexp_split_to_array(trim(p.name), '\s+'))
                                          [array_length(regexp_split_to_array(trim(p.name), '\s+'), 1)], 1)) || '.'
                   else '' end
    end as friend_name,
    r.created_at as joined_at,
    case
      when r.status = 'rejected' or l.status = 'cancelled' or rev.id is not null then 'cancelled'
      when l.id is null then 'joined'
      when l.status = 'available' or l.available_at <= now() then 'credited'
      else 'purchased_pending'
    end as status,
    l.amount,
    case when l.status = 'pending' then l.available_at end as available_at
  from public.referrals r
  left join public.profiles p on p.id = r.referred_id
  left join public.wallet_ledger l
         on l.referral_id = r.id and l.source = 'referral_reward' and l.entry_type = 'credit'
  left join public.wallet_ledger rev
         on rev.reverses_id = l.id and rev.entry_type = 'reversal'
  where r.referrer_id = auth.uid()
  order by r.created_at desc;
$$;

revoke all on function public.get_my_referral_list() from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.get_my_referral_list() to authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Admin: claw back a credit that was ALREADY available (e.g. the friend's
-- refund arrived after the hold). Posts a reversal; never edits history.
-- The reversal can take the balance to 0, not below (balance is clamped).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.admin_reverse_wallet_credit(p_ledger_id uuid, p_note text)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_row public.wallet_ledger%rowtype;
begin
  if not public.am_i_admin() then
    raise exception 'admin only' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  select * into v_row from public.wallet_ledger where id = p_ledger_id for update;
  if not found or v_row.entry_type <> 'credit' or v_row.status <> 'available' then
    raise exception 'Only an available credit can be reversed';
  end if;
  perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'true', true);
  insert into public.wallet_ledger (user_id, entry_type, status, amount, source, reverses_id, referral_id, note)
  values (v_row.user_id, 'reversal', 'available', v_row.amount, 'admin_adjustment', v_row.id, v_row.referral_id,
          left(coalesce(p_note, 'admin reversal'), 500));
  perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'false', true);
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.admin_reverse_wallet_credit(uuid, text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.admin_reverse_wallet_credit(uuid, text) to authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Optional sweep every 15 minutes. Correctness does NOT depend on it (balance
-- reads and order pricing release the caller's due credits first); it only keeps
-- referrals.status fresh for the admin panel. Skipped quietly if pg_cron is not
-- available on this project.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
do $$
begin
  create extension if not exists pg_cron;
  perform cron.unschedule('release-wallet-credits')
    where exists (select 1 from cron.job where jobname = 'release-wallet-credits');
  perform cron.schedule('release-wallet-credits', '*/15 * * * *',
                        'select public.release_due_wallet_credits(null)');
exception when others then
  raise notice 'PHASE2: pg_cron not scheduled (%). Enable it in Dashboard > Database > Extensions, or ignore.', sqlerrm;
end;
$$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Self-check
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
do $$
begin
  if has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.wallet_ledger', 'insert')
     or has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.wallet_ledger', 'update')
     or has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.wallet_ledger', 'delete')
     or has_table_privilege('anon', 'public.wallet_ledger', 'select') then
    raise exception 'PHASE2 self-check: wallet_ledger privileges too wide';
  end if;
  if has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.release_due_wallet_credits(uuid)', 'execute')
     or has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.wallet_balance_of(uuid)', 'execute') then
    raise exception 'PHASE2 self-check: internal wallet function executable by client';
  end if;
end;
$$;

commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20260925120000_phase2_orders_pricing_and_settlement.sql =====
-- ============================================================================
-- PHASE 2 (3/3) — server-side pricing, wallet debit + referral credit at
-- settlement, refund handling, stricter code application
-- ============================================================================
-- Depends on 20260925100000 (config, product_type) and 20260925110000 (ledger).
-- Security model is unchanged from Phase 1: clients still cannot write orders,
-- purchases, payments or the ledger. The client never sends an amount; every
-- number below is computed here from `products`, `referral_settings` and the
-- ledger.
--
-- orders.amount stays "what Razorpay charges" (final payable), so the existing
-- settlement checks (payment amount == order amount, razorpay order amount ==
-- order amount) keep working untouched. The breakdown is stored beside it:
--   list_price        selling price (products.price, never MRP)
--   referral_discount friend's first-purchase discount
--   wallet_amount     wallet credit applied
--   amount            = list_price - referral_discount - wallet_amount
-- Older orders have list_price NULL (= amount, no discounts).
-- Idempotent.
begin;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. orders: price breakdown, immutable like amount
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.orders
  add column if not exists list_price        numeric(10, 2),
  add column if not exists referral_discount numeric(10, 2) not null default 0,
  add column if not exists wallet_amount     numeric(10, 2) not null default 0,
  add column if not exists referral_id       uuid references public.referrals(id) on delete set null,
  add column if not exists expires_at        timestamptz;   -- NULL on legacy orders = never expires

alter table public.orders drop constraint if exists orders_phase2_amounts;
alter table public.orders add constraint orders_phase2_amounts check (
  referral_discount >= 0 and wallet_amount >= 0
  and (list_price is null or list_price - referral_discount - wallet_amount = amount)
) not valid;   -- legacy rows are all NULL/0 and satisfy it; NOT VALID avoids a table scan lock

-- Same rules as Phase 1, plus: the breakdown is immutable, and razorpay_order_id
-- may be set ONCE (NULL -> value) because create-order now inserts the priced
-- order first and attaches the Razorpay order id right after.
create or replace function public.orders_immutable_columns()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
as $$
begin
  if new.amount is distinct from old.amount then
    raise exception 'orders.amount is immutable' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if old.razorpay_order_id is not null and new.razorpay_order_id is distinct from old.razorpay_order_id then
    raise exception 'orders.razorpay_order_id is immutable' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if new.user_id is distinct from old.user_id and new.user_id is not null then
    raise exception 'orders.user_id is immutable' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if new.product_id is distinct from old.product_id and new.product_id is not null then
    raise exception 'orders.product_id is immutable' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if new.list_price is distinct from old.list_price
     or new.referral_discount is distinct from old.referral_discount
     or new.wallet_amount is distinct from old.wallet_amount then
    raise exception 'orders price breakdown is immutable' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if new.referral_id is distinct from old.referral_id and new.referral_id is not null then
    raise exception 'orders.referral_id is immutable' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if new.expires_at is distinct from old.expires_at then
    raise exception 'orders.expires_at is immutable' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. create_priced_order: the ONLY place a price is decided
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Called by the create-order Edge Function (service_role). Returns
--   {ok:true, order_id, list_price, referral_discount, wallet_amount, amount, title}
--   {ok:false, code}   code in product_unavailable | wallet_not_allowed | invalid_price
-- Everything happens under a per-user advisory lock, so two concurrent
-- checkouts cannot both spend the same wallet balance or discount.
-- ALL of the user's older unpaid orders are cancelled when a new checkout is
-- created, and the new order expires after referral_settings.checkout_expiry_minutes
-- (default 30). Settlement treats a cancelled / expired order specially (section 3).
create or replace function public.create_priced_order(
  p_user_id uuid,
  p_product_id text,
  p_use_wallet boolean default false
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_set      public.referral_settings%rowtype;
  v_product  public.products%rowtype;
  v_ref      public.referrals%rowtype;
  v_price    numeric(10, 2);
  v_discount numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_wallet   numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_base     numeric(10, 2);
  v_cap      numeric(10, 2);
  v_balance  numeric(10, 2);
  v_final    numeric(10, 2);
  v_order_id text := gen_random_uuid()::text;
begin
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || p_user_id::text, 0));

  select * into v_product from public.products where id = p_product_id;
  if not found or not v_product.active or not (v_product.price > 0) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'product_unavailable');
  end if;
  v_price := v_product.price::numeric(10, 2);
  if v_price < 1 then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'invalid_price');
  end if;

  select * into v_set from public.referral_settings where id = true;

  -- Friend discount: first purchase only, code applied at signup, program on.
  if v_set.enabled and v_set.friend_discount_percent > 0 then
    select r.* into v_ref
      from public.referrals r
      join public.profiles rp on rp.id = r.referrer_id and not rp.blocked
     where r.referred_id = p_user_id
       and r.status in ('pending', 'qualified')
       and r.first_order_id is null
       and not exists (select 1 from public.purchases pu
                        where pu.user_id = p_user_id and pu.status = 'success');
    if found then
      v_discount := round(v_price * v_set.friend_discount_percent / 100, 2);
      if v_set.friend_discount_max is not null then
        v_discount := least(v_discount, v_set.friend_discount_max);
      end if;
      v_discount := greatest(0, least(v_discount, v_price - 1));
    end if;
  end if;

  v_base := v_price - v_discount;

  -- Wallet: notes products only, capped at wallet_max_percent of what is left
  -- after the friend discount, and never more than the available balance.
  if p_use_wallet then
    if not (v_product.product_type = any (v_set.wallet_product_types)) then
      return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'wallet_not_allowed');
    end if;
    perform public.release_due_wallet_credits(p_user_id);
    select available into v_balance from public.wallet_balance_of(p_user_id);
    v_cap := floor(v_base * v_set.wallet_max_percent) / 100;
    v_wallet := greatest(0, least(v_cap, coalesce(v_balance, 0)));
  end if;

  v_final := v_price - v_discount - v_wallet;
  if v_final < 1 then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'invalid_price');
  end if;

  -- Validation passed: only now cancel every earlier unpaid order of this user.
  update public.orders
     set status = 'cancelled', updated_at = now()
   where user_id = p_user_id and status = 'created';

  insert into public.orders (
    id, user_id, product_id, scope, chapter_id, subject_id, year_id, year_ids, course_id,
    amount, list_price, referral_discount, wallet_amount, referral_id, status, expires_at
  ) values (
    v_order_id, p_user_id, v_product.id, v_product.scope, v_product.chapter_id, v_product.subject_id,
    v_product.year_id, v_product.year_ids, v_product.course_id,
    v_final, v_price, v_discount, v_wallet,
    case when v_discount > 0 then v_ref.id end, 'created',
    now() + make_interval(mins => v_set.checkout_expiry_minutes)
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true, 'order_id', v_order_id, 'title', v_product.title,
    'list_price', v_price, 'referral_discount', v_discount,
    'wallet_amount', v_wallet, 'amount', v_final,
    'timeout_seconds', v_set.checkout_expiry_minutes * 60
  );
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.create_priced_order(uuid, text, boolean) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.create_priced_order(uuid, text, boolean) to service_role;

-- Read-only quote for the checkout screen. Same maths, no order is created, so
-- what the screen shows is what create_priced_order will charge.
create or replace function public.quote_my_order(p_product_id text, p_use_wallet boolean default false)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_uid      uuid := auth.uid();
  v_set      public.referral_settings%rowtype;
  v_product  public.products%rowtype;
  v_price    numeric(10, 2);
  v_discount numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_wallet   numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_avail    numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_cap      numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_eligible boolean := false;
begin
  if v_uid is null then raise exception 'not authenticated' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  select * into v_product from public.products where id = p_product_id and active;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'product_unavailable'); end if;
  v_price := v_product.price::numeric(10, 2);
  select * into v_set from public.referral_settings where id = true;

  if v_set.enabled and v_set.friend_discount_percent > 0
     and exists (select 1 from public.referrals r
                   join public.profiles rp on rp.id = r.referrer_id and not rp.blocked
                  where r.referred_id = v_uid and r.status in ('pending', 'qualified') and r.first_order_id is null)
     and not exists (select 1 from public.purchases pu where pu.user_id = v_uid and pu.status = 'success') then
    v_discount := round(v_price * v_set.friend_discount_percent / 100, 2);
    if v_set.friend_discount_max is not null then v_discount := least(v_discount, v_set.friend_discount_max); end if;
    v_discount := greatest(0, least(v_discount, v_price - 1));
  end if;

  v_eligible := v_product.product_type = any (v_set.wallet_product_types);
  if v_eligible then
    perform public.release_due_wallet_credits(v_uid);
    select available into v_avail from public.wallet_balance_of(v_uid);
    v_cap := floor((v_price - v_discount) * v_set.wallet_max_percent) / 100;
    if p_use_wallet then v_wallet := greatest(0, least(v_cap, coalesce(v_avail, 0))); end if;
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true, 'list_price', v_price, 'referral_discount', v_discount,
    'wallet_eligible', v_eligible, 'wallet_available', coalesce(v_avail, 0),
    'wallet_max_usable', least(v_cap, coalesce(v_avail, 0)),
    'wallet_amount', v_wallet, 'amount', v_price - v_discount - v_wallet
  );
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.quote_my_order(text, boolean) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.quote_my_order(text, boolean) to authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2b. Orders needing an admin's eyes (money moved on an order that was no
-- longer live when the payment came in). Written by settlement only.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table if not exists public.order_review_flags (
  id                uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  order_id          text references public.orders(id) on delete set null,
  user_id           uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,
  reason            text not null check (reason in ('stale_order_paid')),
  wallet_amount     numeric(10, 2) not null default 0,
  referral_discount numeric(10, 2) not null default 0,
  details           jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at        timestamptz not null default now(),
  resolved_at       timestamptz,
  resolved_by       uuid,
  resolution_note   text
);
create unique index if not exists order_review_flags_one_per_order_reason
  on public.order_review_flags (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null;

alter table public.order_review_flags enable row level security;
drop policy if exists "order_review_flags_admin_select" on public.order_review_flags;
create policy "order_review_flags_admin_select" on public.order_review_flags
  for select to authenticated using (public.am_i_admin());
revoke all on public.order_review_flags from public, anon, authenticated;
grant select on public.order_review_flags to authenticated;
grant all on public.order_review_flags to service_role;

drop trigger if exists order_review_flags_00_block_client_writes on public.order_review_flags;
create trigger order_review_flags_00_block_client_writes
  before insert or update or delete on public.order_review_flags
  for each row execute function public.block_client_writes();

create or replace function public.admin_resolve_order_flag(p_flag_id uuid, p_note text)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
begin
  if not public.am_i_admin() then
    raise exception 'admin only' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'true', true);
  update public.order_review_flags
     set resolved_at = now(), resolved_by = auth.uid(), resolution_note = left(coalesce(p_note, ''), 500)
   where id = p_flag_id and resolved_at is null;
  perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'false', true);
  if not found then raise exception 'Flag not found or already resolved'; end if;
end;
$$;
revoke all on function public.admin_resolve_order_flag(uuid, text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.admin_resolve_order_flag(uuid, text) to authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. Settlement: grant + wallet debit + referrer credit, one transaction
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Same signature, locking and idempotency as the Phase 1 version. Additions:
--   * per-user advisory lock (same key as create_priced_order), taken BEFORE the
--     order row lock so the two functions can't deadlock;
--   * wallet debit (idempotent: one debit row per order, unique index), only
--     after Razorpay confirmed the capture. If the order was CANCELLED / FAILED,
--     or the payment was initiated after orders.expires_at, the wallet is NOT
--     debited: the order is flagged in order_review_flags for an admin instead
--     (the cash payment is real, so access is still granted);
--   * the real logic lives in settle_razorpay_payment(..., p_paid_at); the
--     4-argument grant_razorpay_payment() is kept as a wrapper (paid_at = now())
--     for anything still calling the old signature;
--   * referrer credit (idempotent: one credit per referral, unique index) on the
--     friend's first successful purchase, held for credit_hold_days.
create or replace function public.settle_razorpay_payment(
  p_event_id text,
  p_razorpay_order_id text,
  p_razorpay_payment_id text,
  p_amount_paise bigint,
  p_paid_at timestamptz default null   -- when the customer started the payment (Razorpay payment.created_at)
)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $function$
declare
  v_uid uuid;
  v_order public.orders%rowtype;
  v_product public.products%rowtype;
  v_existing_payment_order_id text;
  v_set public.referral_settings%rowtype;
  v_ref public.referrals%rowtype;
  v_balance numeric(10, 2);
  v_debit numeric(10, 2);
  v_stale boolean;
begin
  if p_event_id is null or p_razorpay_order_id is null or p_razorpay_payment_id is null
    or p_amount_paise is null or p_amount_paise <= 0 then
    raise exception 'invalid Razorpay settlement parameters';
  end if;

  select user_id into v_uid from public.orders where razorpay_order_id = p_razorpay_order_id;
  if v_uid is not null then
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || v_uid::text, 0));
  end if;

  -- Row lock serialises a webhook retry with the client verification path.
  select * into v_order
  from public.orders
  where razorpay_order_id = p_razorpay_order_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Razorpay order % is not linked to an internal order', p_razorpay_order_id;
  end if;
  if round(v_order.amount * 100)::bigint <> p_amount_paise then
    raise exception 'Razorpay amount does not match order amount';
  end if;

  select order_id into v_existing_payment_order_id
  from public.payments
  where razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id;
  if found and v_existing_payment_order_id <> v_order.id then
    raise exception 'Razorpay payment is already linked to another order';
  end if;

  -- Account deleted while the payment was in flight: keep the accounting row,
  -- grant nothing, debit nothing, reward nothing (refund manually).
  if v_order.user_id is null then
    insert into public.payments (
      order_id, user_id, product_id, amount, razorpay_order_id,
      razorpay_payment_id, status, verified_at
    ) values (
      v_order.id, null, v_order.product_id, v_order.amount,
      p_razorpay_order_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'success', now()
    ) on conflict (razorpay_payment_id) do nothing;

    update public.orders
    set status = 'paid', razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id, updated_at = now()
    where id = v_order.id;

    insert into public.razorpay_webhook_events(event_id, razorpay_payment_id, event_type)
    values (p_event_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'payment.captured')
    on conflict (event_id) do nothing;

    raise warning 'grant_razorpay_payment: payment % for order % arrived after the account was deleted; no access granted - refund manually', p_razorpay_payment_id, v_order.id;
    return;
  end if;

  select * into v_product from public.products where id = v_order.product_id;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'Order % references unknown product %', v_order.id, v_order.product_id;
  end if;

  insert into public.payments (
    order_id, user_id, product_id, amount, razorpay_order_id,
    razorpay_payment_id, status, verified_at
  ) values (
    v_order.id, v_order.user_id, v_order.product_id, v_order.amount,
    p_razorpay_order_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'success', now()
  ) on conflict (razorpay_payment_id) do nothing;

  insert into public.purchases (
    user_id, order_id, product_id, product_title, scope, chapter_id,
    subject_id, year_id, year_ids, course_id, amount, status, razorpay_order_id
  ) values (
    v_order.user_id, v_order.id, v_product.id, coalesce(v_product.title, 'Your content'),
    v_product.scope, v_product.chapter_id, v_product.subject_id, v_product.year_id,
    v_product.year_ids, v_product.course_id, v_order.amount, 'success', p_razorpay_order_id
  ) on conflict (order_id) do nothing;

  update public.orders
  set status = 'paid', razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id,
      course_id = v_product.course_id, updated_at = now()
  where id = v_order.id;

  -- ---- Stale order? -------------------------------------------------------
  -- v_order is the row as it was BEFORE this settlement flipped it to 'paid'.
  -- Replays see 'paid' and rely on the flag written the first time.
  v_stale := exists (select 1 from public.order_review_flags
                      where order_id = v_order.id and reason = 'stale_order_paid')
          or v_order.status in ('cancelled', 'failed')
          or (v_order.status = 'created' and v_order.expires_at is not null
              and coalesce(p_paid_at, now()) > v_order.expires_at);

  if v_stale and (v_order.wallet_amount > 0 or v_order.referral_discount > 0) then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'stale_order_paid', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            jsonb_build_object('order_status', v_order.status, 'expires_at', v_order.expires_at,
                               'paid_at', p_paid_at, 'razorpay_payment_id', p_razorpay_payment_id))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % was % / expired when payment % arrived; wallet NOT debited, flagged for review',
      v_order.id, v_order.status, p_razorpay_payment_id;
  end if;

  -- ---- Wallet debit -------------------------------------------------------
  if v_order.wallet_amount > 0 and not v_stale then
    perform public.release_due_wallet_credits(v_order.user_id);
    select available into v_balance from public.wallet_balance_of(v_order.user_id);
    -- Normally balance >= wallet_amount (create_priced_order checked it under
    -- the same lock). Clamp anyway so the balance can never go negative.
    v_debit := least(v_order.wallet_amount, coalesce(v_balance, 0));
    if v_debit < v_order.wallet_amount
       and not exists (select 1 from public.wallet_ledger
                        where order_id = v_order.id and entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment') then
      raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % wanted % wallet credit but only % was available',
        v_order.id, v_order.wallet_amount, v_balance;
    end if;
    if v_debit > 0 then
      insert into public.wallet_ledger (user_id, entry_type, status, amount, source, order_id, note)
      values (v_order.user_id, 'debit', 'available', v_debit, 'order_payment', v_order.id, 'Wallet used at checkout')
      on conflict (order_id) where entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment' do nothing;
    end if;
  end if;

  -- ---- Referrer credit ----------------------------------------------------
  -- Only the friend's FIRST successful purchase counts, and only once.
  select * into v_ref from public.referrals where referred_id = v_order.user_id for update;
  if found and v_ref.first_order_id is null and v_ref.status in ('pending', 'qualified')
     and not exists (select 1 from public.purchases
                      where user_id = v_order.user_id and order_id <> v_order.id and status = 'success') then
    update public.referrals
       set first_order_id = v_order.id, status = 'qualified', qualified_at = coalesce(qualified_at, now())
     where id = v_ref.id;

    select * into v_set from public.referral_settings where id = true;
    if v_set.enabled and v_set.referrer_credit_amount > 0
       and exists (select 1 from public.profiles where id = v_ref.referrer_id and not blocked) then
      insert into public.wallet_ledger (
        user_id, entry_type, status, amount, source, referral_id, order_id,
        available_at, expires_at, note
      ) values (
        v_ref.referrer_id, 'credit', 'pending', v_set.referrer_credit_amount::numeric(10, 2),
        'referral_reward', v_ref.id, v_order.id,
        now() + make_interval(days => v_set.credit_hold_days),
        case when v_set.credit_expiry_days is null then null
             else now() + make_interval(days => v_set.credit_hold_days + v_set.credit_expiry_days) end,
        'Friend''s first purchase'
      ) on conflict (referral_id) where entry_type = 'credit' and source = 'referral_reward' do nothing;
    end if;
  end if;

  insert into public.razorpay_webhook_events(event_id, razorpay_payment_id, event_type)
  values (p_event_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'payment.captured')
  on conflict (event_id) do nothing;
end;
$function$;

revoke all on function public.settle_razorpay_payment(text, text, text, bigint, timestamptz)
  from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.settle_razorpay_payment(text, text, text, bigint, timestamptz)
  to service_role;

create or replace function public.grant_razorpay_payment(
  p_event_id text,
  p_razorpay_order_id text,
  p_razorpay_payment_id text,
  p_amount_paise bigint
)
returns void
language sql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  select public.settle_razorpay_payment(p_event_id, p_razorpay_order_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, p_amount_paise, null);
$$;

revoke all on function public.grant_razorpay_payment(text, text, text, bigint)
  from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.grant_razorpay_payment(text, text, text, bigint)
  to service_role;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. Refunds
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Called by the razorpay-webhook function on refund.processed, AFTER it has
-- re-fetched the payment from Razorpay and confirmed a FULL refund.
--   * wallet amount the order used -> restored to the buyer as an 'order_refund'
--     credit (once per order, unique index); nothing to restore if the order
--     never debited (e.g. it was flagged as stale)
--   * friend's referrer credit still inside its hold -> cancelled, referral rejected
--   * credit already released -> untouched, reported back so an admin can decide
--     (admin_reverse_wallet_credit)
-- Returns {status: <referral outcome>, wallet_restored: <amount>}. Idempotent.
create or replace function public.handle_payment_refund(p_razorpay_payment_id text, p_full_refund boolean)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_order public.orders%rowtype;
  v_credit public.wallet_ledger%rowtype;
  v_debit public.wallet_ledger%rowtype;
  v_restored numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_rows integer := 0;
  v_status jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_order from public.orders where razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id for update;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('status', 'unknown_payment'); end if;
  if not p_full_refund then return jsonb_build_object('status', 'partial_refund_ignored'); end if;

  update public.orders set status = 'refunded', updated_at = now()
   where id = v_order.id and status = 'paid';

  -- ---- Restore the wallet amount this order used ---------------------------
  select * into v_debit from public.wallet_ledger
   where order_id = v_order.id and entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment';
  if found and v_debit.user_id is not null then
    perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'true', true);
    insert into public.wallet_ledger (user_id, entry_type, status, amount, source, order_id, note)
    values (v_debit.user_id, 'credit', 'available', v_debit.amount, 'order_refund', v_order.id,
            'Wallet amount restored after refund')
    on conflict (order_id) where entry_type = 'credit' and source = 'order_refund' do nothing;
    get diagnostics v_rows = row_count;   -- 1 on first insert, 0 on replay
    perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'false', true);
    v_restored := case when v_rows > 0 then v_debit.amount else 0 end;
  end if;

  -- ---- Friend's referrer credit -------------------------------------------
  select l.* into v_credit
    from public.referrals r
    join public.wallet_ledger l on l.referral_id = r.id and l.entry_type = 'credit' and l.source = 'referral_reward'
   where r.first_order_id = v_order.id
   for update of l;

  if not found then
    v_status := jsonb_build_object('status', 'no_referral_credit');
  elsif v_credit.status = 'cancelled' then
    v_status := jsonb_build_object('status', 'already_cancelled');
  elsif v_credit.status = 'pending' and v_credit.available_at > now() then
    perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'true', true);
    update public.wallet_ledger set status = 'cancelled' where id = v_credit.id;
    perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'false', true);
    update public.referrals
       set status = 'rejected', reject_reason = 'friend_payment_refunded'
     where id = v_credit.referral_id;
    v_status := jsonb_build_object('status', 'credit_cancelled', 'amount', v_credit.amount);
  else
    raise warning 'handle_payment_refund: credit % for order % was already released; reverse it manually if appropriate', v_credit.id, v_order.id;
    v_status := jsonb_build_object('status', 'credit_already_released', 'ledger_id', v_credit.id);
  end if;

  return v_status || jsonb_build_object('wallet_restored', v_restored);
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.handle_payment_refund(text, boolean) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.handle_payment_refund(text, boolean) to service_role;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5. apply_referral_code: signup-only, configurable window, no reward at signup
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Same signature and return shape as before (released builds keep working).
-- Differences: the window comes from referral_settings.apply_window_days
-- (was a hardcoded 7 days) and the referral always starts 'pending' - rewards
-- are decided at payment, never at signup.
create or replace function public.apply_referral_code(p_code text)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_settings public.referral_settings%rowtype;
  v_referrer public.profiles%rowtype;
  v_caller public.profiles%rowtype;
  v_referral_count integer;
begin
  if v_uid is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'error', 'message', 'Not authenticated.');
  end if;
  if p_code is null or length(trim(p_code)) = 0 then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'invalid_code', 'message', 'Please enter a referral code.');
  end if;

  select * into v_settings from public.referral_settings where id = true;
  if v_settings is null or not v_settings.enabled then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'disabled', 'message', 'Referrals are not available right now.');
  end if;

  select * into v_caller from public.profiles where id = v_uid;
  if v_caller is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'error', 'message', 'Profile not found.');
  end if;

  select * into v_referrer from public.profiles where upper(referral_code) = upper(trim(p_code));
  if v_referrer is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'invalid_code', 'message', 'That referral code was not found.');
  end if;
  if v_referrer.id = v_uid then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'self_referral', 'message', 'You cannot refer yourself.');
  end if;
  if v_referrer.blocked then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'referrer_blocked', 'message', 'That referral code is no longer active.');
  end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.referrals where referred_id = v_uid) then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'already_referred', 'message', 'A referral code has already been applied to your account.');
  end if;
  if v_caller.created_at < now() - make_interval(days => v_settings.apply_window_days) then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'too_late', 'message', 'Referral codes can only be used when you sign up.');
  end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.purchases where user_id = v_uid and status = 'success')
     or exists (select 1 from public.orders where user_id = v_uid and status = 'paid') then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'already_purchased', 'message', 'Referral codes must be applied before your first purchase.');
  end if;

  if v_settings.max_referrals_per_user is not null then
    select count(*) into v_referral_count from public.referrals where referrer_id = v_referrer.id;
    if v_referral_count >= v_settings.max_referrals_per_user then
      return jsonb_build_object('status', 'referrer_limit_reached', 'message', 'That referral code has reached its usage limit.');
    end if;
  end if;

  insert into public.referrals (referrer_id, referred_id, code_used, status)
  values (v_referrer.id, v_uid, upper(trim(p_code)), 'pending');

  return jsonb_build_object('status', 'success', 'message', 'Referral applied successfully.');
exception
  when unique_violation then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'already_referred', 'message', 'A referral code has already been applied to your account.');
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.apply_referral_code(text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.apply_referral_code(text) to authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5b. Admin: reject a referral (fraud). Cancels the referrer's credit if it is
-- still pending; an already-released credit is left for admin_reverse_wallet_credit.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.admin_reject_referral(p_referral_id uuid, p_reason text)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_credit public.wallet_ledger%rowtype;
  v_cancelled boolean := false;
begin
  if not public.am_i_admin() then
    raise exception 'admin only' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  update public.referrals
     set status = 'rejected', reject_reason = left(coalesce(nullif(trim(p_reason), ''), 'rejected by admin'), 500)
   where id = p_referral_id and status <> 'rejected';
  if not found then
    raise exception 'Referral not found or already rejected';
  end if;
  select * into v_credit from public.wallet_ledger
   where referral_id = p_referral_id and entry_type = 'credit' and source = 'referral_reward' for update;
  if found and v_credit.status = 'pending' then
    perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'true', true);
    update public.wallet_ledger set status = 'cancelled' where id = v_credit.id;
    perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'false', true);
    v_cancelled := true;
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('credit_cancelled', v_cancelled,
                            'credit_already_released', found and v_credit.status = 'available');
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.admin_reject_referral(uuid, text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.admin_reject_referral(uuid, text) to authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6. Self-checks
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
do $$
declare f text;
begin
  foreach f in array array[
    'public.create_priced_order(uuid,text,boolean)',
    'public.handle_payment_refund(text,boolean)',
    'public.grant_razorpay_payment(text,text,text,bigint)',
    'public.settle_razorpay_payment(text,text,text,bigint,timestamptz)',
    'public.release_due_wallet_credits(uuid)'
  ] loop
    if has_function_privilege('authenticated', f, 'execute') or has_function_privilege('anon', f, 'execute') then
      raise exception 'PHASE2 self-check: % executable by a client role', f;
    end if;
  end loop;
  if has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.orders', 'insert')
     or has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.orders', 'update') then
    raise exception 'PHASE2 self-check: client can write orders';
  end if;
end;
$$;

commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20260925130000_drop_debug_whoami.sql =====
-- Drop the leftover debug_whoami() helper.
--
-- It returns auth.uid(), the caller's JWT email and their admins rows, and was
-- executable by anon and authenticated (and PUBLIC). Nothing in mobile-app,
-- admin-panel, website or the Edge Functions calls it. It exists on live and is
-- reproduced in 20260701000000_baseline_live_schema.sql so a from-scratch rebuild
-- matches live up to this point; this migration then removes it everywhere.
--
-- Drops every overload, and is a no-op if none exist. Idempotent.
do $$
declare
  f regprocedure;
begin
  for f in
    select p.oid::regprocedure
    from pg_proc p
    where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace
      and p.proname = 'debug_whoami'
  loop
    execute format('drop function if exists %s', f);
  end loop;
end $$;


===== supabase/migrations/20260925140000_phase2_single_use_friend_discount.sql =====
-- ============================================================================
-- Phase 2 hardening: the friend discount can be used at most once.
--
-- create_priced_order prices every open checkout with the friend discount while
-- the referral is unconsumed, and a cancelled checkout can still be paid. So a
-- friend could pay two orders that were both discounted. Pricing cannot stop
-- that; settlement does: the first discounted order to settle claims the
-- referral (referrals.discount_order_id); a second discounted order is recorded
-- as a normal paid order (the customer paid real money for what checkout showed,
-- so access IS granted) but flagged 'discount_reused' for an admin, with no wallet
-- debit and no referrer credit.
-- ============================================================================
alter table public.referrals
  add column if not exists discount_order_id text references public.orders(id) on delete set null;

alter table public.order_review_flags drop constraint if exists order_review_flags_reason_check;
alter table public.order_review_flags
  add constraint order_review_flags_reason_check
  check (reason in ('stale_order_paid', 'discount_reused'));

create or replace function public.settle_razorpay_payment(
  p_event_id text,
  p_razorpay_order_id text,
  p_razorpay_payment_id text,
  p_amount_paise bigint,
  p_paid_at timestamptz default null   -- when the customer started the payment (Razorpay payment.created_at)
)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $function$
declare
  v_uid uuid;
  v_order public.orders%rowtype;
  v_product public.products%rowtype;
  v_existing_payment_order_id text;
  v_set public.referral_settings%rowtype;
  v_ref public.referrals%rowtype;
  v_balance numeric(10, 2);
  v_debit numeric(10, 2);
  v_stale boolean;
  v_discount_owner text;
  v_discount_dup boolean := false;
begin
  if p_event_id is null or p_razorpay_order_id is null or p_razorpay_payment_id is null
    or p_amount_paise is null or p_amount_paise <= 0 then
    raise exception 'invalid Razorpay settlement parameters';
  end if;

  select user_id into v_uid from public.orders where razorpay_order_id = p_razorpay_order_id;
  if v_uid is not null then
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || v_uid::text, 0));
  end if;

  -- Row lock serialises a webhook retry with the client verification path.
  select * into v_order
  from public.orders
  where razorpay_order_id = p_razorpay_order_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Razorpay order % is not linked to an internal order', p_razorpay_order_id;
  end if;
  if round(v_order.amount * 100)::bigint <> p_amount_paise then
    raise exception 'Razorpay amount does not match order amount';
  end if;

  select order_id into v_existing_payment_order_id
  from public.payments
  where razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id;
  if found and v_existing_payment_order_id <> v_order.id then
    raise exception 'Razorpay payment is already linked to another order';
  end if;

  -- Account deleted while the payment was in flight: keep the accounting row,
  -- grant nothing, debit nothing, reward nothing (refund manually).
  if v_order.user_id is null then
    insert into public.payments (
      order_id, user_id, product_id, amount, razorpay_order_id,
      razorpay_payment_id, status, verified_at
    ) values (
      v_order.id, null, v_order.product_id, v_order.amount,
      p_razorpay_order_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'success', now()
    ) on conflict (razorpay_payment_id) do nothing;

    update public.orders
    set status = 'paid', razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id, updated_at = now()
    where id = v_order.id;

    insert into public.razorpay_webhook_events(event_id, razorpay_payment_id, event_type)
    values (p_event_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'payment.captured')
    on conflict (event_id) do nothing;

    raise warning 'grant_razorpay_payment: payment % for order % arrived after the account was deleted; no access granted - refund manually', p_razorpay_payment_id, v_order.id;
    return;
  end if;

  select * into v_product from public.products where id = v_order.product_id;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'Order % references unknown product %', v_order.id, v_order.product_id;
  end if;

  -- ---- Friend discount is usable ONCE per referral -------------------------
  -- create_priced_order can price several open checkouts with the discount (an
  -- earlier one is cancelled but may still be paid). The first discounted order
  -- to settle claims referrals.discount_order_id; any other discounted order is
  -- a second use of the same discount. Serialised per user by the wallet
  -- advisory lock above; replays of the winner see their own id and pass.
  -- A second use is still granted (the customer paid what checkout charged) but
  -- gets no wallet debit and no referrer credit, and is flagged below.
  if v_order.referral_discount > 0 and v_order.referral_id is not null then
    update public.referrals set discount_order_id = v_order.id
     where id = v_order.referral_id and discount_order_id is null;
    select discount_order_id into v_discount_owner from public.referrals where id = v_order.referral_id;
    v_discount_dup := found and v_discount_owner is not null and v_discount_owner <> v_order.id;
  end if;

  insert into public.payments (
    order_id, user_id, product_id, amount, razorpay_order_id,
    razorpay_payment_id, status, verified_at
  ) values (
    v_order.id, v_order.user_id, v_order.product_id, v_order.amount,
    p_razorpay_order_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'success', now()
  ) on conflict (razorpay_payment_id) do nothing;

  insert into public.purchases (
    user_id, order_id, product_id, product_title, scope, chapter_id,
    subject_id, year_id, year_ids, course_id, amount, status, razorpay_order_id
  ) values (
    v_order.user_id, v_order.id, v_product.id, coalesce(v_product.title, 'Your content'),
    v_product.scope, v_product.chapter_id, v_product.subject_id, v_product.year_id,
    v_product.year_ids, v_product.course_id, v_order.amount, 'success', p_razorpay_order_id
  ) on conflict (order_id) do nothing;

  update public.orders
  set status = 'paid', razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id,
      course_id = v_product.course_id, updated_at = now()
  where id = v_order.id;

  -- ---- Stale order? -------------------------------------------------------
  -- v_order is the row as it was BEFORE this settlement flipped it to 'paid'.
  -- Replays see 'paid' and rely on the flag written the first time.
  v_stale := exists (select 1 from public.order_review_flags
                      where order_id = v_order.id and reason = 'stale_order_paid')
          or v_order.status in ('cancelled', 'failed')
          or (v_order.status = 'created' and v_order.expires_at is not null
              and coalesce(p_paid_at, now()) > v_order.expires_at);

  if v_stale and (v_order.wallet_amount > 0 or v_order.referral_discount > 0) then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'stale_order_paid', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            jsonb_build_object('order_status', v_order.status, 'expires_at', v_order.expires_at,
                               'paid_at', p_paid_at, 'razorpay_payment_id', p_razorpay_payment_id))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % was % / expired when payment % arrived; wallet NOT debited, flagged for review',
      v_order.id, v_order.status, p_razorpay_payment_id;
  end if;

  -- ---- Second use of the friend discount -----------------------------------
  if v_discount_dup then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'discount_reused', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            jsonb_build_object('discount_order_id', v_discount_owner, 'order_status', v_order.status,
                               'razorpay_payment_id', p_razorpay_payment_id))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % reuses the friend discount already used by order %; access granted, no wallet debit / referrer credit, flagged for review',
      v_order.id, v_discount_owner;
  end if;

  -- ---- Wallet debit -------------------------------------------------------
  if v_order.wallet_amount > 0 and not v_stale and not v_discount_dup then
    perform public.release_due_wallet_credits(v_order.user_id);
    select available into v_balance from public.wallet_balance_of(v_order.user_id);
    -- Normally balance >= wallet_amount (create_priced_order checked it under
    -- the same lock). Clamp anyway so the balance can never go negative.
    v_debit := least(v_order.wallet_amount, coalesce(v_balance, 0));
    if v_debit < v_order.wallet_amount
       and not exists (select 1 from public.wallet_ledger
                        where order_id = v_order.id and entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment') then
      raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % wanted % wallet credit but only % was available',
        v_order.id, v_order.wallet_amount, v_balance;
    end if;
    if v_debit > 0 then
      insert into public.wallet_ledger (user_id, entry_type, status, amount, source, order_id, note)
      values (v_order.user_id, 'debit', 'available', v_debit, 'order_payment', v_order.id, 'Wallet used at checkout')
      on conflict (order_id) where entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment' do nothing;
    end if;
  end if;

  -- ---- Referrer credit ----------------------------------------------------
  -- Only the friend's FIRST successful purchase counts, and only once.
  select * into v_ref from public.referrals where referred_id = v_order.user_id for update;
  if found and not v_discount_dup and v_ref.first_order_id is null and v_ref.status in ('pending', 'qualified')
     and not exists (select 1 from public.purchases
                      where user_id = v_order.user_id and order_id <> v_order.id and status = 'success') then
    update public.referrals
       set first_order_id = v_order.id, status = 'qualified', qualified_at = coalesce(qualified_at, now())
     where id = v_ref.id;

    select * into v_set from public.referral_settings where id = true;
    if v_set.enabled and v_set.referrer_credit_amount > 0
       and exists (select 1 from public.profiles where id = v_ref.referrer_id and not blocked) then
      insert into public.wallet_ledger (
        user_id, entry_type, status, amount, source, referral_id, order_id,
        available_at, expires_at, note
      ) values (
        v_ref.referrer_id, 'credit', 'pending', v_set.referrer_credit_amount::numeric(10, 2),
        'referral_reward', v_ref.id, v_order.id,
        now() + make_interval(days => v_set.credit_hold_days),
        case when v_set.credit_expiry_days is null then null
             else now() + make_interval(days => v_set.credit_hold_days + v_set.credit_expiry_days) end,
        'Friend''s first purchase'
      ) on conflict (referral_id) where entry_type = 'credit' and source = 'referral_reward' do nothing;
    end if;
  end if;

  insert into public.razorpay_webhook_events(event_id, razorpay_payment_id, event_type)
  values (p_event_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'payment.captured')
  on conflict (event_id) do nothing;
end;
$function$;

revoke all on function public.settle_razorpay_payment(text, text, text, bigint, timestamptz)
  from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.settle_razorpay_payment(text, text, text, bigint, timestamptz)
  to service_role;


===== supabase/migrations/20260926100000_batch1_refund_dispute_revoke_access.sql =====
-- ============================================================================
-- Batch 1 / F2 + F3: a refund or a lost dispute must take the access back, and
-- must take the referrer's credit back in EVERY state it can be in.
--
-- Before this migration handle_payment_refund():
--   * marked the order 'refunded' but left purchases.status = 'success', so the
--     student kept the content after a full refund (F2);
--   * found the referrer's credit through referrals.first_order_id, so a friend
--     who had deleted their account (referrals row gone) left the credit alive;
--   * only cancelled a credit with status 'pending' AND available_at > now(), so
--     a credit that was due but not yet released by the 15-minute job fell into
--     the "already released" branch and was then released anyway;
--   * only WARNED when the credit had already been released (F3).
--
-- After it:
--   * purchases.status leaves 'success' on a FULL refund (-> 'refunded') and on a
--     lost dispute (-> 'chargeback'); an open dispute suspends access
--     (-> 'disputed') and a won dispute restores it. Every entitlement check in
--     the database already tests status = 'success', so nothing else changes.
--   * a PARTIAL refund still does nothing at all (no revoke, no wallet, no credit).
--   * the credit is found through wallet_ledger.order_id (survives the friend's
--     account deletion), a pending credit is cancelled whatever its available_at,
--     a released credit gets a reversal row (clamped to what the referrer still
--     has, so the wallet never goes negative) and any part that cannot be
--     recovered is put in order_review_flags for a manual decision.
--   * credits attached to a disputed payment are not released while it is open.
-- ============================================================================

-- ---- 1. purchases.status: a real, closed vocabulary -------------------------
-- Live data: 13 rows, all 'success', none NULL.
update public.purchases set status = 'success' where status is null;   -- no-op on live; keeps the migration re-runnable on other copies
alter table public.purchases alter column status set default 'success';
alter table public.purchases alter column status set not null;
alter table public.purchases drop constraint if exists purchases_status_check;
alter table public.purchases add constraint purchases_status_check
  check (status in ('success', 'refunded', 'disputed', 'chargeback', 'duplicate'));

comment on column public.purchases.status is
  'success = grants access. refunded / chargeback = payment reversed, no access. disputed = open dispute, access suspended. duplicate = a second paid purchase of a product the student already owned (no access of its own; refund it).';

-- ---- 2. review flag for a credit that could not be fully recovered ----------
alter table public.order_review_flags drop constraint if exists order_review_flags_reason_check;
alter table public.order_review_flags add constraint order_review_flags_reason_check
  check (reason in ('stale_order_paid', 'discount_reused', 'referral_credit_unrecovered'));

-- ---- 3. one internal reversal routine ---------------------------------------
create or replace function public.reverse_payment(
  p_razorpay_payment_id text,
  p_purchase_status text,      -- 'refunded' | 'chargeback'
  p_restore_wallet boolean     -- give the student's own wallet amount back?
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_uid uuid;
  v_order public.orders%rowtype;
  v_credit public.wallet_ledger%rowtype;
  v_debit public.wallet_ledger%rowtype;
  v_restored numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_revoked integer := 0;
  v_rows integer := 0;
  v_avail numeric(10, 2);
  v_reversed numeric(10, 2);
  v_status jsonb;
begin
  if p_purchase_status not in ('refunded', 'chargeback') then
    raise exception 'reverse_payment: bad purchase status %', p_purchase_status;
  end if;

  -- Same lock order as settle_razorpay_payment (wallet lock, THEN the order row)
  -- so a refund cannot deadlock with a replayed capture event.
  select user_id into v_uid from public.orders where razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id;
  if v_uid is not null then
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || v_uid::text, 0));
  end if;

  select * into v_order from public.orders where razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id for update;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('status', 'unknown_payment'); end if;

  -- ---- Take the access back ----------------------------------------------
  update public.orders set status = 'refunded', updated_at = now()
   where id = v_order.id and status = 'paid';

  update public.purchases set status = p_purchase_status
   where order_id = v_order.id and status not in ('refunded', 'chargeback');
  get diagnostics v_revoked = row_count;

  -- ---- Give the wallet amount this order used back to the student ---------
  if p_restore_wallet then
    select * into v_debit from public.wallet_ledger
     where order_id = v_order.id and entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment';
    if found and v_debit.user_id is not null then
      perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'true', true);
      insert into public.wallet_ledger (user_id, entry_type, status, amount, source, order_id, note)
      values (v_debit.user_id, 'credit', 'available', v_debit.amount, 'order_refund', v_order.id,
              'Wallet amount restored after refund')
      on conflict (order_id) where entry_type = 'credit' and source = 'order_refund' do nothing;
      get diagnostics v_rows = row_count;   -- 1 on first insert, 0 on replay
      perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'false', true);
      v_restored := case when v_rows > 0 then v_debit.amount else 0 end;
    end if;
  end if;
