  -- ---- The referrer's credit for this friend's purchase --------------------
  -- Looked up by the ledger row's own order_id, NOT through referrals: the
  -- referrals row is deleted when the friend deletes their account.
  select * into v_credit from public.wallet_ledger
   where order_id = v_order.id and entry_type = 'credit' and source = 'referral_reward'
   for update;

  if not found then
    v_status := jsonb_build_object('status', 'no_referral_credit');

  elsif v_credit.status = 'cancelled' then
    v_status := jsonb_build_object('status', 'already_cancelled');

  elsif v_credit.status = 'pending' then
    -- Still held (even if the hold has technically run out but the release job
    -- has not run yet): cancel it.
    perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'true', true);
    update public.wallet_ledger set status = 'cancelled' where id = v_credit.id;
    perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'false', true);
    update public.referrals
       set status = 'rejected', reject_reason = 'friend_payment_reversed'
     where id = v_credit.referral_id and status <> 'rejected';
    v_status := jsonb_build_object('status', 'credit_cancelled', 'amount', v_credit.amount);

  elsif exists (select 1 from public.wallet_ledger
                 where entry_type = 'reversal' and reverses_id = v_credit.id) then
    v_status := jsonb_build_object('status', 'already_reversed', 'ledger_id', v_credit.id);

  elsif v_credit.user_id is null then
    v_status := jsonb_build_object('status', 'referrer_gone', 'ledger_id', v_credit.id);

  elsif v_credit.expires_at is not null and v_credit.expires_at <= now() then
    v_status := jsonb_build_object('status', 'credit_expired', 'ledger_id', v_credit.id);

  else
    -- Released ('available'): reverse it with a ledger row, but never by more
    -- than the referrer still has (the ledger refuses to overdraw). What cannot
    -- be recovered is flagged for a manual decision.
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || v_credit.user_id::text, 0));
    select available into v_avail from public.wallet_balance_of(v_credit.user_id);
    v_reversed := least(v_credit.amount, coalesce(v_avail, 0));
    if v_reversed > 0 then
      perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'true', true);
      insert into public.wallet_ledger (user_id, entry_type, status, amount, source, reverses_id, referral_id, order_id, note)
      values (v_credit.user_id, 'reversal', 'available', v_reversed, 'order_refund', v_credit.id, v_credit.referral_id, v_order.id,
              'Friend''s payment was reversed')
      on conflict (reverses_id) where entry_type = 'reversal' do nothing;
      perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'false', true);
    end if;
    update public.referrals
       set status = 'rejected', reject_reason = 'friend_payment_reversed'
     where id = v_credit.referral_id and status <> 'rejected';
    if v_reversed < v_credit.amount then
      insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
      values (v_order.id, v_credit.user_id, 'referral_credit_unrecovered', 0, 0,
              jsonb_build_object(
                'credit_ledger_id', v_credit.id,
                'credit_amount', v_credit.amount,
                'reversed', v_reversed,
                'unrecovered', v_credit.amount - v_reversed,
                'razorpay_payment_id', p_razorpay_payment_id,
                'recommended_action',
                  'The friend''s payment was reversed but the referrer had already spent part of the credit. '
                  || 'Only what was still in their wallet was taken back; decide whether to recover the rest.'))
      on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    end if;
    v_status := jsonb_build_object('status', 'credit_reversed', 'ledger_id', v_credit.id,
                                   'amount', v_credit.amount, 'reversed', v_reversed);
  end if;

  return v_status || jsonb_build_object('wallet_restored', v_restored, 'purchases_revoked', v_revoked);
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.reverse_payment(text, text, boolean) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.reverse_payment(text, text, boolean) to service_role;

-- ---- 4. refund: a FULL refund reverses, a partial one does nothing -----------
create or replace function public.handle_payment_refund(p_razorpay_payment_id text, p_full_refund boolean)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from public.orders where razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id) then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'unknown_payment');
  end if;
  if not coalesce(p_full_refund, false) then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'partial_refund_ignored');
  end if;
  return public.reverse_payment(p_razorpay_payment_id, 'refunded', true);
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.handle_payment_refund(text, boolean) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.handle_payment_refund(text, boolean) to service_role;

-- ---- 5. disputes / chargebacks ----------------------------------------------
--   opened : suspend access while the dispute is open (nothing else moves)
--   won    : give the access back
--   lost   : the money is gone - same as a full refund, except the student's
--            wallet amount is NOT given back
create or replace function public.handle_payment_dispute(p_razorpay_payment_id text, p_outcome text)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_order public.orders%rowtype;
  v_uid uuid;
  v_n integer := 0;
begin
  if p_outcome not in ('opened', 'won', 'lost') then
    raise exception 'handle_payment_dispute: unknown outcome %', p_outcome;
  end if;

  if p_outcome = 'lost' then
    return public.reverse_payment(p_razorpay_payment_id, 'chargeback', false)
           || jsonb_build_object('dispute', 'lost');
  end if;

  select user_id into v_uid from public.orders where razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id;
  if v_uid is not null then
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || v_uid::text, 0));
  end if;
  select * into v_order from public.orders where razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id for update;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('status', 'unknown_payment'); end if;

  if p_outcome = 'opened' then
    update public.purchases set status = 'disputed' where order_id = v_order.id and status = 'success';
    get diagnostics v_n = row_count;
    return jsonb_build_object('status', case when v_n > 0 then 'access_suspended' else 'nothing_to_suspend' end,
                              'purchases_suspended', v_n);
  end if;

  -- won: restore, unless the student bought the same product again meanwhile
  -- (then this one is the duplicate; it keeps no access of its own).
  update public.purchases pu
     set status = case when exists (select 1 from public.purchases o
                                     where o.user_id = pu.user_id and o.product_id = pu.product_id
                                       and o.id <> pu.id and o.status = 'success')
                       then 'duplicate' else 'success' end
   where pu.order_id = v_order.id and pu.status = 'disputed';
  get diagnostics v_n = row_count;
  return jsonb_build_object('status', case when v_n > 0 then 'access_restored' else 'nothing_to_restore' end,
                            'purchases_restored', v_n);
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.handle_payment_dispute(text, text) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.handle_payment_dispute(text, text) to service_role;

-- ---- 6. do not release credits that belong to a disputed payment -------------
create or replace function public.release_due_wallet_credits(p_user uuid default null)
returns integer
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_ids uuid[];
  n integer;
begin
  -- Called from get_my_wallet() under the student's role: tell the
  -- block_client_writes backstop this write is ours (transaction-local).
  perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'true', true);
  with due as (
    update public.wallet_ledger l
       set status = 'available'
     where l.entry_type = 'credit'
       and l.status = 'pending'
       and l.available_at <= now()
       and (p_user is null or l.user_id = p_user)
       -- a credit earned by a payment that is being disputed stays held
       and not exists (select 1 from public.purchases pu
                        where pu.order_id = l.order_id and pu.status = 'disputed')
    returning l.id, l.referral_id
  )
  select array_agg(id), count(*) into v_ids, n from due;

  update public.referrals r
     set status = 'rewarded', rewarded_at = now()
   where r.status = 'qualified'
     and exists (
       select 1 from public.wallet_ledger l
        where l.referral_id = r.id and l.source = 'referral_reward'
          and l.entry_type = 'credit' and l.status = 'available'
     );

  perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'false', true);
  return coalesce(n, 0);
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.release_due_wallet_credits(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.release_due_wallet_credits(uuid) to service_role;


===== supabase/migrations/20260926110000_batch1_settle_wallet_and_flags.sql =====
-- ============================================================================
-- Batch 1 / F4 (+ the settlement half of F6)
--
-- 1. The wallet amount an order was priced with is ALWAYS consumed when that
--    order is settled. Before, a payment that arrived for a cancelled / expired
--    checkout, or for a reused friend discount, was granted but NOT debited, so
--    a student could create several checkouts in a row, pay them all, and use
--    the same wallet balance on each while being debited once.
--    The debit is clamped to what the wallet still holds; any shortfall is
--    flagged ('wallet_shortfall'). It runs only on the FIRST settlement of an
--    order, so a replayed webhook can never debit twice or debit late.
--
-- 2. 'discount_reused' still GRANTS access (the customer paid what checkout
--    showed) and still gives no referrer credit, but the flag now says exactly
--    what happened and what to do: which order legitimately used the discount,
--    how much was under-charged, and how to reverse it (a FULL refund of the
--    payment in Razorpay, which after the F2 migration revokes the access and
--    gives the wallet amount back).
--
-- 3. Paying twice for a product the student already owns (a checkout that was
--    superseded but is still payable) is recorded, not rejected - the money is
--    real. The second purchase row is stored as status 'duplicate' (it grants
--    nothing, the first purchase already does), and a 'duplicate_purchase' flag
--    tells the admin to refund it. This is also what keeps the new unique index
--    on purchases (next migration) from ever failing a settlement.
--
-- 4. A late replay of a capture event after a full refund no longer flips the
--    order back from 'refunded' to 'paid'.
-- ============================================================================

alter table public.order_review_flags drop constraint if exists order_review_flags_reason_check;
alter table public.order_review_flags add constraint order_review_flags_reason_check
  check (reason in ('stale_order_paid', 'discount_reused', 'referral_credit_unrecovered',
                    'wallet_shortfall', 'duplicate_purchase'));

create or replace function public.settle_razorpay_payment(
  p_event_id text,
  p_razorpay_order_id text,
  p_razorpay_payment_id text,
  p_amount_paise bigint,
  p_paid_at timestamptz default null   -- when the customer started the payment (Razorpay payment.created_at)
)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_uid uuid;
  v_order public.orders%rowtype;
  v_product public.products%rowtype;
  v_existing_payment_order_id text;
  v_set public.referral_settings%rowtype;
  v_ref public.referrals%rowtype;
  v_balance numeric(10, 2);
  v_debit numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_stale boolean;
  v_first boolean;                 -- first settlement of this order (not a replay)
  v_debited boolean := false;
  v_discount_owner text;
  v_discount_dup boolean := false;
  v_owned_purchase text;           -- an existing successful purchase of the same product
  v_base jsonb;
begin
  if p_event_id is null or p_razorpay_order_id is null or p_razorpay_payment_id is null
    or p_amount_paise is null or p_amount_paise <= 0 then
    raise exception 'invalid Razorpay settlement parameters';
  end if;

  select user_id into v_uid from public.orders where razorpay_order_id = p_razorpay_order_id;
  if v_uid is not null then
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || v_uid::text, 0));
  end if;

  -- Row lock serialises a webhook retry with the client verification path.
  select * into v_order
  from public.orders
  where razorpay_order_id = p_razorpay_order_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Razorpay order % is not linked to an internal order', p_razorpay_order_id;
  end if;
  if round(v_order.amount * 100)::bigint <> p_amount_paise then
    raise exception 'Razorpay amount does not match order amount';
  end if;

  select order_id into v_existing_payment_order_id
  from public.payments
  where razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id;
  if found and v_existing_payment_order_id <> v_order.id then
    raise exception 'Razorpay payment is already linked to another order';
  end if;

  -- Account deleted while the payment was in flight: keep the accounting row,
  -- grant nothing, debit nothing, reward nothing (refund manually).
  if v_order.user_id is null then
    insert into public.payments (
      order_id, user_id, product_id, amount, razorpay_order_id,
      razorpay_payment_id, status, verified_at
    ) values (
      v_order.id, null, v_order.product_id, v_order.amount,
      p_razorpay_order_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'success', now()
    ) on conflict (razorpay_payment_id) do nothing;

    update public.orders
    set status = 'paid', razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id, updated_at = now()
    where id = v_order.id and status <> 'refunded';

    insert into public.razorpay_webhook_events(event_id, razorpay_payment_id, event_type)
    values (p_event_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'payment.captured')
    on conflict (event_id) do nothing;

    raise warning 'grant_razorpay_payment: payment % for order % arrived after the account was deleted; no access granted - refund manually', p_razorpay_payment_id, v_order.id;
    return;
  end if;

  select * into v_product from public.products where id = v_order.product_id;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'Order % references unknown product %', v_order.id, v_order.product_id;
  end if;

  v_first := v_order.status not in ('paid', 'refunded');

  -- ---- Friend discount is usable ONCE per referral -------------------------
  -- The first discounted order to settle claims referrals.discount_order_id; any
  -- other discounted order is a second use of the same discount. Serialised per
  -- user by the wallet advisory lock above; replays of the winner see their own
  -- id and pass. A second use is still granted (the customer paid what checkout
  -- charged) but gets no referrer credit, and is flagged below.
  if v_order.referral_discount > 0 and v_order.referral_id is not null then
    update public.referrals set discount_order_id = v_order.id
     where id = v_order.referral_id and discount_order_id is null;
    select discount_order_id into v_discount_owner from public.referrals where id = v_order.referral_id;
    v_discount_dup := found and v_discount_owner is not null and v_discount_owner <> v_order.id;
  end if;

  insert into public.payments (
    order_id, user_id, product_id, amount, razorpay_order_id,
    razorpay_payment_id, status, verified_at
  ) values (
    v_order.id, v_order.user_id, v_order.product_id, v_order.amount,
    p_razorpay_order_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'success', now()
  ) on conflict (razorpay_payment_id) do nothing;

  -- ---- Already owns this product? -----------------------------------------
  select id into v_owned_purchase from public.purchases
   where user_id = v_order.user_id and product_id = v_product.id
     and status = 'success' and order_id is distinct from v_order.id
   limit 1;

  insert into public.purchases (
    user_id, order_id, product_id, product_title, scope, chapter_id,
    subject_id, year_id, year_ids, course_id, amount, status, razorpay_order_id
  ) values (
    v_order.user_id, v_order.id, v_product.id, coalesce(v_product.title, 'Your content'),
    v_product.scope, v_product.chapter_id, v_product.subject_id, v_product.year_id,
    v_product.year_ids, v_product.course_id, v_order.amount,
    case when v_owned_purchase is null then 'success' else 'duplicate' end,
    p_razorpay_order_id
  ) on conflict (order_id) do nothing;

  update public.orders
  set status = 'paid', razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id,
      course_id = v_product.course_id, updated_at = now()
  where id = v_order.id and status <> 'refunded';

  -- ---- Stale order? -------------------------------------------------------
  -- v_order is the row as it was BEFORE this settlement flipped it to 'paid'.
  -- Replays see 'paid' and rely on the flag written the first time.
  v_stale := exists (select 1 from public.order_review_flags
                      where order_id = v_order.id and reason = 'stale_order_paid')
          or v_order.status in ('cancelled', 'failed')
          or (v_order.status = 'created' and v_order.expires_at is not null
              and coalesce(p_paid_at, now()) > v_order.expires_at);

  -- ---- Wallet debit: ALWAYS, on the first settlement, clamped ---------------
  if v_first and v_order.wallet_amount > 0
     and not exists (select 1 from public.wallet_ledger
                      where order_id = v_order.id and entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment') then
    perform public.release_due_wallet_credits(v_order.user_id);
    select available into v_balance from public.wallet_balance_of(v_order.user_id);
    v_debit := least(v_order.wallet_amount, coalesce(v_balance, 0));
    if v_debit > 0 then
      insert into public.wallet_ledger (user_id, entry_type, status, amount, source, order_id, note)
      values (v_order.user_id, 'debit', 'available', v_debit, 'order_payment', v_order.id, 'Wallet used at checkout')
      on conflict (order_id) where entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment' do nothing;
      v_debited := true;
    end if;
  end if;

  -- ---- Review flags (one per order and reason; replays add nothing) ---------
  v_base := jsonb_build_object(
    'product_id', v_product.id,
    'product_title', v_product.title,
    'amount_paid', v_order.amount,
    'list_price', v_order.list_price,
    'razorpay_order_id', p_razorpay_order_id,
    'razorpay_payment_id', p_razorpay_payment_id);

  if v_first and v_order.wallet_amount > 0 and v_debit < v_order.wallet_amount then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'wallet_shortfall', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            v_base || jsonb_build_object(
              'wallet_amount_applied', v_order.wallet_amount,
              'wallet_debited', v_debit,
              'shortfall', v_order.wallet_amount - v_debit,
              'access_granted', true,
              'recommended_action',
                format('Checkout applied Rs %s of wallet balance but only Rs %s was still available, so Rs %s of the discount was not paid for. Access was granted. Decide whether to accept it or refund payment %s in Razorpay (a full refund revokes the access).',
                       v_order.wallet_amount, v_debit, v_order.wallet_amount - v_debit, p_razorpay_payment_id)))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % wanted % wallet credit but only % was available',
      v_order.id, v_order.wallet_amount, v_debit;
  end if;

  if v_stale and (v_order.wallet_amount > 0 or v_order.referral_discount > 0) then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'stale_order_paid', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            v_base || jsonb_build_object(
              'order_status', v_order.status, 'expires_at', v_order.expires_at, 'paid_at', p_paid_at,
              'wallet_debited', (select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from public.wallet_ledger
                                  where order_id = v_order.id and entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment'),
              'access_granted', true,
              'recommended_action',
                'This payment arrived for a checkout that was already cancelled or had expired. Access was granted and the wallet amount was debited as normal. No action needed unless the amount looks wrong.'))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % was % / expired when payment % arrived; flagged for review',
      v_order.id, v_order.status, p_razorpay_payment_id;
  end if;

  if v_discount_dup then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'discount_reused', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            v_base || jsonb_build_object(
              'discount_first_order_id', v_discount_owner,
              'discount_not_owed', v_order.referral_discount,
              'order_status', v_order.status,
              'access_granted', true,
              'referrer_credited', false,
              'recommended_action',
                format('Access was granted. This student already used their one friend discount on order %s, so this order was under-charged by Rs %s (paid Rs %s instead of Rs %s). To reverse it, issue a FULL refund of payment %s in the Razorpay dashboard: the refund webhook then revokes the access and gives back any wallet amount used, and the student can buy again at full price. Do nothing to keep the sale as it is.',
                       v_discount_owner, v_order.referral_discount, v_order.amount,
                       v_order.amount + v_order.referral_discount, p_razorpay_payment_id)))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % reuses the friend discount already used by order %; access granted, no referrer credit, flagged for review',
      v_order.id, v_discount_owner;
  end if;

  if v_owned_purchase is not null then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'duplicate_purchase', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            v_base || jsonb_build_object(
              'existing_purchase_id', v_owned_purchase,
              'access_granted', false,
              'recommended_action',
                format('The student already owned "%s" and paid for it again (Rs %s). The new purchase is stored as ''duplicate'' and adds no access. Refund payment %s in the Razorpay dashboard.',
                       v_product.title, v_order.amount, p_razorpay_payment_id)))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % is a duplicate purchase of product %; flagged for refund', v_order.id, v_product.id;
  end if;

  -- ---- Referrer credit ----------------------------------------------------
  -- Only the friend's FIRST successful purchase counts, and only once.
  select * into v_ref from public.referrals where referred_id = v_order.user_id for update;
  if found and not v_discount_dup and v_ref.first_order_id is null and v_ref.status in ('pending', 'qualified')
     and v_owned_purchase is null
     and not exists (select 1 from public.purchases
                      where user_id = v_order.user_id and order_id <> v_order.id and status = 'success') then
    update public.referrals
       set first_order_id = v_order.id, status = 'qualified', qualified_at = coalesce(qualified_at, now())
     where id = v_ref.id;

    select * into v_set from public.referral_settings where id = true;
    if v_set.enabled and v_set.referrer_credit_amount > 0
       and exists (select 1 from public.profiles where id = v_ref.referrer_id and not blocked) then
      insert into public.wallet_ledger (
        user_id, entry_type, status, amount, source, referral_id, order_id,
        available_at, expires_at, note
      ) values (
        v_ref.referrer_id, 'credit', 'pending', v_set.referrer_credit_amount::numeric(10, 2),
        'referral_reward', v_ref.id, v_order.id,
        now() + make_interval(days => v_set.credit_hold_days),
        case when v_set.credit_expiry_days is null then null
             else now() + make_interval(days => v_set.credit_hold_days + v_set.credit_expiry_days) end,
        'Friend''s first purchase'
      ) on conflict (referral_id) where entry_type = 'credit' and source = 'referral_reward' do nothing;
    end if;
  end if;

  insert into public.razorpay_webhook_events(event_id, razorpay_payment_id, event_type)
  values (p_event_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'payment.captured')
  on conflict (event_id) do nothing;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.settle_razorpay_payment(text, text, text, bigint, timestamptz)
  from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.settle_razorpay_payment(text, text, text, bigint, timestamptz)
  to service_role;


===== supabase/migrations/20260926120000_batch1_block_owned_product.sql =====
-- ============================================================================
-- Batch 1 / F6: a student cannot buy a product they already own.
--
--  * create_priced_order() / quote_my_order() answer code 'already_owned'
--    (create-order maps it to a message) before anything is reserved.
--  * a partial UNIQUE index makes it impossible to hold two successful purchases
--    of the same product. settle_razorpay_payment() (previous migration) stores a
--    second paid purchase as 'duplicate', so the index can never fail a
--    settlement.
--
-- LIVE DATA, checked before writing this: exactly one (user, product) pair
-- already has two successful purchases - an ADMIN account testing the Rs 1
-- product "new one" twice on 2026-08-01, 49 seconds apart, two real captured
-- payments (pay_TKRKPATnDf3xSS, pay_TKS4dN2Cih85eD). No row is deleted or
-- edited here. The newer of the two (66c151c8-...) is excluded from the index by
-- id, so the index can be created now and still protects every other purchase,
-- including all future ones. If you later refund or re-status that row you can
-- drop the exclusion:
--   drop index purchases_one_success_per_product;
--   create unique index purchases_one_success_per_product
--     on public.purchases (user_id, product_id) where status = 'success';
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_priced_order(p_user_id uuid, p_product_id text, p_use_wallet boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_set      public.referral_settings%rowtype;
  v_product  public.products%rowtype;
  v_ref      public.referrals%rowtype;
  v_price    numeric(10, 2);
  v_discount numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_wallet   numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_base     numeric(10, 2);
  v_cap      numeric(10, 2);
  v_balance  numeric(10, 2);
  v_final    numeric(10, 2);
  v_order_id text := gen_random_uuid()::text;
begin
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || p_user_id::text, 0));

  select * into v_product from public.products where id = p_product_id;
  if not found or not v_product.active or not (v_product.price > 0) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'product_unavailable');
  end if;
  v_price := v_product.price::numeric(10, 2);
  if v_price < 1 then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'invalid_price');
  end if;

  -- Already owns this exact product? Refuse before anything is reserved.
  if exists (select 1 from public.purchases
              where user_id = p_user_id and product_id = v_product.id and status = 'success') then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'already_owned');
  end if;

  select * into v_set from public.referral_settings where id = true;

  -- Friend discount: first purchase only, code applied at signup, program on.
  if v_set.enabled and v_set.friend_discount_percent > 0 then
    select r.* into v_ref
      from public.referrals r
      join public.profiles rp on rp.id = r.referrer_id and not rp.blocked
     where r.referred_id = p_user_id
       and r.status in ('pending', 'qualified')
       and r.first_order_id is null
       and not exists (select 1 from public.purchases pu
                        where pu.user_id = p_user_id and pu.status = 'success');
    if found then
      v_discount := round(v_price * v_set.friend_discount_percent / 100, 2);
      if v_set.friend_discount_max is not null then
        v_discount := least(v_discount, v_set.friend_discount_max);
      end if;
      v_discount := greatest(0, least(v_discount, v_price - 1));
    end if;
  end if;

  v_base := v_price - v_discount;

  -- Wallet: notes products only, capped at wallet_max_percent of what is left
  -- after the friend discount, and never more than the available balance.
  if p_use_wallet then
    if not (v_product.product_type = any (v_set.wallet_product_types)) then
      return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'wallet_not_allowed');
    end if;
    perform public.release_due_wallet_credits(p_user_id);
    select available into v_balance from public.wallet_balance_of(p_user_id);
    v_cap := floor(v_base * v_set.wallet_max_percent) / 100;
    v_wallet := greatest(0, least(v_cap, coalesce(v_balance, 0)));
  end if;

  v_final := v_price - v_discount - v_wallet;
  if v_final < 1 then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'invalid_price');
  end if;

  -- Validation passed: only now cancel every earlier unpaid order of this user.
  update public.orders
     set status = 'cancelled', updated_at = now()
   where user_id = p_user_id and status = 'created';

  insert into public.orders (
    id, user_id, product_id, scope, chapter_id, subject_id, year_id, year_ids, course_id,
    amount, list_price, referral_discount, wallet_amount, referral_id, status, expires_at
  ) values (
    v_order_id, p_user_id, v_product.id, v_product.scope, v_product.chapter_id, v_product.subject_id,
    v_product.year_id, v_product.year_ids, v_product.course_id,
    v_final, v_price, v_discount, v_wallet,
    case when v_discount > 0 then v_ref.id end, 'created',
    now() + make_interval(mins => v_set.checkout_expiry_minutes)
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true, 'order_id', v_order_id, 'title', v_product.title,
    'list_price', v_price, 'referral_discount', v_discount,
    'wallet_amount', v_wallet, 'amount', v_final,
    'timeout_seconds', v_set.checkout_expiry_minutes * 60
  );
end;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.quote_my_order(p_product_id text, p_use_wallet boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_uid      uuid := auth.uid();
  v_set      public.referral_settings%rowtype;
  v_product  public.products%rowtype;
  v_price    numeric(10, 2);
  v_discount numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_wallet   numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_avail    numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_cap      numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_eligible boolean := false;
begin
  if v_uid is null then raise exception 'not authenticated' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  select * into v_product from public.products where id = p_product_id and active;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'product_unavailable'); end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.purchases
              where user_id = v_uid and product_id = v_product.id and status = 'success') then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'already_owned');
  end if;
  v_price := v_product.price::numeric(10, 2);
  select * into v_set from public.referral_settings where id = true;

  if v_set.enabled and v_set.friend_discount_percent > 0
     and exists (select 1 from public.referrals r
                   join public.profiles rp on rp.id = r.referrer_id and not rp.blocked
                  where r.referred_id = v_uid and r.status in ('pending', 'qualified') and r.first_order_id is null)
     and not exists (select 1 from public.purchases pu where pu.user_id = v_uid and pu.status = 'success') then
    v_discount := round(v_price * v_set.friend_discount_percent / 100, 2);
    if v_set.friend_discount_max is not null then v_discount := least(v_discount, v_set.friend_discount_max); end if;
    v_discount := greatest(0, least(v_discount, v_price - 1));
  end if;

  v_eligible := v_product.product_type = any (v_set.wallet_product_types);
  if v_eligible then
    perform public.release_due_wallet_credits(v_uid);
    select available into v_avail from public.wallet_balance_of(v_uid);
    v_cap := floor((v_price - v_discount) * v_set.wallet_max_percent) / 100;
    if p_use_wallet then v_wallet := greatest(0, least(v_cap, coalesce(v_avail, 0))); end if;
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true, 'list_price', v_price, 'referral_discount', v_discount,
    'wallet_eligible', v_eligible, 'wallet_available', coalesce(v_avail, 0),
    'wallet_max_usable', least(v_cap, coalesce(v_avail, 0)),
    'wallet_amount', v_wallet, 'amount', v_price - v_discount - v_wallet
  );
end;
$function$;

revoke all on function public.create_priced_order(uuid, text, boolean) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.create_priced_order(uuid, text, boolean) to service_role;
revoke all on function public.quote_my_order(text, boolean) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.quote_my_order(text, boolean) to authenticated;


-- purchases.product_id is nullable on legacy rows; NULLs are distinct, so they never collide.
create unique index if not exists purchases_one_success_per_product
  on public.purchases (user_id, product_id)
  where status = 'success' and id <> '66c151c8-bd1e-42ca-b22e-73091554fbae';


===== supabase/migrations/20260926130000_batch1_hygiene.sql =====
-- ============================================================================
-- Batch 1 / hygiene: F9, F10, F14, F15, F16. Nothing here deletes or edits data.
-- Where a CHECK / FK is added it is added NOT VALID (enforced for every new or
-- changed row at once) and then VALIDATEd inside a guarded block, so a legacy
-- row that breaks a rule produces a NOTICE instead of failing the deploy.
-- ============================================================================

create or replace function pg_temp.try_validate(p_table regclass, p_constraint text) returns void
language plpgsql as $$
begin
  execute format('alter table %s validate constraint %I', p_table, p_constraint);
exception when others then
  raise notice 'HYGIENE: % on % left NOT VALID (existing rows break it): %', p_constraint, p_table, sqlerrm;
end $$;

-- ---- F9: analytics_events cannot be used to spam or to forge a user ---------
drop policy if exists "anyone can log analytics events" on public.analytics_events;
drop policy if exists analytics_insert_own_or_anon on public.analytics_events;
create policy analytics_insert_own_or_anon on public.analytics_events
  for insert to anon, authenticated
  with check (user_id is null or user_id = auth.uid());

alter table public.analytics_events drop constraint if exists analytics_events_name_len;
alter table public.analytics_events add constraint analytics_events_name_len
  check (char_length(name) between 1 and 64) not valid;
alter table public.analytics_events drop constraint if exists analytics_events_params_size;
alter table public.analytics_events add constraint analytics_events_params_size
  check (octet_length(params::text) <= 4096) not valid;
select pg_temp.try_validate('public.analytics_events', 'analytics_events_name_len');
select pg_temp.try_validate('public.analytics_events', 'analytics_events_params_size');

-- ---- F10: email is server-owned; changing the phone drops mobile_verified ----
create or replace function public.profiles_before_write()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_year_course_id text;
  v_client boolean := coalesce(current_setting('role', true), 'none') in ('anon', 'authenticated');
  v_bypass boolean := coalesce(current_setting('app.allow_profile_admin_fields', true), 'false') = 'true';
  v_is_admin boolean := public.am_i_admin();
  v_protected text[] := array[
    'id', 'blocked', 'is_blocked', 'role', 'is_admin', 'is_staff', 'status',
    'email', 'email_verified', 'mobile_verified', 'referral_code', 'course_id', 'year_id',
    'created_at'
  ];
  v_old jsonb;
  v_new jsonb;
  v_col text;
begin
  if v_client and not v_bypass and not v_is_admin then
    if tg_op = 'UPDATE' then
      v_old := to_jsonb(old);
      v_new := to_jsonb(new);
      foreach v_col in array v_protected loop
        if v_new -> v_col is distinct from v_old -> v_col then
          raise exception 'Cannot modify protected profile field "%"', v_col
            using errcode = '42501';
        end if;
      end loop;
      -- A verified number stops being verified the moment it is replaced.
      if public.normalize_phone(new.phone) is distinct from public.normalize_phone(old.phone) then
        new.mobile_verified := false;
      end if;
    else
      -- A client-created profile row starts unblocked and unverified.
      new.blocked := false;
      new.email_verified := false;
      new.mobile_verified := false;
    end if;
  end if;

  -- Self-heal: if year_id no longer belongs to course_id, clear it.
  if new.year_id is not null then
    select course_id into v_year_course_id from public.years where id = new.year_id;
    if v_year_course_id is null or v_year_course_id is distinct from new.course_id then
      new.year_id := null;
    end if;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$$;

-- profiles.email now only changes when the auth email does.
create or replace function public.sync_profile_email()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
begin
  if new.email is not null and new.email is distinct from old.email then
    perform set_config('app.allow_profile_admin_fields', 'true', true);
    update public.profiles set email = new.email, updated_at = now() where id = new.id;
    perform set_config('app.allow_profile_admin_fields', 'false', true);
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;
revoke all on function public.sync_profile_email() from public, anon, authenticated;

drop trigger if exists on_auth_user_email_changed on auth.users;
create trigger on_auth_user_email_changed
  after update of email on auth.users
  for each row execute function public.sync_profile_email();

-- ---- F14: quiz_scores cannot hold nonsense or someone else's email -----------
-- (The app still grades on the device, so a student can claim a perfect score;
-- what is closed here is score > total, negative, percentage 99999 and a forged
-- email. Real protection needs server-side grading.)
alter table public.quiz_scores drop constraint if exists quiz_scores_sane;
alter table public.quiz_scores add constraint quiz_scores_sane
  check (total > 0 and score >= 0 and score <= total and percentage between 0 and 100) not valid;
select pg_temp.try_validate('public.quiz_scores', 'quiz_scores_sane');

create or replace function public.quiz_scores_own_email()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
begin
  if coalesce(current_setting('role', true), 'none') in ('anon', 'authenticated') then
    new.email := (select p.email from public.profiles p where p.id = new.user_id);
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;
revoke all on function public.quiz_scores_own_email() from public, anon, authenticated;

drop trigger if exists quiz_scores_own_email on public.quiz_scores;
create trigger quiz_scores_own_email
  before insert or update on public.quiz_scores
  for each row execute function public.quiz_scores_own_email();

-- ---- F15: integrity ----------------------------------------------------------
-- (a) an order is always for a positive amount
alter table public.orders drop constraint if exists orders_amount_positive;
alter table public.orders add constraint orders_amount_positive check (amount > 0) not valid;
select pg_temp.try_validate('public.orders', 'orders_amount_positive');

-- (b) the Phase 2 price-breakdown check was created NOT VALID; validate it
select pg_temp.try_validate('public.orders', 'orders_phase2_amounts');

-- (c) deleting an order must not silently delete its payment record
alter table public.payments drop constraint if exists payments_order_id_fkey;
alter table public.payments add constraint payments_order_id_fkey
  foreign key (order_id) references public.orders(id) on delete restrict not valid;
select pg_temp.try_validate('public.payments', 'payments_order_id_fkey');

-- (d) referrals.first_order_id now points at a real order
alter table public.referrals drop constraint if exists referrals_first_order_id_fkey;
alter table public.referrals add constraint referrals_first_order_id_fkey
  foreign key (first_order_id) references public.orders(id) on delete set null not valid;
select pg_temp.try_validate('public.referrals', 'referrals_first_order_id_fkey');

-- (e) payments.razorpay_payment_id had two identical unique indexes; keep the
-- constraint (payments_razorpay_payment_id_key), drop the redundant plain index.
-- ON CONFLICT (razorpay_payment_id) keeps working against the constraint.
drop index if exists public.payments_razorpay_payment_id_unique;

-- ---- F16: the wallet cannot go below zero, in the database itself ------------
create or replace function public.wallet_ledger_no_overdraw()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_bal numeric;
begin
  if new.user_id is null or new.entry_type not in ('debit', 'reversal') or new.status <> 'available' then
    return new;
  end if;
  -- same lock key as create_priced_order / settle_razorpay_payment
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || new.user_id::text, 0));
  select coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where entry_type = 'credit' and status = 'available'
                                        and (expires_at is null or expires_at > now())), 0)
       - coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where entry_type in ('debit', 'reversal') and status = 'available'), 0)
    into v_bal
    from public.wallet_ledger where user_id = new.user_id;
  if v_bal < new.amount then
    raise exception 'wallet_ledger: a % of % would overdraw the wallet (available %)', new.entry_type, new.amount, v_bal
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;
revoke all on function public.wallet_ledger_no_overdraw() from public, anon, authenticated;

drop trigger if exists wallet_ledger_03_no_overdraw on public.wallet_ledger;
create trigger wallet_ledger_03_no_overdraw
  before insert on public.wallet_ledger
  for each row execute function public.wallet_ledger_no_overdraw();

-- An admin reversal reverses what the referrer still HAS, never more, and never
-- an expired credit; a fully spent credit is refused with a clear message.
create or replace function public.admin_reverse_wallet_credit(p_ledger_id uuid, p_note text)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_row public.wallet_ledger%rowtype;
  v_avail numeric(10, 2);
  v_amt numeric(10, 2);
begin
  if not public.am_i_admin() then
    raise exception 'admin only' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  select * into v_row from public.wallet_ledger where id = p_ledger_id for update;
  if not found or v_row.entry_type <> 'credit' or v_row.status <> 'available' then
    raise exception 'Only an available credit can be reversed';
  end if;
  if v_row.user_id is null then
    raise exception 'This credit belongs to a deleted account';
  end if;
  if v_row.expires_at is not null and v_row.expires_at <= now() then
    raise exception 'This credit has already expired';
  end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.wallet_ledger where entry_type = 'reversal' and reverses_id = v_row.id) then
    raise exception 'This credit was already reversed';
  end if;

  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || v_row.user_id::text, 0));
  select available into v_avail from public.wallet_balance_of(v_row.user_id);
  v_amt := least(v_row.amount, coalesce(v_avail, 0));
  if v_amt <= 0 then
    raise exception 'Nothing left to reverse: the student has already spent this credit';
  end if;

  perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'true', true);
  insert into public.wallet_ledger (user_id, entry_type, status, amount, source, reverses_id, referral_id, note)
  values (v_row.user_id, 'reversal', 'available', v_amt, 'admin_adjustment', v_row.id, v_row.referral_id,
          left(coalesce(p_note, 'admin reversal')
               || case when v_amt < v_row.amount then ' (partial: ' || v_amt || ' of ' || v_row.amount || ' was still available)' else '' end, 500));
  perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'false', true);
end;
$$;
revoke all on function public.admin_reverse_wallet_credit(uuid, text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.admin_reverse_wallet_credit(uuid, text) to authenticated;


===== supabase/migrations/20260927100000_f7_drop_legacy_admin_policies.sql =====
-- ============================================================================
-- F7: retire the legacy e-mail based admin check.
--
-- public.is_admin() decided "admin" from the e-mail claim inside the JWT and had no
-- pinned search_path; public.am_i_admin() decides from admins.id = auth.uid() and is
-- pinned. Every legacy policy had an am_i_admin() twin EXCEPT app_settings UPDATE, so
-- that twin is created FIRST (otherwise the admin panel could no longer save settings).
-- Then the 14 legacy policies, the inline-e-mail policy on notes and the function go.
--
-- Checked before writing: no function body and no app / admin-panel / edge-function
-- code calls is_admin(); all 3 rows in admins have an id that matches their auth e-mail,
-- so nobody who is an admin today depends on the e-mail path.
-- What changes for behaviour: a signed-in user whose JWT e-mail merely EQUALS an admin's
-- e-mail (but whose id is not in admins) is no longer treated as an admin anywhere.
-- ============================================================================

-- 1. the missing twin, same rule as the legacy policy but by admin id
drop policy if exists app_settings_admin_update on public.app_settings;
create policy app_settings_admin_update on public.app_settings
  for update using (public.am_i_admin()) with check (public.am_i_admin());

-- 2. the legacy policies (each has an am_i_admin() twin: *_admin_write / *_select_own_or_admin / ...)
drop policy if exists "admin write app_settings"        on public.app_settings;
drop policy if exists "admin write chapters"            on public.chapters;
drop policy if exists "admin write notifications"       on public.notifications;
drop policy if exists "public read active notifications" on public.notifications;   -- twin notifications_public_read_active is broader (anon too)
drop policy if exists "user read own orders"            on public.orders;
drop policy if exists "admin write products"            on public.products;
drop policy if exists "admin manage profiles"           on public.profiles;
drop policy if exists "user read own profile"           on public.profiles;
drop policy if exists "user read own purchases"         on public.purchases;
drop policy if exists "user read own quiz_scores"       on public.quiz_scores;
drop policy if exists "admin write quiz_tests"          on public.quiz_tests;
drop policy if exists "admin write subjects"            on public.subjects;
drop policy if exists "admin write videos"              on public.videos;
drop policy if exists "admin write years"               on public.years;
drop policy if exists "Admin can manage notes"          on public.notes;               -- inline admins.email check; twin notes_admin_write

-- 3. drop the function only if nothing still depends on it
do $$
declare v_left text;
begin
  select string_agg(schemaname || '.' || tablename || '.' || policyname, ', ') into v_left
    from pg_policies
   where schemaname in ('public', 'storage')
     and coalesce(qual, '') || coalesce(with_check, '') ~ 'is_admin\(\)';
  if v_left is not null then
    raise exception 'F7 REFUSED: policies still use is_admin(): %. Give each an am_i_admin() twin, drop it, re-run.', v_left;
  end if;
end $$;

drop function if exists public.is_admin();


===== supabase/migrations/20260927110000_f8_revoke_excess_grants.sql =====
-- ============================================================================
-- F8: take away table privileges nothing needs.
--
-- Supabase's default privileges give anon and authenticated ALL privileges on every
-- public table; RLS then decides rows. But TRUNCATE (and REFERENCES / TRIGGER) is not
-- subject to RLS at all. PostgREST never issues TRUNCATE, so this is not reachable through
-- the API today - it is one direct-SQL / misconfiguration away from a wipe.
--
-- Revoked:  TRUNCATE, REFERENCES, TRIGGER from anon and authenticated on every public table;
--           INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE from anon (the only anonymous write the app makes is
--           pre-login analytics, granted back on analytics_events alone).
-- KEPT:     authenticated keeps INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE: the admin panel is an `authenticated`
--           session (same DB role as students), so RLS remains the only barrier on the
--           admin-managed tables - that cannot be tightened without a separate admin role.
--           service_role is untouched.
-- Future tables: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE postgres (migrations and the dashboard
--           create objects as postgres, and every public table on live is owned by postgres).
--           The same statement FOR ROLE supabase_admin needs membership of that role, which
--           `postgres` does not have on hosted Supabase (checked on live: not superuser, not a
--           member) - it is attempted, and skipped with a NOTICE if denied. What stays exposed
--           in that case: only tables CREATED BY supabase_admin (none exist in public today;
--           that role creates Supabase-internal objects), which would still get the default
--           full grants until revoked by hand.
-- ============================================================================

revoke truncate, references, trigger on all tables in schema public from anon, authenticated;
revoke insert, update, delete on all tables in schema public from anon;
grant insert on public.analytics_events to anon;          -- pre-login analytics (RLS: user_id must be null)

alter default privileges for role postgres in schema public
  revoke truncate, references, trigger on tables from anon, authenticated;
alter default privileges for role postgres in schema public
  revoke insert, update, delete on tables from anon;

do $$
begin
  alter default privileges for role supabase_admin in schema public
    revoke truncate, references, trigger on tables from anon, authenticated;
  alter default privileges for role supabase_admin in schema public
    revoke insert, update, delete on tables from anon;
exception when insufficient_privilege then
  raise notice 'F8: not allowed to change default privileges for role supabase_admin (expected on hosted Supabase). Tables created by that role, if any ever appear, keep the default grants.';
end $$;


===== supabase/migrations/20260927120000_batch3_referral_hardening.sql =====
-- ============================================================================
-- Batch 3 (deploy BEFORE referral is switched on): F5, F11, F12.
--
-- F5  a verified mobile number is required on BOTH sides
--       * to apply a code (friend AND referrer; an unverified referrer's code just
--         answers "invalid" so nobody can probe whose number is verified),
--       * and again at the moment the credit would be created (settlement).
--     referral_settings.require_verified_phone is the switch. It DEFAULTS TO FALSE
--     (decision 2026-09-21): on live 0 of 22 profiles have mobile_verified = true and
--     nothing in the repo sets it after the one-time backfill of 20260801, so with the
--     switch on nobody could apply a code. The rule is built and tested; turn it on
--     (update referral_settings set require_verified_phone = true) once a server-side
--     phone-verification flow sets profiles.mobile_verified. The anti-farming guards
--     that work WITHOUT verification are in the next migration (20260927130000).
--
-- F11 the referrals table is no longer readable by students (it exposed the other
--     party's user id, order ids and the internal reject_reason). The app uses the
--     RPCs; the admin panel reads it as an admin. get_my_referrals() (kept for
--     released builds) no longer returns the friend's user id and is not callable
--     by anon.
--
-- F12 * the per-referrer cap is enforced under a lock (two friends applying at the
--       same instant can no longer both pass), and counts only referrals that were
--       not rejected;
--     * apply_referral_code is rate-limited (10 calls per user per hour);
--     * referral codes come from the database's cryptographic generator instead
--       of random(), and are looked up by exact match (index) instead of
--       upper(referral_code), with a CHECK that stored codes are upper-case.
-- ============================================================================

create or replace function pg_temp.try_validate(p_table regclass, p_constraint text) returns void
language plpgsql as $$
begin
  execute format('alter table %s validate constraint %I', p_table, p_constraint);
exception when others then
  raise notice 'BATCH3: % on % left NOT VALID (existing rows break it): %', p_constraint, p_table, sqlerrm;
end $$;

-- ---- F5 setting ---------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.referral_settings
  add column if not exists require_verified_phone boolean not null default false;

-- ---- F5 + F12: apply_referral_code ----------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.apply_referral_code(p_code text)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_settings public.referral_settings%rowtype;
  v_referrer public.profiles%rowtype;
  v_caller public.profiles%rowtype;
  v_referral_count integer;
  v_code text;
begin
  if v_uid is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'error', 'message', 'Not authenticated.');
  end if;
  if p_code is null or length(trim(p_code)) = 0 then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'invalid_code', 'message', 'Please enter a referral code.');
  end if;
  v_code := upper(trim(p_code));

  -- 10 attempts per user per hour: enough for typos, useless for guessing codes.
  if not public.rate_limit_hit('apply-referral:' || v_uid::text, 10, 3600) then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'rate_limited', 'message', 'Too many attempts. Please try again later.');
  end if;

  select * into v_settings from public.referral_settings where id = true;
  if v_settings is null or not v_settings.enabled then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'disabled', 'message', 'Referrals are not available right now.');
  end if;

  select * into v_caller from public.profiles where id = v_uid;
  if v_caller is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'error', 'message', 'Profile not found.');
  end if;
  if v_settings.require_verified_phone and not v_caller.mobile_verified then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'phone_not_verified', 'message', 'Verify your mobile number to use a referral code.');
  end if;

  select * into v_referrer from public.profiles where referral_code = v_code;
  if v_referrer is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'invalid_code', 'message', 'That referral code was not found.');
  end if;
  if v_referrer.id = v_uid then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'self_referral', 'message', 'You cannot refer yourself.');
  end if;
  if v_referrer.blocked then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'referrer_blocked', 'message', 'That referral code is no longer active.');
  end if;
  -- An unverified referrer's code behaves exactly like an unknown one.
  if v_settings.require_verified_phone and not v_referrer.mobile_verified then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'invalid_code', 'message', 'That referral code was not found.');
  end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.referrals where referred_id = v_uid) then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'already_referred', 'message', 'A referral code has already been applied to your account.');
  end if;
  if v_caller.created_at < now() - make_interval(days => v_settings.apply_window_days) then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'too_late', 'message', 'Referral codes can only be used when you sign up.');
  end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.purchases where user_id = v_uid and status = 'success')
     or exists (select 1 from public.orders where user_id = v_uid and status = 'paid') then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'already_purchased', 'message', 'Referral codes must be applied before your first purchase.');
  end if;

  if v_settings.max_referrals_per_user is not null then
    -- One applier at a time per referrer, so the count below cannot go stale.
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('referrer:' || v_referrer.id::text, 0));
    select count(*) into v_referral_count from public.referrals
     where referrer_id = v_referrer.id and status <> 'rejected';
    if v_referral_count >= v_settings.max_referrals_per_user then
      return jsonb_build_object('status', 'referrer_limit_reached', 'message', 'That referral code has reached its usage limit.');
    end if;
  end if;

  insert into public.referrals (referrer_id, referred_id, code_used, status)
  values (v_referrer.id, v_uid, v_code, 'pending');

  return jsonb_build_object('status', 'success', 'message', 'Referral applied successfully.');
exception
  when unique_violation then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'already_referred', 'message', 'A referral code has already been applied to your account.');
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.apply_referral_code(text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.apply_referral_code(text) to authenticated;

-- ---- F12: cryptographic code generator ------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.generate_unique_referral_code(p_length integer default 7)
returns text
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  -- Uppercase, unambiguous charset: excludes 0/O, 1/I/L. 31 symbols.
  v_charset constant text := '23456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
  v_code text;
  v_attempt int := 0;
  v_byte int;
begin
  loop
    v_attempt := v_attempt + 1;
    v_code := '';
    while length(v_code) < p_length loop
      -- gen_random_uuid() is the database's cryptographic generator; byte 0 of a v4 uuid
      -- is fully random. 248 = 31 * 8, so rejecting >= 248 leaves no modulo bias.
      v_byte := get_byte(uuid_send(gen_random_uuid()), 0);
      if v_byte < 248 then
        v_code := v_code || substr(v_charset, 1 + (v_byte % 31), 1);
      end if;
    end loop;
    exit when not exists (select 1 from public.profiles where referral_code = v_code);
    if v_attempt > 30 then
      raise exception 'Could not generate a unique referral code after % attempts', v_attempt;
    end if;
  end loop;
  return v_code;
end;
$$;
revoke all on function public.generate_unique_referral_code(integer) from public, anon, authenticated;

-- stored codes are upper-case (the generator only makes upper-case), so the lookup is an exact index match
alter table public.profiles drop constraint if exists profiles_referral_code_upper;
alter table public.profiles add constraint profiles_referral_code_upper
  check (referral_code = upper(referral_code)) not valid;
select pg_temp.try_validate('public.profiles', 'profiles_referral_code_upper');

-- ---- F11: the referrals table is not a student-facing API ------------------------
drop policy if exists referrals_read_own on public.referrals;
-- (referrals_admin_write, FOR ALL am_i_admin(), still gives admins read and write)

-- Kept for released builds. No friend user id, not callable by anon.
create or replace function public.get_my_referrals()
returns table (
  id uuid, referrer_id uuid, referred_id uuid, referred_name text, code_used text,
  status text, created_at timestamptz, qualified_at timestamptz, rewarded_at timestamptz
)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  select
    r.id,
    r.referrer_id,                       -- the caller's own id
    r.id as referred_id,                 -- opaque: the friend's user id is no longer exposed
    nullif(split_part(trim(coalesce(p.name, '')), ' ', 1), '') as referred_name,
    r.code_used,
    r.status,
    r.created_at,
    r.qualified_at,
    r.rewarded_at
  from public.referrals r
  left join public.profiles p on p.id = r.referred_id
  where r.referrer_id = auth.uid()
  order by r.created_at desc;
$$;
revoke all on function public.get_my_referrals() from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.get_my_referrals() to authenticated;

-- ---- F5: settlement (referrer credit needs verified numbers) ----------------------
create or replace function public.settle_razorpay_payment(
  p_event_id text,
  p_razorpay_order_id text,
  p_razorpay_payment_id text,
  p_amount_paise bigint,
  p_paid_at timestamptz default null   -- when the customer started the payment (Razorpay payment.created_at)
)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_uid uuid;
  v_order public.orders%rowtype;
  v_product public.products%rowtype;
  v_existing_payment_order_id text;
  v_set public.referral_settings%rowtype;
  v_ref public.referrals%rowtype;
  v_balance numeric(10, 2);
  v_debit numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_stale boolean;
  v_first boolean;                 -- first settlement of this order (not a replay)
  v_debited boolean := false;
  v_discount_owner text;
  v_discount_dup boolean := false;
  v_owned_purchase text;           -- an existing successful purchase of the same product
  v_base jsonb;
begin
  if p_event_id is null or p_razorpay_order_id is null or p_razorpay_payment_id is null
    or p_amount_paise is null or p_amount_paise <= 0 then
    raise exception 'invalid Razorpay settlement parameters';
  end if;

  select user_id into v_uid from public.orders where razorpay_order_id = p_razorpay_order_id;
  if v_uid is not null then
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || v_uid::text, 0));
  end if;

  -- Row lock serialises a webhook retry with the client verification path.
  select * into v_order
  from public.orders
  where razorpay_order_id = p_razorpay_order_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Razorpay order % is not linked to an internal order', p_razorpay_order_id;
  end if;
  if round(v_order.amount * 100)::bigint <> p_amount_paise then
    raise exception 'Razorpay amount does not match order amount';
  end if;

  select order_id into v_existing_payment_order_id
  from public.payments
  where razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id;
  if found and v_existing_payment_order_id <> v_order.id then
    raise exception 'Razorpay payment is already linked to another order';
  end if;

  -- Account deleted while the payment was in flight: keep the accounting row,
  -- grant nothing, debit nothing, reward nothing (refund manually).
  if v_order.user_id is null then
    insert into public.payments (
      order_id, user_id, product_id, amount, razorpay_order_id,
      razorpay_payment_id, status, verified_at
    ) values (
      v_order.id, null, v_order.product_id, v_order.amount,
      p_razorpay_order_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'success', now()
    ) on conflict (razorpay_payment_id) do nothing;

    update public.orders
    set status = 'paid', razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id, updated_at = now()
    where id = v_order.id and status <> 'refunded';

    insert into public.razorpay_webhook_events(event_id, razorpay_payment_id, event_type)
    values (p_event_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'payment.captured')
    on conflict (event_id) do nothing;

    raise warning 'grant_razorpay_payment: payment % for order % arrived after the account was deleted; no access granted - refund manually', p_razorpay_payment_id, v_order.id;
    return;
  end if;

  select * into v_product from public.products where id = v_order.product_id;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'Order % references unknown product %', v_order.id, v_order.product_id;
  end if;

  v_first := v_order.status not in ('paid', 'refunded');

  -- ---- Friend discount is usable ONCE per referral -------------------------
  -- The first discounted order to settle claims referrals.discount_order_id; any
  -- other discounted order is a second use of the same discount. Serialised per
  -- user by the wallet advisory lock above; replays of the winner see their own
  -- id and pass. A second use is still granted (the customer paid what checkout
  -- charged) but gets no referrer credit, and is flagged below.
  if v_order.referral_discount > 0 and v_order.referral_id is not null then
    update public.referrals set discount_order_id = v_order.id
     where id = v_order.referral_id and discount_order_id is null;
    select discount_order_id into v_discount_owner from public.referrals where id = v_order.referral_id;
    v_discount_dup := found and v_discount_owner is not null and v_discount_owner <> v_order.id;
  end if;

  insert into public.payments (
    order_id, user_id, product_id, amount, razorpay_order_id,
    razorpay_payment_id, status, verified_at
  ) values (
    v_order.id, v_order.user_id, v_order.product_id, v_order.amount,
    p_razorpay_order_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'success', now()
  ) on conflict (razorpay_payment_id) do nothing;

  -- ---- Already owns this product? -----------------------------------------
  select id into v_owned_purchase from public.purchases
   where user_id = v_order.user_id and product_id = v_product.id
     and status = 'success' and order_id is distinct from v_order.id
   limit 1;

  insert into public.purchases (
    user_id, order_id, product_id, product_title, scope, chapter_id,
    subject_id, year_id, year_ids, course_id, amount, status, razorpay_order_id
  ) values (
    v_order.user_id, v_order.id, v_product.id, coalesce(v_product.title, 'Your content'),
    v_product.scope, v_product.chapter_id, v_product.subject_id, v_product.year_id,
    v_product.year_ids, v_product.course_id, v_order.amount,
    case when v_owned_purchase is null then 'success' else 'duplicate' end,
    p_razorpay_order_id
  ) on conflict (order_id) do nothing;

  update public.orders
  set status = 'paid', razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id,
      course_id = v_product.course_id, updated_at = now()
  where id = v_order.id and status <> 'refunded';

  -- ---- Stale order? -------------------------------------------------------
  -- v_order is the row as it was BEFORE this settlement flipped it to 'paid'.
  -- Replays see 'paid' and rely on the flag written the first time.
  v_stale := exists (select 1 from public.order_review_flags
                      where order_id = v_order.id and reason = 'stale_order_paid')
          or v_order.status in ('cancelled', 'failed')
          or (v_order.status = 'created' and v_order.expires_at is not null
              and coalesce(p_paid_at, now()) > v_order.expires_at);

  -- ---- Wallet debit: ALWAYS, on the first settlement, clamped ---------------
  if v_first and v_order.wallet_amount > 0
     and not exists (select 1 from public.wallet_ledger
                      where order_id = v_order.id and entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment') then
    perform public.release_due_wallet_credits(v_order.user_id);
    select available into v_balance from public.wallet_balance_of(v_order.user_id);
    v_debit := least(v_order.wallet_amount, coalesce(v_balance, 0));
    if v_debit > 0 then
      insert into public.wallet_ledger (user_id, entry_type, status, amount, source, order_id, note)
      values (v_order.user_id, 'debit', 'available', v_debit, 'order_payment', v_order.id, 'Wallet used at checkout')
      on conflict (order_id) where entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment' do nothing;
      v_debited := true;
    end if;
  end if;

  -- ---- Review flags (one per order and reason; replays add nothing) ---------
  v_base := jsonb_build_object(
    'product_id', v_product.id,
    'product_title', v_product.title,
    'amount_paid', v_order.amount,
    'list_price', v_order.list_price,
    'razorpay_order_id', p_razorpay_order_id,
    'razorpay_payment_id', p_razorpay_payment_id);

  if v_first and v_order.wallet_amount > 0 and v_debit < v_order.wallet_amount then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'wallet_shortfall', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            v_base || jsonb_build_object(
              'wallet_amount_applied', v_order.wallet_amount,
              'wallet_debited', v_debit,
              'shortfall', v_order.wallet_amount - v_debit,
              'access_granted', true,
              'recommended_action',
                format('Checkout applied Rs %s of wallet balance but only Rs %s was still available, so Rs %s of the discount was not paid for. Access was granted. Decide whether to accept it or refund payment %s in Razorpay (a full refund revokes the access).',
                       v_order.wallet_amount, v_debit, v_order.wallet_amount - v_debit, p_razorpay_payment_id)))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % wanted % wallet credit but only % was available',
      v_order.id, v_order.wallet_amount, v_debit;
  end if;

  if v_stale and (v_order.wallet_amount > 0 or v_order.referral_discount > 0) then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'stale_order_paid', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            v_base || jsonb_build_object(
              'order_status', v_order.status, 'expires_at', v_order.expires_at, 'paid_at', p_paid_at,
              'wallet_debited', (select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from public.wallet_ledger
                                  where order_id = v_order.id and entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment'),
              'access_granted', true,
              'recommended_action',
                'This payment arrived for a checkout that was already cancelled or had expired. Access was granted and the wallet amount was debited as normal. No action needed unless the amount looks wrong.'))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % was % / expired when payment % arrived; flagged for review',
      v_order.id, v_order.status, p_razorpay_payment_id;
  end if;

  if v_discount_dup then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'discount_reused', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            v_base || jsonb_build_object(
              'discount_first_order_id', v_discount_owner,
              'discount_not_owed', v_order.referral_discount,
              'order_status', v_order.status,
              'access_granted', true,
              'referrer_credited', false,
              'recommended_action',
                format('Access was granted. This student already used their one friend discount on order %s, so this order was under-charged by Rs %s (paid Rs %s instead of Rs %s). To reverse it, issue a FULL refund of payment %s in the Razorpay dashboard: the refund webhook then revokes the access and gives back any wallet amount used, and the student can buy again at full price. Do nothing to keep the sale as it is.',
                       v_discount_owner, v_order.referral_discount, v_order.amount,
                       v_order.amount + v_order.referral_discount, p_razorpay_payment_id)))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % reuses the friend discount already used by order %; access granted, no referrer credit, flagged for review',
      v_order.id, v_discount_owner;
  end if;

  if v_owned_purchase is not null then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'duplicate_purchase', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            v_base || jsonb_build_object(
              'existing_purchase_id', v_owned_purchase,
              'access_granted', false,
              'recommended_action',
                format('The student already owned "%s" and paid for it again (Rs %s). The new purchase is stored as ''duplicate'' and adds no access. Refund payment %s in the Razorpay dashboard.',
                       v_product.title, v_order.amount, p_razorpay_payment_id)))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % is a duplicate purchase of product %; flagged for refund', v_order.id, v_product.id;
  end if;

  -- ---- Referrer credit ----------------------------------------------------
  -- Only the friend's FIRST successful purchase counts, and only once.
  select * into v_ref from public.referrals where referred_id = v_order.user_id for update;
  if found and not v_discount_dup and v_ref.first_order_id is null and v_ref.status in ('pending', 'qualified')
     and v_owned_purchase is null
     and not exists (select 1 from public.purchases
                      where user_id = v_order.user_id and order_id <> v_order.id and status = 'success') then
    select * into v_set from public.referral_settings where id = true;

    -- Batch 3 / F5: no credit unless BOTH sides have a verified mobile number at the
    -- moment of the purchase (a number changed after applying the code loses its
    -- verification). The referral is consumed: this was the friend's first purchase.
    if v_set.require_verified_phone
       and not (coalesce((select mobile_verified from public.profiles where id = v_order.user_id), false)
            and coalesce((select mobile_verified from public.profiles where id = v_ref.referrer_id), false)) then
      update public.referrals
         set first_order_id = v_order.id, status = 'rejected', reject_reason = 'phone_not_verified_at_purchase'
       where id = v_ref.id;
      raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: no referrer credit for order %: a mobile number was not verified', v_order.id;
      v_ref.status := 'rejected';
    else
      update public.referrals
         set first_order_id = v_order.id, status = 'qualified', qualified_at = coalesce(qualified_at, now())
       where id = v_ref.id;
    end if;

    if v_ref.status <> 'rejected' and v_set.enabled and v_set.referrer_credit_amount > 0
       and exists (select 1 from public.profiles where id = v_ref.referrer_id and not blocked) then
      insert into public.wallet_ledger (
        user_id, entry_type, status, amount, source, referral_id, order_id,
        available_at, expires_at, note
      ) values (
        v_ref.referrer_id, 'credit', 'pending', v_set.referrer_credit_amount::numeric(10, 2),
        'referral_reward', v_ref.id, v_order.id,
        now() + make_interval(days => v_set.credit_hold_days),
        case when v_set.credit_expiry_days is null then null
             else now() + make_interval(days => v_set.credit_hold_days + v_set.credit_expiry_days) end,
        'Friend''s first purchase'
      ) on conflict (referral_id) where entry_type = 'credit' and source = 'referral_reward' do nothing;
    end if;
  end if;

  insert into public.razorpay_webhook_events(event_id, razorpay_payment_id, event_type)
  values (p_event_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'payment.captured')
  on conflict (event_id) do nothing;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.settle_razorpay_payment(text, text, text, bigint, timestamptz)
  from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.settle_razorpay_payment(text, text, text, bigint, timestamptz)
  to service_role;


===== supabase/migrations/20260927130000_batch3b_antifarming.sql =====
-- ============================================================================
-- Batch 3b: two anti-farming guards that work WITHOUT phone verification
-- (F5's verified-phone rule stays built but off: require_verified_phone = false).
--
-- 1. RETURNING CUSTOMER (deleted-and-recreated account).
--    Deleting an account deletes the profile and the purchases, so a fresh signup used
--    to look like a brand-new first-time buyer and could take the friend discount again
--    (and earn its referrer a second credit). Now every successful purchase records a
--    HASH of the buyer's normalised email and phone in first_purchase_identities, a
--    server-only table that is NOT tied to the account and survives its deletion (and a
--    refund). An account whose email OR phone hash was recorded by a DIFFERENT account:
--      * gets no friend discount at checkout (create_priced_order / quote_my_order),
--      * cannot apply a referral code ('already_purchased'),
--      * earns its referrer no credit (referral rejected: 'returning_customer').
--    Email is normalised (lower-case, +tag removed, gmail dots removed); phone is E.164.
--    Existing buyers are back-filled below.
--
--    What it means for genuinely new users:
--      * a NEW email AND a NEW phone number: unaffected;
--      * a phone number recycled by the carrier (or a family phone shared by siblings)
--        that an earlier buyer used: that person loses the ~10% first-purchase discount
--        and their referrer gets no credit. They can still buy at full price. Email
--        collisions are far rarer. An admin can lift a wrongly caught identity by deleting
--        its row in first_purchase_identities.
--      * phone is not verified today, so a farmer typing a fresh number or using a fresh
--        email is NOT caught. This stops lazy re-signup with the same identity only.
--    Privacy: the table holds one-way hashes, not the numbers. A phone number is a small
--    space, so treat the hashes as personal data (retention / privacy policy).
--
-- 2. SHARED NETWORK (device/IP signal).
