--    There is NO device identifier anywhere in the database (push_tokens is empty, analytics
--    params carry no device id). The only signal is auth.sessions.ip (GoTrue records the IP of
--    every login session; 43 of 43 sessions on live have one). When the referrer and the friend
--    have ever logged in from the same IP, the credit is held for an admin instead of being
--    released (see release_due_wallet_credits): flag reason 'referral_shared_network'.
--    Held, not denied, because shared Wi-Fi / carrier-grade NAT puts classmates on one IP,
--    and classmates are exactly who refer each other. It does not see VPNs, mobile data vs
--    home Wi-Fi, or two different phones. If auth.sessions is unavailable the signal is
--    simply absent (no hold).
--    NOTE: the admin panel has no screen for order_review_flags yet; until it does, held
--    credits are found with:  select * from order_review_flags where resolved_at is null;
-- ============================================================================

alter table public.order_review_flags drop constraint if exists order_review_flags_reason_check;
alter table public.order_review_flags add constraint order_review_flags_reason_check
  check (reason in ('stale_order_paid', 'discount_reused', 'referral_credit_unrecovered',
                    'wallet_shortfall', 'duplicate_purchase', 'referral_shared_network'));

-- ---- identity hashes ---------------------------------------------------------------
create table if not exists public.first_purchase_identities (
  identity_hash text primary key,
  kind text not null check (kind in ('email', 'phone')),
  account_id uuid not null,        -- the account that bought first; deliberately NOT a foreign key
  first_purchase_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
alter table public.first_purchase_identities enable row level security;
revoke all on public.first_purchase_identities from public, anon, authenticated;
grant all on public.first_purchase_identities to service_role;

create or replace function public.identity_hash(p_kind text, p_value text)
returns text
language plpgsql
immutable
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v text;
  v_at int;
  v_local text;
  v_dom text;
begin
  if p_value is null or btrim(p_value) = '' then return null; end if;
  if p_kind = 'phone' then
    v := public.normalize_phone(p_value);
  elsif p_kind = 'email' then
    v := lower(btrim(p_value));
    v_at := position('@' in v);
    if v_at < 2 then return null; end if;
    v_local := split_part(substr(v, 1, v_at - 1), '+', 1);     -- name+anything@ == name@
    v_dom := substr(v, v_at + 1);
    if v_dom in ('gmail.com', 'googlemail.com') then
      v_local := replace(v_local, '.', '');                    -- a.b@gmail.com == ab@gmail.com
      v_dom := 'gmail.com';
    end if;
    if v_local = '' then return null; end if;
    v := v_local || '@' || v_dom;
  else
    raise exception 'identity_hash: unknown kind %', p_kind;
  end if;
  if v is null then return null; end if;
  return encode(sha256(convert_to('ayurpulse-identity-v1|' || p_kind || '|' || v, 'UTF8')), 'hex');
end;
$$;
revoke all on function public.identity_hash(text, text) from public, anon, authenticated;

create or replace function public.record_purchase_identity(p_uid uuid)
returns void
language sql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  insert into public.first_purchase_identities (identity_hash, kind, account_id)
  select v.h, v.k, p_uid
    from public.profiles p
    cross join lateral (values ('email', public.identity_hash('email', p.email)),
                               ('phone', public.identity_hash('phone', p.phone))) v(k, h)
   where p.id = p_uid and v.h is not null
  on conflict (identity_hash) do nothing;
$$;
revoke all on function public.record_purchase_identity(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.record_purchase_identity(uuid) to service_role;

create or replace function public.has_prior_purchase_identity(p_uid uuid)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
      from public.profiles p
      join public.first_purchase_identities i
        on i.identity_hash in (public.identity_hash('email', p.email), public.identity_hash('phone', p.phone))
     where p.id = p_uid and i.account_id <> p_uid
  );
$$;
revoke all on function public.has_prior_purchase_identity(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.has_prior_purchase_identity(uuid) to service_role;

-- existing buyers (deleted accounts' purchases are already gone; nothing to recover for them)
insert into public.first_purchase_identities (identity_hash, kind, account_id, first_purchase_at)
select v.h, v.k, x.user_id, x.first_at
  from (select user_id, min(created_at) as first_at from public.purchases
         where status in ('success', 'refunded', 'chargeback', 'disputed') group by user_id) x
  join public.profiles p on p.id = x.user_id
  cross join lateral (values ('email', public.identity_hash('email', p.email)),
                             ('phone', public.identity_hash('phone', p.phone))) v(k, h)
 where v.h is not null
on conflict (identity_hash) do nothing;

-- ---- shared-network signal ---------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.accounts_share_network(p_a uuid, p_b uuid)
returns boolean
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
begin
  if p_a is null or p_b is null or p_a = p_b then return false; end if;
  return exists (select 1 from auth.sessions a join auth.sessions b on b.ip = a.ip
                  where a.user_id = p_a and b.user_id = p_b and a.ip is not null);
exception when undefined_table or undefined_column or insufficient_privilege then
  return false;   -- no signal available: never block on a signal we cannot read
end;
$$;
revoke all on function public.accounts_share_network(uuid, uuid) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.accounts_share_network(uuid, uuid) to service_role;

-- ---- the functions that use them (re-issued from their current definitions) ---------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_priced_order(p_user_id uuid, p_product_id text, p_use_wallet boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_set      public.referral_settings%rowtype;
  v_product  public.products%rowtype;
  v_ref      public.referrals%rowtype;
  v_price    numeric(10, 2);
  v_discount numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_wallet   numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_base     numeric(10, 2);
  v_cap      numeric(10, 2);
  v_balance  numeric(10, 2);
  v_final    numeric(10, 2);
  v_order_id text := gen_random_uuid()::text;
begin
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || p_user_id::text, 0));

  select * into v_product from public.products where id = p_product_id;
  if not found or not v_product.active or not (v_product.price > 0) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'product_unavailable');
  end if;
  v_price := v_product.price::numeric(10, 2);
  if v_price < 1 then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'invalid_price');
  end if;

  -- Already owns this exact product? Refuse before anything is reserved.
  if exists (select 1 from public.purchases
              where user_id = p_user_id and product_id = v_product.id and status = 'success') then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'already_owned');
  end if;

  select * into v_set from public.referral_settings where id = true;

  -- Friend discount: first purchase only, code applied at signup, program on.
  if v_set.enabled and v_set.friend_discount_percent > 0 then
    select r.* into v_ref
      from public.referrals r
      join public.profiles rp on rp.id = r.referrer_id and not rp.blocked
     where r.referred_id = p_user_id
       and r.status in ('pending', 'qualified')
       and r.first_order_id is null
       and not exists (select 1 from public.purchases pu
                        where pu.user_id = p_user_id and pu.status = 'success')
       -- a returning customer (same email / phone bought under an earlier, maybe deleted, account) is not a first-time buyer
       and not public.has_prior_purchase_identity(p_user_id);
    if found then
      v_discount := round(v_price * v_set.friend_discount_percent / 100, 2);
      if v_set.friend_discount_max is not null then
        v_discount := least(v_discount, v_set.friend_discount_max);
      end if;
      v_discount := greatest(0, least(v_discount, v_price - 1));
    end if;
  end if;

  v_base := v_price - v_discount;

  -- Wallet: notes products only, capped at wallet_max_percent of what is left
  -- after the friend discount, and never more than the available balance.
  if p_use_wallet then
    if not (v_product.product_type = any (v_set.wallet_product_types)) then
      return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'wallet_not_allowed');
    end if;
    perform public.release_due_wallet_credits(p_user_id);
    select available into v_balance from public.wallet_balance_of(p_user_id);
    v_cap := floor(v_base * v_set.wallet_max_percent) / 100;
    v_wallet := greatest(0, least(v_cap, coalesce(v_balance, 0)));
  end if;

  v_final := v_price - v_discount - v_wallet;
  if v_final < 1 then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'invalid_price');
  end if;

  -- Validation passed: only now cancel every earlier unpaid order of this user.
  update public.orders
     set status = 'cancelled', updated_at = now()
   where user_id = p_user_id and status = 'created';

  insert into public.orders (
    id, user_id, product_id, scope, chapter_id, subject_id, year_id, year_ids, course_id,
    amount, list_price, referral_discount, wallet_amount, referral_id, status, expires_at
  ) values (
    v_order_id, p_user_id, v_product.id, v_product.scope, v_product.chapter_id, v_product.subject_id,
    v_product.year_id, v_product.year_ids, v_product.course_id,
    v_final, v_price, v_discount, v_wallet,
    case when v_discount > 0 then v_ref.id end, 'created',
    now() + make_interval(mins => v_set.checkout_expiry_minutes)
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true, 'order_id', v_order_id, 'title', v_product.title,
    'list_price', v_price, 'referral_discount', v_discount,
    'wallet_amount', v_wallet, 'amount', v_final,
    'timeout_seconds', v_set.checkout_expiry_minutes * 60
  );
end;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.quote_my_order(p_product_id text, p_use_wallet boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_uid      uuid := auth.uid();
  v_set      public.referral_settings%rowtype;
  v_product  public.products%rowtype;
  v_price    numeric(10, 2);
  v_discount numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_wallet   numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_avail    numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_cap      numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_eligible boolean := false;
begin
  if v_uid is null then raise exception 'not authenticated' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  select * into v_product from public.products where id = p_product_id and active;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'product_unavailable'); end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.purchases
              where user_id = v_uid and product_id = v_product.id and status = 'success') then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'already_owned');
  end if;
  v_price := v_product.price::numeric(10, 2);
  select * into v_set from public.referral_settings where id = true;

  if v_set.enabled and v_set.friend_discount_percent > 0
     and exists (select 1 from public.referrals r
                   join public.profiles rp on rp.id = r.referrer_id and not rp.blocked
                  where r.referred_id = v_uid and r.status in ('pending', 'qualified') and r.first_order_id is null)
     and not exists (select 1 from public.purchases pu where pu.user_id = v_uid and pu.status = 'success')
     and not public.has_prior_purchase_identity(v_uid) then
    v_discount := round(v_price * v_set.friend_discount_percent / 100, 2);
    if v_set.friend_discount_max is not null then v_discount := least(v_discount, v_set.friend_discount_max); end if;
    v_discount := greatest(0, least(v_discount, v_price - 1));
  end if;

  v_eligible := v_product.product_type = any (v_set.wallet_product_types);
  if v_eligible then
    perform public.release_due_wallet_credits(v_uid);
    select available into v_avail from public.wallet_balance_of(v_uid);
    v_cap := floor((v_price - v_discount) * v_set.wallet_max_percent) / 100;
    if p_use_wallet then v_wallet := greatest(0, least(v_cap, coalesce(v_avail, 0))); end if;
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true, 'list_price', v_price, 'referral_discount', v_discount,
    'wallet_eligible', v_eligible, 'wallet_available', coalesce(v_avail, 0),
    'wallet_max_usable', least(v_cap, coalesce(v_avail, 0)),
    'wallet_amount', v_wallet, 'amount', v_price - v_discount - v_wallet
  );
end;
$function$;

create or replace function public.apply_referral_code(p_code text)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_settings public.referral_settings%rowtype;
  v_referrer public.profiles%rowtype;
  v_caller public.profiles%rowtype;
  v_referral_count integer;
  v_code text;
begin
  if v_uid is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'error', 'message', 'Not authenticated.');
  end if;
  if p_code is null or length(trim(p_code)) = 0 then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'invalid_code', 'message', 'Please enter a referral code.');
  end if;
  v_code := upper(trim(p_code));

  -- 10 attempts per user per hour: enough for typos, useless for guessing codes.
  if not public.rate_limit_hit('apply-referral:' || v_uid::text, 10, 3600) then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'rate_limited', 'message', 'Too many attempts. Please try again later.');
  end if;

  select * into v_settings from public.referral_settings where id = true;
  if v_settings is null or not v_settings.enabled then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'disabled', 'message', 'Referrals are not available right now.');
  end if;

  select * into v_caller from public.profiles where id = v_uid;
  if v_caller is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'error', 'message', 'Profile not found.');
  end if;
  if v_settings.require_verified_phone and not v_caller.mobile_verified then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'phone_not_verified', 'message', 'Verify your mobile number to use a referral code.');
  end if;

  select * into v_referrer from public.profiles where referral_code = v_code;
  if v_referrer is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'invalid_code', 'message', 'That referral code was not found.');
  end if;
  if v_referrer.id = v_uid then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'self_referral', 'message', 'You cannot refer yourself.');
  end if;
  if v_referrer.blocked then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'referrer_blocked', 'message', 'That referral code is no longer active.');
  end if;
  -- An unverified referrer's code behaves exactly like an unknown one.
  if v_settings.require_verified_phone and not v_referrer.mobile_verified then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'invalid_code', 'message', 'That referral code was not found.');
  end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.referrals where referred_id = v_uid) then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'already_referred', 'message', 'A referral code has already been applied to your account.');
  end if;
  if v_caller.created_at < now() - make_interval(days => v_settings.apply_window_days) then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'too_late', 'message', 'Referral codes can only be used when you sign up.');
  end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.purchases where user_id = v_uid and status = 'success')
     or exists (select 1 from public.orders where user_id = v_uid and status = 'paid') then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'already_purchased', 'message', 'Referral codes must be applied before your first purchase.');
  end if;

  -- same email / phone already bought under another (maybe deleted) account: not a first purchase
  if public.has_prior_purchase_identity(v_uid) then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'already_purchased', 'message', 'Referral codes must be applied before your first purchase.');
  end if;

  if v_settings.max_referrals_per_user is not null then
    -- One applier at a time per referrer, so the count below cannot go stale.
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('referrer:' || v_referrer.id::text, 0));
    select count(*) into v_referral_count from public.referrals
     where referrer_id = v_referrer.id and status <> 'rejected';
    if v_referral_count >= v_settings.max_referrals_per_user then
      return jsonb_build_object('status', 'referrer_limit_reached', 'message', 'That referral code has reached its usage limit.');
    end if;
  end if;

  insert into public.referrals (referrer_id, referred_id, code_used, status)
  values (v_referrer.id, v_uid, v_code, 'pending');

  return jsonb_build_object('status', 'success', 'message', 'Referral applied successfully.');
exception
  when unique_violation then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'already_referred', 'message', 'A referral code has already been applied to your account.');
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.settle_razorpay_payment(
  p_event_id text,
  p_razorpay_order_id text,
  p_razorpay_payment_id text,
  p_amount_paise bigint,
  p_paid_at timestamptz default null   -- when the customer started the payment (Razorpay payment.created_at)
)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_uid uuid;
  v_order public.orders%rowtype;
  v_product public.products%rowtype;
  v_existing_payment_order_id text;
  v_set public.referral_settings%rowtype;
  v_ref public.referrals%rowtype;
  v_balance numeric(10, 2);
  v_debit numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_stale boolean;
  v_first boolean;                 -- first settlement of this order (not a replay)
  v_debited boolean := false;
  v_discount_owner text;
  v_discount_dup boolean := false;
  v_owned_purchase text;           -- an existing successful purchase of the same product
  v_base jsonb;
begin
  if p_event_id is null or p_razorpay_order_id is null or p_razorpay_payment_id is null
    or p_amount_paise is null or p_amount_paise <= 0 then
    raise exception 'invalid Razorpay settlement parameters';
  end if;

  select user_id into v_uid from public.orders where razorpay_order_id = p_razorpay_order_id;
  if v_uid is not null then
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || v_uid::text, 0));
  end if;

  -- Row lock serialises a webhook retry with the client verification path.
  select * into v_order
  from public.orders
  where razorpay_order_id = p_razorpay_order_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Razorpay order % is not linked to an internal order', p_razorpay_order_id;
  end if;
  if round(v_order.amount * 100)::bigint <> p_amount_paise then
    raise exception 'Razorpay amount does not match order amount';
  end if;

  select order_id into v_existing_payment_order_id
  from public.payments
  where razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id;
  if found and v_existing_payment_order_id <> v_order.id then
    raise exception 'Razorpay payment is already linked to another order';
  end if;

  -- Account deleted while the payment was in flight: keep the accounting row,
  -- grant nothing, debit nothing, reward nothing (refund manually).
  if v_order.user_id is null then
    insert into public.payments (
      order_id, user_id, product_id, amount, razorpay_order_id,
      razorpay_payment_id, status, verified_at
    ) values (
      v_order.id, null, v_order.product_id, v_order.amount,
      p_razorpay_order_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'success', now()
    ) on conflict (razorpay_payment_id) do nothing;

    update public.orders
    set status = 'paid', razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id, updated_at = now()
    where id = v_order.id and status <> 'refunded';

    insert into public.razorpay_webhook_events(event_id, razorpay_payment_id, event_type)
    values (p_event_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'payment.captured')
    on conflict (event_id) do nothing;

    raise warning 'grant_razorpay_payment: payment % for order % arrived after the account was deleted; no access granted - refund manually', p_razorpay_payment_id, v_order.id;
    return;
  end if;

  select * into v_product from public.products where id = v_order.product_id;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'Order % references unknown product %', v_order.id, v_order.product_id;
  end if;

  v_first := v_order.status not in ('paid', 'refunded');

  -- ---- Friend discount is usable ONCE per referral -------------------------
  -- The first discounted order to settle claims referrals.discount_order_id; any
  -- other discounted order is a second use of the same discount. Serialised per
  -- user by the wallet advisory lock above; replays of the winner see their own
  -- id and pass. A second use is still granted (the customer paid what checkout
  -- charged) but gets no referrer credit, and is flagged below.
  if v_order.referral_discount > 0 and v_order.referral_id is not null then
    update public.referrals set discount_order_id = v_order.id
     where id = v_order.referral_id and discount_order_id is null;
    select discount_order_id into v_discount_owner from public.referrals where id = v_order.referral_id;
    v_discount_dup := found and v_discount_owner is not null and v_discount_owner <> v_order.id;
  end if;

  insert into public.payments (
    order_id, user_id, product_id, amount, razorpay_order_id,
    razorpay_payment_id, status, verified_at
  ) values (
    v_order.id, v_order.user_id, v_order.product_id, v_order.amount,
    p_razorpay_order_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'success', now()
  ) on conflict (razorpay_payment_id) do nothing;

  -- ---- Already owns this product? -----------------------------------------
  select id into v_owned_purchase from public.purchases
   where user_id = v_order.user_id and product_id = v_product.id
     and status = 'success' and order_id is distinct from v_order.id
   limit 1;

  insert into public.purchases (
    user_id, order_id, product_id, product_title, scope, chapter_id,
    subject_id, year_id, year_ids, course_id, amount, status, razorpay_order_id
  ) values (
    v_order.user_id, v_order.id, v_product.id, coalesce(v_product.title, 'Your content'),
    v_product.scope, v_product.chapter_id, v_product.subject_id, v_product.year_id,
    v_product.year_ids, v_product.course_id, v_order.amount,
    case when v_owned_purchase is null then 'success' else 'duplicate' end,
    p_razorpay_order_id
  ) on conflict (order_id) do nothing;

  update public.orders
  set status = 'paid', razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id,
      course_id = v_product.course_id, updated_at = now()
  where id = v_order.id and status <> 'refunded';

  -- Remember who bought (hashed email / phone) so a deleted-and-recreated account is not
  -- treated as a first-time buyer. Never removed on refund or account deletion.
  if v_owned_purchase is null then
    perform public.record_purchase_identity(v_order.user_id);
  end if;

  -- ---- Stale order? -------------------------------------------------------
  -- v_order is the row as it was BEFORE this settlement flipped it to 'paid'.
  -- Replays see 'paid' and rely on the flag written the first time.
  v_stale := exists (select 1 from public.order_review_flags
                      where order_id = v_order.id and reason = 'stale_order_paid')
          or v_order.status in ('cancelled', 'failed')
          or (v_order.status = 'created' and v_order.expires_at is not null
              and coalesce(p_paid_at, now()) > v_order.expires_at);

  -- ---- Wallet debit: ALWAYS, on the first settlement, clamped ---------------
  if v_first and v_order.wallet_amount > 0
     and not exists (select 1 from public.wallet_ledger
                      where order_id = v_order.id and entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment') then
    perform public.release_due_wallet_credits(v_order.user_id);
    select available into v_balance from public.wallet_balance_of(v_order.user_id);
    v_debit := least(v_order.wallet_amount, coalesce(v_balance, 0));
    if v_debit > 0 then
      insert into public.wallet_ledger (user_id, entry_type, status, amount, source, order_id, note)
      values (v_order.user_id, 'debit', 'available', v_debit, 'order_payment', v_order.id, 'Wallet used at checkout')
      on conflict (order_id) where entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment' do nothing;
      v_debited := true;
    end if;
  end if;

  -- ---- Review flags (one per order and reason; replays add nothing) ---------
  v_base := jsonb_build_object(
    'product_id', v_product.id,
    'product_title', v_product.title,
    'amount_paid', v_order.amount,
    'list_price', v_order.list_price,
    'razorpay_order_id', p_razorpay_order_id,
    'razorpay_payment_id', p_razorpay_payment_id);

  if v_first and v_order.wallet_amount > 0 and v_debit < v_order.wallet_amount then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'wallet_shortfall', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            v_base || jsonb_build_object(
              'wallet_amount_applied', v_order.wallet_amount,
              'wallet_debited', v_debit,
              'shortfall', v_order.wallet_amount - v_debit,
              'access_granted', true,
              'recommended_action',
                format('Checkout applied Rs %s of wallet balance but only Rs %s was still available, so Rs %s of the discount was not paid for. Access was granted. Decide whether to accept it or refund payment %s in Razorpay (a full refund revokes the access).',
                       v_order.wallet_amount, v_debit, v_order.wallet_amount - v_debit, p_razorpay_payment_id)))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % wanted % wallet credit but only % was available',
      v_order.id, v_order.wallet_amount, v_debit;
  end if;

  if v_stale and (v_order.wallet_amount > 0 or v_order.referral_discount > 0) then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'stale_order_paid', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            v_base || jsonb_build_object(
              'order_status', v_order.status, 'expires_at', v_order.expires_at, 'paid_at', p_paid_at,
              'wallet_debited', (select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from public.wallet_ledger
                                  where order_id = v_order.id and entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment'),
              'access_granted', true,
              'recommended_action',
                'This payment arrived for a checkout that was already cancelled or had expired. Access was granted and the wallet amount was debited as normal. No action needed unless the amount looks wrong.'))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % was % / expired when payment % arrived; flagged for review',
      v_order.id, v_order.status, p_razorpay_payment_id;
  end if;

  if v_discount_dup then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'discount_reused', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            v_base || jsonb_build_object(
              'discount_first_order_id', v_discount_owner,
              'discount_not_owed', v_order.referral_discount,
              'order_status', v_order.status,
              'access_granted', true,
              'referrer_credited', false,
              'recommended_action',
                format('Access was granted. This student already used their one friend discount on order %s, so this order was under-charged by Rs %s (paid Rs %s instead of Rs %s). To reverse it, issue a FULL refund of payment %s in the Razorpay dashboard: the refund webhook then revokes the access and gives back any wallet amount used, and the student can buy again at full price. Do nothing to keep the sale as it is.',
                       v_discount_owner, v_order.referral_discount, v_order.amount,
                       v_order.amount + v_order.referral_discount, p_razorpay_payment_id)))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % reuses the friend discount already used by order %; access granted, no referrer credit, flagged for review',
      v_order.id, v_discount_owner;
  end if;

  if v_owned_purchase is not null then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'duplicate_purchase', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            v_base || jsonb_build_object(
              'existing_purchase_id', v_owned_purchase,
              'access_granted', false,
              'recommended_action',
                format('The student already owned "%s" and paid for it again (Rs %s). The new purchase is stored as ''duplicate'' and adds no access. Refund payment %s in the Razorpay dashboard.',
                       v_product.title, v_order.amount, p_razorpay_payment_id)))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % is a duplicate purchase of product %; flagged for refund', v_order.id, v_product.id;
  end if;

  -- ---- Referrer credit ----------------------------------------------------
  -- Only the friend's FIRST successful purchase counts, and only once.
  select * into v_ref from public.referrals where referred_id = v_order.user_id for update;
  if found and not v_discount_dup and v_ref.first_order_id is null and v_ref.status in ('pending', 'qualified')
     and v_owned_purchase is null
     and not exists (select 1 from public.purchases
                      where user_id = v_order.user_id and order_id <> v_order.id and status = 'success') then
    select * into v_set from public.referral_settings where id = true;

    -- Batch 3 / F5: no credit unless BOTH sides have a verified mobile number at the
    -- moment of the purchase (a number changed after applying the code loses its
    -- verification). The referral is consumed: this was the friend's first purchase.
    if v_set.require_verified_phone
       and not (coalesce((select mobile_verified from public.profiles where id = v_order.user_id), false)
            and coalesce((select mobile_verified from public.profiles where id = v_ref.referrer_id), false)) then
      update public.referrals
         set first_order_id = v_order.id, status = 'rejected', reject_reason = 'phone_not_verified_at_purchase'
       where id = v_ref.id;
      raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: no referrer credit for order %: a mobile number was not verified', v_order.id;
      v_ref.status := 'rejected';
    elsif public.has_prior_purchase_identity(v_order.user_id) then
      -- Same email / phone already bought under another (maybe deleted) account.
      update public.referrals
         set first_order_id = v_order.id, status = 'rejected', reject_reason = 'returning_customer'
       where id = v_ref.id;
      raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: no referrer credit for order %: the buyer is a returning customer', v_order.id;
      v_ref.status := 'rejected';
    else
      update public.referrals
         set first_order_id = v_order.id, status = 'qualified', qualified_at = coalesce(qualified_at, now())
       where id = v_ref.id;
    end if;

    if v_ref.status <> 'rejected' and v_set.enabled and v_set.referrer_credit_amount > 0
       and exists (select 1 from public.profiles where id = v_ref.referrer_id and not blocked) then
      insert into public.wallet_ledger (
        user_id, entry_type, status, amount, source, referral_id, order_id,
        available_at, expires_at, note
      ) values (
        v_ref.referrer_id, 'credit', 'pending', v_set.referrer_credit_amount::numeric(10, 2),
        'referral_reward', v_ref.id, v_order.id,
        now() + make_interval(days => v_set.credit_hold_days),
        case when v_set.credit_expiry_days is null then null
             else now() + make_interval(days => v_set.credit_hold_days + v_set.credit_expiry_days) end,
        'Friend''s first purchase'
      ) on conflict (referral_id) where entry_type = 'credit' and source = 'referral_reward' do nothing;
    end if;
  end if;

  insert into public.razorpay_webhook_events(event_id, razorpay_payment_id, event_type)
  values (p_event_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'payment.captured')
  on conflict (event_id) do nothing;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.release_due_wallet_credits(p_user uuid default null)
returns integer
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_ids uuid[];
  n integer;
begin
  -- Called from get_my_wallet() under the student's role: tell the
  -- block_client_writes backstop this write is ours (transaction-local).
  perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'true', true);

  -- Anti-farming: a credit whose referrer and friend have logged in from the same IP address is
  -- HELD for an admin (never granted automatically, never denied automatically: classmates on the
  -- same Wi-Fi or mobile network share an IP too). One flag per friend order; once an admin resolves
  -- it (admin_resolve_order_flag) the credit releases, or they reject the referral (admin_reject_referral).
  insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
  select l.order_id, l.user_id, 'referral_shared_network', 0, 0,
         jsonb_build_object(
           'referrer_id', l.user_id, 'friend_id', o.user_id, 'credit_ledger_id', l.id, 'credit_amount', l.amount,
           'signal', 'the two accounts have logged in from the same IP address',
           'caveat', 'college / hostel Wi-Fi and mobile-carrier networks share one IP between many people, so this can be two genuine classmates',
           'recommended_action',
             'Decide whether these are two accounts of the same person. If they are NOT, resolve this flag and the credit releases on the next run. If they ARE, reject the referral (admin_reject_referral) - that cancels the credit.')
    from public.wallet_ledger l
    join public.orders o on o.id = l.order_id
   where l.entry_type = 'credit' and l.source = 'referral_reward' and l.status = 'pending'
     and l.available_at <= now() and l.user_id is not null and o.user_id is not null
     and (p_user is null or l.user_id = p_user)
     and public.accounts_share_network(l.user_id, o.user_id)
  on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;

  with due as (
    update public.wallet_ledger l
       set status = 'available'
     where l.entry_type = 'credit'
       and l.status = 'pending'
       and l.available_at <= now()
       and (p_user is null or l.user_id = p_user)
       -- a credit earned by a payment that is being disputed stays held
       and not exists (select 1 from public.purchases pu
                        where pu.order_id = l.order_id and pu.status = 'disputed')
       -- ... nor while a shared-network review is open
       and not exists (select 1 from public.order_review_flags f
                        where f.order_id = l.order_id and f.reason = 'referral_shared_network' and f.resolved_at is null)
    returning l.id, l.referral_id
  )
  select array_agg(id), count(*) into v_ids, n from due;

  update public.referrals r
     set status = 'rewarded', rewarded_at = now()
   where r.status = 'qualified'
     and exists (
       select 1 from public.wallet_ledger l
        where l.referral_id = r.id and l.source = 'referral_reward'
          and l.entry_type = 'credit' and l.status = 'available'
     );

  perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'false', true);
  return coalesce(n, 0);
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.create_priced_order(uuid, text, boolean) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.create_priced_order(uuid, text, boolean) to service_role;
revoke all on function public.quote_my_order(text, boolean) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.quote_my_order(text, boolean) to authenticated;
revoke all on function public.apply_referral_code(text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.apply_referral_code(text) to authenticated;
revoke all on function public.settle_razorpay_payment(text, text, text, bigint, timestamptz) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.settle_razorpay_payment(text, text, text, bigint, timestamptz) to service_role;
revoke all on function public.release_due_wallet_credits(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.release_due_wallet_credits(uuid) to service_role;


===== supabase/migrations/20260928100000_referral_settings_limits_and_audit.sql =====
-- ============================================================================
-- Referral settings: hard limits + audit trail.
--
--   1. One named CHECK constraint per admin-editable number, so the server
--      rejects a bad value even if the admin form is bypassed (direct API call,
--      SQL editor) and the error names the field:
--        friend_discount_percent  0-50          friend_discount_max      blank or 1-10000
--        referrer_credit_amount   0-10000       credit_hold_days         0-90
--        wallet_max_percent       1-100         apply_window_days        1-30
--        max_referrals_per_user   blank or 1-1000
--      The Phase 2 catch-all constraint is replaced: its ranges for these
--      columns were wider, and the checks it also carried (expiry, checkout
--      minutes, product types) move to referral_settings_other_ranges.
--      If the live row violates a new limit this migration FAILS (it does not
--      rewrite the admin's values) - fix the row in the admin panel first.
--
--   2. referral_settings_audit: one row per change (who, when, old and new
--      values of the columns that changed). Written by a trigger, readable by
--      admins only, never writable or editable by clients.
-- Idempotent.
-- ============================================================================
begin;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Limits
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.referral_settings drop constraint if exists referral_settings_phase2_ranges;

alter table public.referral_settings drop constraint if exists referral_settings_other_ranges;
alter table public.referral_settings
  add constraint referral_settings_other_ranges check (
        (credit_expiry_days is null or credit_expiry_days > 0)
    and checkout_expiry_minutes between 5 and 240
    and wallet_product_types <@ array['notes', 'notes_bundle', 'video', 'other']
  );

alter table public.referral_settings drop constraint if exists referral_settings_friend_discount_percent_range;
alter table public.referral_settings
  add constraint referral_settings_friend_discount_percent_range
  check (friend_discount_percent between 0 and 50);

alter table public.referral_settings drop constraint if exists referral_settings_friend_discount_max_range;
alter table public.referral_settings
  add constraint referral_settings_friend_discount_max_range
  check (friend_discount_max is null or friend_discount_max between 1 and 10000);

alter table public.referral_settings drop constraint if exists referral_settings_referrer_credit_amount_range;
alter table public.referral_settings
  add constraint referral_settings_referrer_credit_amount_range
  check (referrer_credit_amount between 0 and 10000);

alter table public.referral_settings drop constraint if exists referral_settings_credit_hold_days_range;
alter table public.referral_settings
  add constraint referral_settings_credit_hold_days_range
  check (credit_hold_days between 0 and 90);

alter table public.referral_settings drop constraint if exists referral_settings_wallet_max_percent_range;
alter table public.referral_settings
  add constraint referral_settings_wallet_max_percent_range
  check (wallet_max_percent between 1 and 100);

alter table public.referral_settings drop constraint if exists referral_settings_apply_window_days_range;
alter table public.referral_settings
  add constraint referral_settings_apply_window_days_range
  check (apply_window_days between 1 and 30);

alter table public.referral_settings drop constraint if exists referral_settings_max_referrals_per_user_range;
alter table public.referral_settings
  add constraint referral_settings_max_referrals_per_user_range
  check (max_referrals_per_user is null or max_referrals_per_user between 1 and 1000);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Audit table
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table if not exists public.referral_settings_audit (
  id               bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  changed_at       timestamptz not null default now(),
  changed_by       uuid,          -- auth.uid(); null when changed outside a user session (SQL editor, service role)
  changed_by_email text,
  old_values       jsonb not null, -- only the columns that changed
  new_values       jsonb not null
);

create index if not exists referral_settings_audit_changed_at_idx
  on public.referral_settings_audit (changed_at desc);

alter table public.referral_settings_audit enable row level security;

drop policy if exists "referral_settings_audit_admin_read" on public.referral_settings_audit;
create policy "referral_settings_audit_admin_read"
  on public.referral_settings_audit for select to authenticated
  using (public.am_i_admin());

-- Read-only for clients; rows are written by the trigger below (owner) only.
revoke all on public.referral_settings_audit from public, anon, authenticated;
grant select on public.referral_settings_audit to authenticated;
grant all on public.referral_settings_audit to service_role;

create or replace function public.log_referral_settings_change()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  v_old jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_new jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_key text;
  v_o   jsonb := to_jsonb(old) - 'updated_at';
  v_n   jsonb := to_jsonb(new) - 'updated_at';
begin
  for v_key in select jsonb_object_keys(v_n) loop
    if v_o -> v_key is distinct from v_n -> v_key then
      v_old := v_old || jsonb_build_object(v_key, v_o -> v_key);
      v_new := v_new || jsonb_build_object(v_key, v_n -> v_key);
    end if;
  end loop;

  if v_new = '{}'::jsonb then
    return new; -- nothing but updated_at changed
  end if;

  insert into public.referral_settings_audit (changed_by, changed_by_email, old_values, new_values)
  values (auth.uid(), nullif(auth.jwt() ->> 'email', ''), v_old, v_new);
  return new;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.log_referral_settings_change() from public, anon, authenticated;

drop trigger if exists referral_settings_audit_trg on public.referral_settings;
create trigger referral_settings_audit_trg
  after update on public.referral_settings
  for each row execute function public.log_referral_settings_change();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. Self-check
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
do $$
begin
  if (select count(*) from pg_constraint
       where conrelid = 'public.referral_settings'::regclass
         and conname like 'referral\_settings\_%\_range') <> 7 then
    raise exception 'REFERRAL LIMITS self-check: expected 7 range constraints';
  end if;
  if has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.referral_settings_audit', 'INSERT')
     or has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.referral_settings_audit', 'UPDATE')
     or has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.referral_settings_audit', 'DELETE')
     or has_table_privilege('anon', 'public.referral_settings_audit', 'SELECT') then
    raise exception 'REFERRAL LIMITS self-check: audit table privileges too wide';
  end if;
end;
$$;

commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20260928110000_referral_off_blocks_wallet.sql =====
-- ============================================================================
-- Referral off => the wallet cannot be spent.
--
-- When referral_settings.enabled = false, quote_my_order() and
-- create_priced_order() price the order with NO wallet even if the client sends
-- use_wallet = true (ignored, not an error): quote reports wallet_eligible =
-- false and wallet_amount = 0, and the order is created with wallet_amount = 0.
-- Existing balances are untouched (get_my_wallet still shows them, the ledger is
-- not modified); they simply cannot be spent until the program is switched on.
-- An order that was already created while the program was on keeps the wallet
-- amount it was priced with (Razorpay was asked for that exact amount).
--
-- Re-issued from the Batch 3b definitions (20260927130000) with two changed
-- lines each; it must therefore run AFTER that migration (guarded below).
-- Idempotent.
-- ============================================================================
begin;

do $$
begin
  if to_regprocedure('public.has_prior_purchase_identity(uuid)') is null then
    raise exception 'Apply 20260927130000_batch3b_antifarming.sql first: these functions are re-issued from its definitions';
  end if;
end;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_priced_order(p_user_id uuid, p_product_id text, p_use_wallet boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_set      public.referral_settings%rowtype;
  v_product  public.products%rowtype;
  v_ref      public.referrals%rowtype;
  v_price    numeric(10, 2);
  v_discount numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_wallet   numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_base     numeric(10, 2);
  v_cap      numeric(10, 2);
  v_balance  numeric(10, 2);
  v_final    numeric(10, 2);
  v_order_id text := gen_random_uuid()::text;
begin
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || p_user_id::text, 0));

  select * into v_product from public.products where id = p_product_id;
  if not found or not v_product.active or not (v_product.price > 0) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'product_unavailable');
  end if;
  v_price := v_product.price::numeric(10, 2);
  if v_price < 1 then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'invalid_price');
  end if;

  -- Already owns this exact product? Refuse before anything is reserved.
  if exists (select 1 from public.purchases
              where user_id = p_user_id and product_id = v_product.id and status = 'success') then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'already_owned');
  end if;

  select * into v_set from public.referral_settings where id = true;

  -- Friend discount: first purchase only, code applied at signup, program on.
  if v_set.enabled and v_set.friend_discount_percent > 0 then
    select r.* into v_ref
      from public.referrals r
      join public.profiles rp on rp.id = r.referrer_id and not rp.blocked
     where r.referred_id = p_user_id
       and r.status in ('pending', 'qualified')
       and r.first_order_id is null
       and not exists (select 1 from public.purchases pu
                        where pu.user_id = p_user_id and pu.status = 'success')
       -- a returning customer (same email / phone bought under an earlier, maybe deleted, account) is not a first-time buyer
       and not public.has_prior_purchase_identity(p_user_id);
    if found then
      v_discount := round(v_price * v_set.friend_discount_percent / 100, 2);
      if v_set.friend_discount_max is not null then
        v_discount := least(v_discount, v_set.friend_discount_max);
      end if;
      v_discount := greatest(0, least(v_discount, v_price - 1));
    end if;
  end if;

  v_base := v_price - v_discount;

  -- Wallet: eligible product types only (referral_settings), capped at wallet_max_percent of what is left
  -- after the friend discount, and never more than the available balance.
  -- Program off: a client-sent use_wallet is ignored (priced with no wallet), never an error.
  if p_use_wallet and v_set.enabled then
    if not (v_product.product_type = any (v_set.wallet_product_types)) then
      return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'wallet_not_allowed');
    end if;
    perform public.release_due_wallet_credits(p_user_id);
    select available into v_balance from public.wallet_balance_of(p_user_id);
    v_cap := floor(v_base * v_set.wallet_max_percent) / 100;
    v_wallet := greatest(0, least(v_cap, coalesce(v_balance, 0)));
  end if;

  v_final := v_price - v_discount - v_wallet;
  if v_final < 1 then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'invalid_price');
  end if;

  -- Validation passed: only now cancel every earlier unpaid order of this user.
  update public.orders
     set status = 'cancelled', updated_at = now()
   where user_id = p_user_id and status = 'created';

  insert into public.orders (
    id, user_id, product_id, scope, chapter_id, subject_id, year_id, year_ids, course_id,
    amount, list_price, referral_discount, wallet_amount, referral_id, status, expires_at
  ) values (
    v_order_id, p_user_id, v_product.id, v_product.scope, v_product.chapter_id, v_product.subject_id,
    v_product.year_id, v_product.year_ids, v_product.course_id,
    v_final, v_price, v_discount, v_wallet,
    case when v_discount > 0 then v_ref.id end, 'created',
    now() + make_interval(mins => v_set.checkout_expiry_minutes)
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true, 'order_id', v_order_id, 'title', v_product.title,
    'list_price', v_price, 'referral_discount', v_discount,
    'wallet_amount', v_wallet, 'amount', v_final,
    'timeout_seconds', v_set.checkout_expiry_minutes * 60
  );
end;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.quote_my_order(p_product_id text, p_use_wallet boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_uid      uuid := auth.uid();
  v_set      public.referral_settings%rowtype;
  v_product  public.products%rowtype;
  v_price    numeric(10, 2);
  v_discount numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_wallet   numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_avail    numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_cap      numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_eligible boolean := false;
begin
  if v_uid is null then raise exception 'not authenticated' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  select * into v_product from public.products where id = p_product_id and active;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'product_unavailable'); end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.purchases
              where user_id = v_uid and product_id = v_product.id and status = 'success') then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'already_owned');
  end if;
  v_price := v_product.price::numeric(10, 2);
  select * into v_set from public.referral_settings where id = true;

  if v_set.enabled and v_set.friend_discount_percent > 0
     and exists (select 1 from public.referrals r
                   join public.profiles rp on rp.id = r.referrer_id and not rp.blocked
                  where r.referred_id = v_uid and r.status in ('pending', 'qualified') and r.first_order_id is null)
     and not exists (select 1 from public.purchases pu where pu.user_id = v_uid and pu.status = 'success')
     and not public.has_prior_purchase_identity(v_uid) then
    v_discount := round(v_price * v_set.friend_discount_percent / 100, 2);
    if v_set.friend_discount_max is not null then v_discount := least(v_discount, v_set.friend_discount_max); end if;
    v_discount := greatest(0, least(v_discount, v_price - 1));
  end if;

  -- Program off: nothing is wallet-eligible, so the balance can be neither shown nor spent.
  v_eligible := v_set.enabled and v_product.product_type = any (v_set.wallet_product_types);
  if v_eligible then
    perform public.release_due_wallet_credits(v_uid);
    select available into v_avail from public.wallet_balance_of(v_uid);
    v_cap := floor((v_price - v_discount) * v_set.wallet_max_percent) / 100;
    if p_use_wallet then v_wallet := greatest(0, least(v_cap, coalesce(v_avail, 0))); end if;
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true, 'list_price', v_price, 'referral_discount', v_discount,
    'wallet_eligible', v_eligible, 'wallet_available', coalesce(v_avail, 0),
    'wallet_max_usable', least(v_cap, coalesce(v_avail, 0)),
    'wallet_amount', v_wallet, 'amount', v_price - v_discount - v_wallet
  );
end;
$function$;

revoke all on function public.create_priced_order(uuid, text, boolean) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.create_priced_order(uuid, text, boolean) to service_role;
revoke all on function public.quote_my_order(text, boolean) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.quote_my_order(text, boolean) to authenticated;

commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20260929100000_high_phone_change_rpc_and_notes_storage.sql =====
-- ============================================================================
-- HIGH-priority audit fixes (S2 phone enumeration / squatting, notes storage policy).
--
-- 1. profiles.phone can no longer be changed by a client with a plain UPDATE.
--    Before: any signed-in user could `update profiles set phone = '<someone else>'`.
--    The unique index then answered "registered / not registered" (enumeration), and
--    an unregistered number could be parked on an unverified account (squatting; the
--    phone login and password reset both trust profiles.phone_normalized).
--    Now the only client path is change_my_phone(): rate limited (5 changes or
--    attempts per user per 24 h), one generic failure for "taken", and the number is
--    marked unverified. Saving a profile with the phone UNCHANGED still works, so the
--    released app build (which sends `phone` on every Edit Profile save) keeps working.
--    Admins and server code (service_role, SECURITY DEFINER with the bypass flag) are unaffected.
--
-- 2. Storage policy notes_read_if_purchased matched objects with
--    POSITION(objects.name IN notes.pdf_url) > 0, i.e. ANY substring. It now requires
--    the object name to be the whole path (the end of pdf_url after '/', or pdf_url itself)
--    and the note to be active. Files are only ever read through get-note-url (signed URL,
--    service role); this policy is the direct-download backstop.
-- ============================================================================

create or replace function public.profiles_before_write()
 returns trigger
 language plpgsql
 security definer
 set search_path to 'public'
as $function$
declare
  v_year_course_id text;
  v_client boolean := coalesce(current_setting('role', true), 'none') in ('anon', 'authenticated');
  v_bypass boolean := coalesce(current_setting('app.allow_profile_admin_fields', true), 'false') = 'true';
  v_is_admin boolean := public.am_i_admin();
  v_protected text[] := array[
    'id', 'blocked', 'is_blocked', 'role', 'is_admin', 'is_staff', 'status',
    'email', 'email_verified', 'mobile_verified', 'referral_code', 'course_id', 'year_id',
    'created_at'
  ];
  v_old jsonb;
  v_new jsonb;
  v_col text;
begin
  if v_client and not v_bypass and not v_is_admin then
    if tg_op = 'UPDATE' then
      v_old := to_jsonb(old);
      v_new := to_jsonb(new);
      foreach v_col in array v_protected loop
        if v_new -> v_col is distinct from v_old -> v_col then
          raise exception 'Cannot modify protected profile field "%"', v_col
            using errcode = '42501';
        end if;
      end loop;
      -- The phone is only changeable through change_my_phone() (rate limited, generic
      -- errors). Compared normalised, so re-saving the same number is not a change.
      if public.normalize_phone(new.phone) is distinct from public.normalize_phone(old.phone)
         or new.phone_normalized is distinct from old.phone_normalized then
        raise exception 'Use change_my_phone() to change the phone number'
          using errcode = '42501';
      end if;
    else
      -- A client-created profile row starts unblocked and unverified.
      new.blocked := false;
      new.email_verified := false;
      new.mobile_verified := false;
    end if;
  end if;

  -- Self-heal: if year_id no longer belongs to course_id, clear it.
  if new.year_id is not null then
    select course_id into v_year_course_id from public.years where id = new.year_id;
    if v_year_course_id is null or v_year_course_id is distinct from new.course_id then
      new.year_id := null;
    end if;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$;

create or replace function public.change_my_phone(p_phone text)
 returns jsonb
 language plpgsql
 security definer
 set search_path to 'public'
as $function$
declare
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_norm text;
begin
  if v_uid is null then
    raise exception 'Not authenticated' using errcode = '28000';
  end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.profiles where id = v_uid and coalesce(blocked, false)) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'unavailable');
  end if;

  -- Every call counts, successful or not: this is what bounds number probing.
  if not public.rate_limit_hit('phone-change:' || v_uid::text, 5, 86400) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'rate_limited');
  end if;

  if p_phone is null or btrim(p_phone) = '' then
    v_norm := null;                       -- clearing the number is allowed
  else
    v_norm := public.normalize_phone(p_phone);
    if v_norm is null then
      return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'invalid');
    end if;
  end if;

  perform set_config('app.allow_profile_admin_fields', 'true', true);
  begin
    update public.profiles
       set phone = v_norm,
           mobile_verified = false,
           updated_at = now()
     where id = v_uid
       and phone_normalized is distinct from v_norm;
  exception when unique_violation then
    perform set_config('app.allow_profile_admin_fields', 'false', true);
    -- Same answer as any other refusal: does not reveal that the number is registered.
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'unavailable');
  end;
  perform set_config('app.allow_profile_admin_fields', 'false', true);

  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true);
end;
$function$;

revoke all on function public.change_my_phone(text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.change_my_phone(text) to authenticated;

-- Storage: exact-path match, active notes only.
drop policy if exists notes_read_if_purchased on storage.objects;
create policy notes_read_if_purchased on storage.objects
  for select
  using (
    bucket_id = 'notes'
    and (
      public.am_i_admin()
      or exists (
        select 1
        from public.notes n
        where n.active
          and (n.pdf_url = objects.name
               or right(n.pdf_url, length(objects.name) + 1) = '/' || objects.name)
          and public.user_owns_chapter(n.chapter_id)
      )
    )
  );


===== supabase/migrations/20260930100000_medium_db_hardening.sql =====
-- ============================================================================
-- MEDIUM-priority audit fixes (database side).
--   1. function search_path pinned on the 5 functions the linter flagged
--   2. EXECUTE removed from anon (and, for trigger functions, from everyone) where no
--      client path needs it (Supabase advisor: *_security_definer_function_executable)
--   3. RLS policies re-written with (select auth.uid()) so it is evaluated once per query
--   4. exact-duplicate permissive policies dropped (same rows, evaluated twice)
--   5. indexes on foreign keys that had none
--   6. abuse limits on client-writable tables: quiz_scores, analytics_events, push_tokens
--   7. register_push_token(): a device token moves to whoever is signed in on that device
--   8. groundwork for phone verification: when Supabase Auth confirms a phone (SMS OTP,
--      once a provider is configured), profiles.mobile_verified is set by the server
-- ============================================================================

-- 1. search_path -------------------------------------------------------------------------
alter function public.normalize_phone(text)          set search_path = public, pg_temp;
alter function public.app_config_touch_updated_at()  set search_path = public, pg_temp;
alter function public.orders_immutable_columns()     set search_path = public, pg_temp;
alter function public.wallet_ledger_append_only()    set search_path = public, pg_temp;
alter function public.wallet_ledger_no_truncate()    set search_path = public, pg_temp;

-- 2. EXECUTE ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Trigger / event-trigger functions are never called through the API and do not need
-- EXECUTE to fire (the privilege is only checked when the trigger is created).
do $$
declare r record;
begin
  for r in
    select p.oid::regprocedure as sig
    from pg_proc p
    where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace
      and p.prorettype in ('trigger'::regtype, 'event_trigger'::regtype)
  loop
    execute format('revoke execute on function %s from public, anon, authenticated', r.sig);
  end loop;
end $$;

-- RPCs that need a signed-in user: anon gets nothing.
revoke execute on function public.set_my_course_year(text, text) from public, anon;
revoke execute on function public.my_course_id() from public, anon;
revoke execute on function public.my_year_id() from public, anon;
revoke execute on function public.has_content_access(text, text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.set_my_course_year(text, text) to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.my_course_id() to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.my_year_id() to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.has_content_access(text, text) to authenticated;
-- am_i_admin() and user_owns_chapter() stay executable by anon on purpose: RLS policies that
-- apply to the public role call them, and a permission error there would break anon reads.

-- 3. auth.uid() -> (select auth.uid()) ----------------------------------------------------
do $$
declare r record; v_q text; v_w text;
begin
  for r in
    select schemaname, tablename, policyname, qual, with_check
    from pg_policies
    where schemaname = 'public'
      and (coalesce(qual, '') ~ 'auth\.uid\(\)' or coalesce(with_check, '') ~ 'auth\.uid\(\)')
      and (coalesce(qual, '') || coalesce(with_check, '')) !~* 'select auth\.uid\(\)'
  loop
    v_q := regexp_replace(r.qual,       'auth\.uid\(\)', '(select auth.uid())', 'g');
    v_w := regexp_replace(r.with_check, 'auth\.uid\(\)', '(select auth.uid())', 'g');
    if r.qual is not null and r.with_check is not null then
      execute format('alter policy %I on %I.%I using (%s) with check (%s)', r.policyname, r.schemaname, r.tablename, v_q, v_w);
    elsif r.qual is not null then
      execute format('alter policy %I on %I.%I using (%s)', r.policyname, r.schemaname, r.tablename, v_q);
    else
      execute format('alter policy %I on %I.%I with check (%s)', r.policyname, r.schemaname, r.tablename, v_w);
    end if;
  end loop;
end $$;

-- 4. duplicate policies (each is fully covered by the policy kept) ----------------------------
drop policy if exists "Admins can view all orders"     on public.orders;     -- orders_select_own_or_admin
drop policy if exists "Users can view own orders"      on public.orders;
drop policy if exists "Admins can view all payments"   on public.payments;   -- payments_admin_read
drop policy if exists "Admins can view all purchases"  on public.purchases;  -- purchases_select_own_or_admin
drop policy if exists "Users can view own purchases"   on public.purchases;
drop policy if exists "Users manage their own push tokens" on public.push_tokens; -- push_tokens_own
drop policy if exists "user write own quiz_scores"     on public.quiz_scores; -- quiz_scores_own_or_admin

-- 5. foreign-key indexes ---------------------------------------------------------------------
do $$
declare r record;
begin
  for r in
    select c.conrelid::regclass as tbl, a.attname as col, c.conrelid::regclass::text as tname
    from pg_constraint c
    join pg_attribute a on a.attrelid = c.conrelid and a.attnum = c.conkey[1]
    where c.contype = 'f' and c.connamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and array_length(c.conkey, 1) = 1
      and not exists (select 1 from pg_index i where i.indrelid = c.conrelid and i.indkey[0] = c.conkey[1])
  loop
    execute format('create index if not exists %I on %s (%I)', 'idx_' || replace(r.tname, 'public.', '') || '_' || r.col, r.tbl, r.col);
  end loop;
end $$;

-- 6. abuse limits on client-writable tables ---------------------------------------------------
-- quiz_scores: a student can save scores, not flood the table.
create or replace function public.quiz_scores_rate_limit()
returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
begin
  if coalesce(current_setting('role', true), 'none') in ('anon', 'authenticated')
     and not public.rate_limit_hit('quiz-score:' || new.user_id::text, 120, 3600) then
    raise exception 'Too many quiz results saved recently. Please try again later.' using errcode = '54000';
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;
drop trigger if exists quiz_scores_rate_limit on public.quiz_scores;
create trigger quiz_scores_rate_limit before insert on public.quiz_scores
  for each row execute function public.quiz_scores_rate_limit();

-- analytics_events: excess events are dropped silently (analytics must never break the app).
-- Signed-in: 600 per user per hour. Anonymous: 300 per minute across all anonymous clients.
create or replace function public.analytics_events_rate_limit()
returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
begin
  if coalesce(current_setting('role', true), 'none') in ('anon', 'authenticated') then
    if new.user_id is null then
      if not public.rate_limit_hit('analytics-anon', 300, 60) then return null; end if;
    elsif not public.rate_limit_hit('analytics-user:' || new.user_id::text, 600, 3600) then
      return null;
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;
drop trigger if exists analytics_events_rate_limit on public.analytics_events;
create trigger analytics_events_rate_limit before insert on public.analytics_events
  for each row execute function public.analytics_events_rate_limit();

-- push_tokens: only real Expo tokens, at most 10 devices per user.
alter table public.push_tokens drop constraint if exists push_tokens_token_format;
alter table public.push_tokens add constraint push_tokens_token_format
  check (expo_push_token ~ '^Expo(nent)?PushToken\[[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\]$');

create or replace function public.push_tokens_cap()
returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
begin
  if coalesce(current_setting('role', true), 'none') in ('anon', 'authenticated')
     and not exists (select 1 from public.push_tokens where expo_push_token = new.expo_push_token)
     and (select count(*) from public.push_tokens where user_id = new.user_id) >= 10 then
    raise exception 'Too many registered devices.' using errcode = '54000';
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;
drop trigger if exists push_tokens_cap on public.push_tokens;
create trigger push_tokens_cap before insert on public.push_tokens
  for each row execute function public.push_tokens_cap();

-- the trigger functions created in this migration follow the same rule
revoke all on function public.quiz_scores_rate_limit()      from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all on function public.analytics_events_rate_limit() from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all on function public.push_tokens_cap()             from public, anon, authenticated;

-- 7. register_push_token ------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A plain upsert cannot take over a token row that belongs to the previous user of a shared
-- device (RLS hides it), so the new user never got pushes and the old one kept getting them.
create or replace function public.register_push_token(p_token text, p_platform text)
returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  if v_uid is null then raise exception 'Not authenticated' using errcode = '28000'; end if;
  if p_token is null or p_token !~ '^Expo(nent)?PushToken\[[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\]$' then
    raise exception 'Invalid push token' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  if p_platform is null or p_platform not in ('ios', 'android', 'web') then
    raise exception 'Invalid platform' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  if not public.rate_limit_hit('push-register:' || v_uid::text, 30, 3600) then
    raise exception 'Too many requests' using errcode = '54000';
  end if;

  insert into public.push_tokens (user_id, expo_push_token, platform, updated_at)
  values (v_uid, p_token, p_platform, now())
  on conflict (expo_push_token) do update
    set user_id = excluded.user_id, platform = excluded.platform, updated_at = now();

  -- keep only this user's 10 most recent devices
  delete from public.push_tokens
  where user_id = v_uid
    and id not in (select id from public.push_tokens where user_id = v_uid order by updated_at desc limit 10);
end $$;
revoke all on function public.register_push_token(text, text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.register_push_token(text, text) to authenticated;

-- 8. phone verification groundwork ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- Inert until an SMS provider is enabled in Supabase Auth and the app starts a phone OTP flow
-- (auth.updateUser({phone}) then auth.verifyOtp). When Auth confirms a phone number this marks
-- that number as the profile's verified number. Nothing on the client can set mobile_verified.
create or replace function public.sync_profile_mobile_verified()
returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare v_norm text;
begin
  if new.phone_confirmed_at is null or coalesce(new.phone, '') = '' then return new; end if;
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' and old.phone_confirmed_at is not distinct from new.phone_confirmed_at
     and old.phone is not distinct from new.phone then
    return new;
  end if;
  v_norm := public.normalize_phone('+' || ltrim(new.phone, '+'));
  if v_norm is null then return new; end if;
  perform set_config('app.allow_profile_admin_fields', 'true', true);
  begin
    update public.profiles set phone = v_norm, mobile_verified = true, updated_at = now() where id = new.id;
  exception when unique_violation then
    null;   -- that number already belongs to another profile: leave this one unverified
  end;
  perform set_config('app.allow_profile_admin_fields', 'false', true);
  return new;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.sync_profile_mobile_verified() from public, anon, authenticated;
drop trigger if exists on_auth_user_phone_confirmed on auth.users;
create trigger on_auth_user_phone_confirmed
  after update of phone, phone_confirmed_at on auth.users
  for each row execute function public.sync_profile_mobile_verified();


===== supabase/migrations/20260930110000_low_grants_tightening.sql =====
-- ============================================================================
-- LOW-priority audit fix (S7): table privileges nothing needs.
--
-- RLS is the only row-level barrier, and the admin panel is an `authenticated` session (same DB
-- role as students), so tables the admin panel edits keep their grants. What is removed here are
-- privileges NO client uses (checked against the admin panel, the mobile app and the released
-- build's write paths): those tables are written only by SECURITY DEFINER functions or the
-- service role, so a future policy mistake there can no longer become a client write.
--
--   authenticated: admins (all writes), referrals (all writes), analytics_events UPDATE/DELETE, profiles INSERT/DELETE (rows are created by the
--                  signup trigger and removed by erase_user_data), referral_settings INSERT/DELETE
--                  (a single row that is only ever updated).
--   anon:          SELECT on everything except the four tables the app reads before login.
--
-- KEPT on purpose: notifications writes (admin RLS policy exists for the admin panel), quiz_scores UPDATE (the offline sync engine writes with upsert), push_tokens
-- INSERT/UPDATE (released builds upsert directly), analytics_events INSERT for anon.
-- ============================================================================

revoke insert, update, delete on public.admins        from authenticated;
revoke insert, update, delete on public.referrals     from authenticated;
revoke update, delete         on public.analytics_events from authenticated;
revoke insert, delete         on public.profiles       from authenticated;
revoke insert, delete         on public.referral_settings from authenticated;

do $$
declare r record;
begin
  for r in
    select c.oid::regclass as tbl
    from pg_class c
    where c.relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and c.relkind in ('r', 'p')
      and c.relname not in ('courses', 'years', 'notifications', 'app_config')
      and has_table_privilege('anon', c.oid, 'select')
  loop
    execute format('revoke select on %s from anon', r.tbl);
  end loop;
end $$;

-- The notes storage policy applied to the public role, so its `notes` sub-select ran as anon, which
-- no longer has SELECT on that table ("permission denied" instead of "no rows", which would also
-- break anonymous listing of the public thumbnails bucket). Anonymous users never own a purchase,
-- so the policy is simply limited to signed-in users; the result for everyone is unchanged.
drop policy if exists notes_read_if_purchased on storage.objects;
create policy notes_read_if_purchased on storage.objects
  for select to authenticated
  using (
    bucket_id = 'notes'
    and (
      public.am_i_admin()
      or exists (
        select 1
        from public.notes n
        where n.active
          and (n.pdf_url = objects.name
               or right(n.pdf_url, length(objects.name) + 1) = '/' || objects.name)
          and public.user_owns_chapter(n.chapter_id)
      )
    )
  );


===== supabase/migrations/20261001100000_admin_mfa_aal2.sql =====
-- Admin MFA (AAL2) — switchable, so enabling it can never lock the admins out by accident.
--
-- am_i_admin() is the single gate behind every admin RLS policy and RPC. It now also requires
-- the session to be AAL2 (the JWT `aal` claim, set by Supabase Auth after a TOTP challenge)
-- WHEN public.admin_settings.require_mfa is true. The flag ships FALSE, so applying this
-- migration changes nothing until the owner has enrolled every admin and flips it with
-- public.set_admin_mfa_required(true), which itself refuses while any admin lacks a verified factor.
--
-- Manual sequence: docs/security/ADMIN_MFA.md.

create table if not exists public.admin_settings (
  id          boolean primary key default true check (id),      -- single row
  require_mfa boolean not null default false,
  updated_at  timestamptz not null default now()
);
insert into public.admin_settings (id, require_mfa) values (true, false) on conflict do nothing;
alter table public.admin_settings enable row level security;      -- no policies: no client access
revoke all on public.admin_settings from public, anon, authenticated;

create or replace function public.admin_mfa_required()
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path to 'public' as $$
  select coalesce((select require_mfa from public.admin_settings where id), false)
$$;
revoke all on function public.admin_mfa_required() from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.admin_mfa_required() to service_role;

create or replace function public.am_i_admin()
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path to 'public' as $$
  select exists (select 1 from public.admins where id = auth.uid())
     and (not public.admin_mfa_required() or coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'aal', '') = 'aal2')
$$;

-- "Is this account an admin, regardless of MFA?" Lets the admin panel tell "not an admin" apart
-- from "admin who still has to complete MFA". Reveals nothing beyond the caller's own status.
create or replace function public.is_admin_account()
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path to 'public' as $$
  select exists (select 1 from public.admins where id = auth.uid())
$$;
revoke all on function public.is_admin_account() from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.is_admin_account() to authenticated, service_role;

-- Owner-only switch (run from the SQL editor / `supabase db query`; not callable by any API role).
create or replace function public.set_admin_mfa_required(p_required boolean)
returns text language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public' as $$
declare missing text;
begin
  if p_required then
    select string_agg(a.email, ', ') into missing
      from public.admins a
     where not exists (select 1 from auth.mfa_factors f
                        where f.user_id = a.id and f.status = 'verified');
    if missing is not null then
      raise exception 'Refusing to require MFA: these admins have no verified factor yet: %', missing;
    end if;
  end if;
  update public.admin_settings set require_mfa = p_required, updated_at = now() where id;
  return case when p_required then 'admin MFA is now REQUIRED' else 'admin MFA requirement is OFF' end;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.set_admin_mfa_required(boolean) from public, anon, authenticated;


===== supabase/migrations/20261012100000_google_play_ucb.sql =====
-- India User Choice Billing. No price tiers are seeded: each live INR price must
-- be checked against a matching active Play Console item before it is enabled.
begin;

create table if not exists public.play_price_tiers (
  price_inr numeric(10,2) primary key check (price_inr > 0),
  play_sku text not null unique check (play_sku ~ '^notes_[0-9]+$'),
  active boolean not null default false,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
alter table public.play_price_tiers enable row level security;
revoke all on public.play_price_tiers from public, anon, authenticated;
grant all on public.play_price_tiers to service_role;

alter table public.orders
  add column if not exists provider text not null default 'razorpay',
  add column if not exists play_sku text,
  add column if not exists purchase_token text,
  add column if not exists play_consumption_status text,
  add column if not exists external_transaction_token text,
  add column if not exists external_choice_bound_order_id text,
  add column if not exists external_transaction_id text,
  add column if not exists external_report_status text,
  add column if not exists external_reported_at timestamptz,
  add column if not exists external_report_error text,
