  add column if not exists external_report_attempts integer not null default 0,
  add column if not exists external_report_attempted_at timestamptz,
  add column if not exists external_refund_status text,
  add column if not exists external_refund_at timestamptz,
  add column if not exists external_refund_error text,
  add column if not exists external_refund_attempts integer not null default 0,
  add column if not exists external_refund_attempted_at timestamptz,
  add column if not exists tax_pre_amount numeric(10,2),
  add column if not exists tax_amount numeric(10,2),
  add column if not exists gst_rate_percent numeric(6,2),
  add column if not exists tax_region_code text,
  add column if not exists tax_administrative_area text,
  add column if not exists payment_completed_at timestamptz;

-- Public, non-secret tax configuration. Zero GST is the current business
-- configuration; changing it requires a reviewed tax calculation first.
insert into public.app_config(key,value) values ('gst_rate_percent','0') on conflict(key) do nothing;
insert into public.app_config(key,value) values ('require_ucb_for_razorpay','false') on conflict(key) do nothing;
-- `seller_state` intentionally has no default; it must be configured explicitly.

create or replace function public.orders_snapshot_tax()
returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_rate_text text; v_rate numeric(6,2);
begin
  select value into v_rate_text from public.app_config where key='gst_rate_percent';
  if v_rate_text is null or v_rate_text !~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]{1,2})?$' then
    raise exception 'GST rate configuration unavailable';
  end if;
  v_rate:=v_rate_text::numeric;
  if v_rate<0 or v_rate>100 then raise exception 'GST rate out of range'; end if;
  new.gst_rate_percent:=v_rate;
  new.tax_pre_amount:=round(new.amount/(1+v_rate/100),2);
  new.tax_amount:=new.amount-new.tax_pre_amount;
  return new;
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.orders_snapshot_tax() from public,anon,authenticated;
drop trigger if exists orders_02_tax_snapshot on public.orders;
create trigger orders_02_tax_snapshot before insert on public.orders
  for each row execute function public.orders_snapshot_tax();

alter table public.orders drop constraint if exists orders_ucb_provider_check;
alter table public.orders add constraint orders_ucb_provider_check
  check (provider in ('razorpay','play'));
alter table public.orders drop constraint if exists orders_ucb_choice_check;
alter table public.orders add constraint orders_ucb_choice_check
  check (provider <> 'play' or (play_sku is not null and razorpay_order_id is null));
alter table public.orders drop constraint if exists orders_ucb_report_check;
alter table public.orders add constraint orders_ucb_report_check
  check (external_report_status is null or external_report_status in ('pending','failed','reported'));
alter table public.orders drop constraint if exists orders_ucb_consumption_check;
alter table public.orders add constraint orders_ucb_consumption_check
  check (play_consumption_status is null or play_consumption_status in ('pending','failed','consumed'));
create unique index if not exists orders_play_purchase_token_unique on public.orders(purchase_token) where purchase_token is not null;
create unique index if not exists orders_external_token_unique on public.orders(external_transaction_token) where external_transaction_token is not null;
create unique index if not exists orders_external_id_unique on public.orders(external_transaction_id) where external_transaction_id is not null;

alter table public.payments
  add column if not exists provider text not null default 'razorpay',
  add column if not exists purchase_token text,
  add column if not exists play_sku text;
alter table public.payments alter column razorpay_order_id drop not null;
alter table public.payments alter column razorpay_payment_id drop not null;
alter table public.payments drop constraint if exists payments_ucb_provider_check;
alter table public.payments add constraint payments_ucb_provider_check check (
  (provider = 'razorpay' and razorpay_order_id is not null and razorpay_payment_id is not null and purchase_token is null)
  or (provider = 'play' and razorpay_order_id is null and razorpay_payment_id is null and purchase_token is not null and play_sku is not null)
);
create unique index if not exists payments_play_purchase_token_unique on public.payments(purchase_token) where purchase_token is not null;

-- Preserve all existing immutability guarantees and add billing identity fields.
create or replace function public.orders_immutable_columns()
returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path=public as $$
begin
  if new.amount is distinct from old.amount then raise exception 'orders.amount is immutable' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  if old.razorpay_order_id is not null and new.razorpay_order_id is distinct from old.razorpay_order_id then raise exception 'orders.razorpay_order_id is immutable' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  if new.user_id is distinct from old.user_id and new.user_id is not null then raise exception 'orders.user_id is immutable' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  if new.product_id is distinct from old.product_id and new.product_id is not null then raise exception 'orders.product_id is immutable' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  if new.list_price is distinct from old.list_price or new.referral_discount is distinct from old.referral_discount or new.wallet_amount is distinct from old.wallet_amount then raise exception 'orders price breakdown is immutable' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  if new.referral_id is distinct from old.referral_id and new.referral_id is not null then raise exception 'orders.referral_id is immutable' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  if new.expires_at is distinct from old.expires_at then raise exception 'orders.expires_at is immutable' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  if new.provider is distinct from old.provider or (old.play_sku is not null and new.play_sku is distinct from old.play_sku) then raise exception 'orders provider/SKU is immutable' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  if old.purchase_token is not null and new.purchase_token is distinct from old.purchase_token then raise exception 'orders.purchase_token is immutable' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  if old.external_transaction_id is not null and new.external_transaction_id is distinct from old.external_transaction_id then raise exception 'orders.external_transaction_id is immutable' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  if new.gst_rate_percent is distinct from old.gst_rate_percent or new.tax_pre_amount is distinct from old.tax_pre_amount
     or new.tax_amount is distinct from old.tax_amount then raise exception 'orders tax snapshot is immutable' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  if (old.tax_region_code is not null and new.tax_region_code is distinct from old.tax_region_code)
     or (old.tax_administrative_area is not null and new.tax_administrative_area is distinct from old.tax_administrative_area)
     then raise exception 'orders buyer tax address is immutable' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  if old.external_choice_bound_order_id is not null and new.external_choice_bound_order_id is distinct from old.external_choice_bound_order_id then raise exception 'orders.external_choice_bound_order_id is immutable' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  -- Token may move exactly once from a cancelled choice order to its Razorpay order.
  if old.external_transaction_token is not null and new.external_transaction_token is distinct from old.external_transaction_token
     and not (old.provider = 'play' and new.external_transaction_token is null and old.status = 'cancelled') then
    raise exception 'orders.external_transaction_token is immutable' using errcode='42501';
  end if;
  return new;
end; $$;

create or replace function public.create_play_order(p_user_id uuid, p_product_id text)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare v_product public.products%rowtype; v_profile public.profiles%rowtype;
  v_sku text; v_order_id text := gen_random_uuid()::text; v_minutes integer;
begin
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || p_user_id::text, 0));
  select * into v_profile from public.profiles where id=p_user_id;
  if not found or v_profile.blocked then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','account_unavailable'); end if;
  select * into v_product from public.products where id=p_product_id and active;
  if not found or v_product.course_id is distinct from v_profile.course_id then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','product_unavailable'); end if;
  if exists(select 1 from public.purchases where user_id=p_user_id and product_id=p_product_id and status='success') then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','already_owned'); end if;
  select play_sku into v_sku from public.play_price_tiers where price_inr=v_product.price and active;
  if v_sku is null then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','price_tier_missing'); end if;
  select checkout_expiry_minutes into v_minutes from public.referral_settings where id=true;
  update public.orders set status='cancelled',updated_at=now() where user_id=p_user_id and status='created' and provider='play' and purchase_token is null;
  insert into public.orders(id,user_id,product_id,scope,chapter_id,subject_id,year_id,year_ids,course_id,
    amount,list_price,provider,play_sku,status,expires_at)
  values(v_order_id,p_user_id,p_product_id,v_product.scope,v_product.chapter_id,v_product.subject_id,v_product.year_id,
    v_product.year_ids,v_product.course_id,v_product.price,v_product.price,'play',v_sku,'created',now()+make_interval(mins=>coalesce(v_minutes,30)));
  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'order_id',v_order_id,'play_sku',v_sku);
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.create_play_order(uuid,text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.create_play_order(uuid,text) to service_role;

create or replace function public.attach_ucb_external_token(p_user_id uuid,p_order_id text,p_token text)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_order public.orders%rowtype;
begin
  if p_token is null or length(p_token) < 10 or length(p_token)>4096 then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','invalid_token'); end if;
  select * into v_order from public.orders where id=p_order_id for update;
  if not found or v_order.user_id is distinct from p_user_id or v_order.provider<>'play' or v_order.status<>'created'
     or v_order.purchase_token is not null or (v_order.expires_at is not null and v_order.expires_at<now()) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','order_unavailable');
  end if;
  if v_order.external_transaction_token is not null and v_order.external_transaction_token<>p_token then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','token_already_attached');
  end if;
  update public.orders set external_transaction_token=p_token where id=p_order_id and external_transaction_token is null;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true);
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.attach_ucb_external_token(uuid,text,text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.attach_ucb_external_token(uuid,text,text) to service_role;

create or replace function public.bind_ucb_razorpay_order(p_user_id uuid,p_choice_id text,p_razorpay_id text,p_buyer_state text)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_choice public.orders%rowtype; v_paid public.orders%rowtype;
begin
  if p_buyer_state is null or not (p_buyer_state = any(array[
    'ANDAMAN AND NICOBAR ISLANDS','ANDHRA PRADESH','ARUNACHAL PRADESH','ASSAM','BIHAR','CHANDIGARH',
    'CHHATTISGARH','DADRA AND NAGAR HAVELI','DADRA AND NAGAR HAVELI AND DAMAN AND DIU',
    'DAMAN AND DIU','DELHI','GOA','GUJARAT','HARYANA','HIMACHAL PRADESH','JAMMU AND KASHMIR',
    'JHARKHAND','KARNATAKA','KERALA','LADAKH','LAKSHADWEEP','MADHYA PRADESH','MAHARASHTRA',
    'MANIPUR','MEGHALAYA','MIZORAM','NAGALAND','ODISHA','PUDUCHERRY','PUNJAB','RAJASTHAN',
    'SIKKIM','TAMIL NADU','TELANGANA','TRIPURA','UTTAR PRADESH','UTTARAKHAND','WEST BENGAL'])) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','buyer_state_invalid');
  end if;
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || p_user_id::text, 0));
  select * into v_choice from public.orders where id=p_choice_id for update;
  select * into v_paid from public.orders where razorpay_order_id=p_razorpay_id for update;
  if v_choice.id is null or v_paid.id is null or v_choice.user_id is distinct from p_user_id
     or v_paid.user_id is distinct from p_user_id or v_choice.product_id is distinct from v_paid.product_id
     or v_choice.provider<>'play' or v_paid.provider<>'razorpay' or v_choice.status<>'cancelled'
     or v_paid.status<>'created' or v_choice.external_transaction_token is null
     or v_choice.purchase_token is not null or v_choice.play_sku is null
     or v_paid.external_transaction_token is not null then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','ucb_binding_failed');
  end if;
  if v_paid.tax_pre_amount is null or v_paid.tax_amount is null or v_paid.gst_rate_percent is null
     or v_paid.tax_pre_amount+v_paid.tax_amount<>v_paid.amount then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','tax_snapshot_missing');
  end if;
  update public.orders set external_transaction_token=null,external_choice_bound_order_id=v_paid.id where id=v_choice.id;
  update public.orders set external_transaction_token=v_choice.external_transaction_token,
    external_transaction_id='medveda_' || replace(v_paid.id,'-',''),
    external_report_status='pending',play_sku=v_choice.play_sku,
    tax_region_code='IN',tax_administrative_area=p_buyer_state where id=v_paid.id;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'order_id',v_paid.id);
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.bind_ucb_razorpay_order(uuid,text,text,text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.bind_ucb_razorpay_order(uuid,text,text,text) to service_role;

-- The same first-purchase, anti-farming and hold rules as the current Razorpay
-- settlement (20260927130000). The existing Razorpay function is left intact.
create or replace function public.settle_play_purchase(
  p_user_id uuid,p_order_id text,p_product_id text,p_play_sku text,p_purchase_token text,p_paid_at timestamptz
)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_order public.orders%rowtype; v_product public.products%rowtype;
  v_other_order text; v_owned_purchase text;
  v_ref public.referrals%rowtype; v_set public.referral_settings%rowtype;
begin
  if p_purchase_token is null or length(p_purchase_token)<10 or length(p_purchase_token)>4096
     or p_paid_at is null then raise exception 'Invalid Play settlement inputs'; end if;
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || p_user_id::text,0));
  select * into v_order from public.orders where id=p_order_id for update;
  if not found or v_order.user_id is distinct from p_user_id or v_order.product_id is distinct from p_product_id
     or v_order.provider<>'play' or v_order.play_sku is distinct from p_play_sku
     or v_order.external_transaction_token is not null or v_order.external_choice_bound_order_id is not null then
    raise exception 'Play order ownership or product mismatch';
  end if;
  if v_order.status='paid' then
    if v_order.purchase_token=p_purchase_token then
      return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'already_settled',true,'amount',v_order.amount);
    end if;
    raise exception 'Play order already paid with different token';
  end if;
  -- A pending Play purchase can complete after the local checkout timer; once
  -- Google binds its token to this order, charging the user must still unlock it.
  if v_order.status not in ('created','cancelled') then
    raise exception 'Play order unavailable';
  end if;
  select order_id into v_other_order from public.payments where purchase_token=p_purchase_token;
  if found and v_other_order<>p_order_id then raise exception 'Play token already used for another order'; end if;
  select * into v_product from public.products where id=v_order.product_id;
  if not found then raise exception 'Play product unavailable'; end if;
  if not exists(select 1 from public.play_price_tiers where play_sku=v_order.play_sku and price_inr=v_order.amount)
     or v_order.list_price is distinct from v_order.amount or v_order.wallet_amount<>0
     or v_order.referral_discount<>0 then raise exception 'Play order price mismatch'; end if;

  insert into public.payments(order_id,user_id,product_id,amount,provider,purchase_token,play_sku,status,verified_at)
  values(v_order.id,v_order.user_id,v_order.product_id,v_order.amount,'play',p_purchase_token,v_order.play_sku,'success',now());
  select id into v_owned_purchase from public.purchases
   where user_id=v_order.user_id and product_id=v_product.id and status='success' and order_id is distinct from v_order.id limit 1;
  insert into public.purchases(user_id,order_id,product_id,product_title,scope,chapter_id,subject_id,year_id,
    year_ids,course_id,amount,status)
  values(v_order.user_id,v_order.id,v_product.id,coalesce(v_product.title,'Your content'),v_product.scope,
    v_product.chapter_id,v_product.subject_id,v_product.year_id,v_product.year_ids,v_product.course_id,
    v_order.amount,case when v_owned_purchase is null then 'success' else 'duplicate' end);
  update public.orders set status='paid',purchase_token=p_purchase_token,play_consumption_status='pending',
    payment_completed_at=p_paid_at,updated_at=now() where id=v_order.id;
  if v_owned_purchase is null then perform public.record_purchase_identity(v_order.user_id); end if;

  -- Mirror the referral section of settle_razorpay_payment exactly: a duplicate
  -- paid product is not a first purchase and never earns another credit.
  select * into v_ref from public.referrals where referred_id=v_order.user_id for update;
  if found and v_ref.first_order_id is null and v_ref.status in ('pending','qualified')
     and v_owned_purchase is null
     and not exists(select 1 from public.purchases where user_id=v_order.user_id
                    and order_id<>v_order.id and status='success') then
    select * into v_set from public.referral_settings where id=true;
    if v_set.require_verified_phone
       and not (coalesce((select mobile_verified from public.profiles where id=v_order.user_id),false)
            and coalesce((select mobile_verified from public.profiles where id=v_ref.referrer_id),false)) then
      update public.referrals set first_order_id=v_order.id,status='rejected',
        reject_reason='phone_not_verified_at_purchase' where id=v_ref.id;
      v_ref.status:='rejected';
    elsif public.has_prior_purchase_identity(v_order.user_id) then
      update public.referrals set first_order_id=v_order.id,status='rejected',
        reject_reason='returning_customer' where id=v_ref.id;
      v_ref.status:='rejected';
    else
      update public.referrals set first_order_id=v_order.id,status='qualified',
        qualified_at=coalesce(qualified_at,now()) where id=v_ref.id;
    end if;
    if v_ref.status<>'rejected' and v_set.enabled and v_set.referrer_credit_amount>0
       and exists(select 1 from public.profiles where id=v_ref.referrer_id and not blocked) then
      insert into public.wallet_ledger(user_id,entry_type,status,amount,source,referral_id,order_id,
        available_at,expires_at,note)
      values(v_ref.referrer_id,'credit','pending',v_set.referrer_credit_amount::numeric(10,2),
        'referral_reward',v_ref.id,v_order.id,
        now()+make_interval(days=>v_set.credit_hold_days),
        case when v_set.credit_expiry_days is null then null
          else now()+make_interval(days=>v_set.credit_hold_days+v_set.credit_expiry_days) end,
        'Friend''s first purchase')
      on conflict (referral_id) where entry_type='credit' and source='referral_reward' do nothing;
    end if;
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'already_settled',false,'amount',v_order.amount,
    'duplicate',v_owned_purchase is not null);
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.settle_play_purchase(uuid,text,text,text,text,timestamptz) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.settle_play_purchase(uuid,text,text,text,text,timestamptz) to service_role;

create or replace function public.mark_ucb_report_attempt(p_order_id text,p_refund boolean default false)
returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
begin
  if p_refund then
    update public.orders set external_refund_attempts=external_refund_attempts+1,
      external_refund_attempted_at=now() where id=p_order_id and external_transaction_token is not null;
  else
    update public.orders set external_report_attempts=external_report_attempts+1,
      external_report_attempted_at=now() where id=p_order_id and external_transaction_token is not null;
  end if;
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.mark_ucb_report_attempt(text,boolean) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.mark_ucb_report_attempt(text,boolean) to service_role;

commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261012110000_google_play_refunds.sql =====
-- Play refunds/voids revoke the entitlement and referral credit with the same
-- ledger rules as Razorpay reverse_payment. No Play purchase uses a wallet debit.
alter table public.orders add column if not exists play_last_checked_at timestamptz;

create or replace function public.reverse_play_payment(p_purchase_token text)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_uid uuid;
  v_order public.orders%rowtype;
  v_credit public.wallet_ledger%rowtype;
  v_restored numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_revoked integer := 0;
  v_avail numeric(10, 2);
  v_reversed numeric(10, 2);
  v_status jsonb;
begin
  -- Same lock order as settle_play_purchase (wallet lock, THEN the order row)
  -- so a refund cannot deadlock with a replayed capture event.
  select user_id into v_uid from public.orders where purchase_token = p_purchase_token and provider = 'play';
  if v_uid is not null then
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || v_uid::text, 0));
  end if;

  select * into v_order from public.orders where purchase_token = p_purchase_token and provider = 'play' for update;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('status', 'unknown_payment'); end if;

  -- ---- Take the access back ----------------------------------------------
  update public.orders set status = 'refunded', updated_at = now()
   where id = v_order.id and status = 'paid';

  update public.purchases set status = 'refunded'
   where order_id = v_order.id and status not in ('refunded', 'chargeback');
  get diagnostics v_revoked = row_count;

  -- ---- The referrer's credit for this friend's purchase --------------------
  -- Looked up by the ledger row's own order_id, NOT through referrals: the
  -- referrals row is deleted when the friend deletes their account.
  select * into v_credit from public.wallet_ledger
   where order_id = v_order.id and entry_type = 'credit' and source = 'referral_reward'
   for update;

  if not found then
    v_status := jsonb_build_object('status', 'no_referral_credit');

  elsif v_credit.status = 'cancelled' then
    v_status := jsonb_build_object('status', 'already_cancelled');

  elsif v_credit.status = 'pending' then
    -- Still held (even if the hold has technically run out but the release job
    -- has not run yet): cancel it.
    perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'true', true);
    update public.wallet_ledger set status = 'cancelled' where id = v_credit.id;
    perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'false', true);
    update public.referrals
       set status = 'rejected', reject_reason = 'friend_payment_reversed'
     where id = v_credit.referral_id and status <> 'rejected';
    v_status := jsonb_build_object('status', 'credit_cancelled', 'amount', v_credit.amount);

  elsif exists (select 1 from public.wallet_ledger
                 where entry_type = 'reversal' and reverses_id = v_credit.id) then
    v_status := jsonb_build_object('status', 'already_reversed', 'ledger_id', v_credit.id);

  elsif v_credit.user_id is null then
    v_status := jsonb_build_object('status', 'referrer_gone', 'ledger_id', v_credit.id);

  elsif v_credit.expires_at is not null and v_credit.expires_at <= now() then
    v_status := jsonb_build_object('status', 'credit_expired', 'ledger_id', v_credit.id);

  else
    -- Released ('available'): reverse it with a ledger row, but never by more
    -- than the referrer still has (the ledger refuses to overdraw). What cannot
    -- be recovered is flagged for a manual decision.
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || v_credit.user_id::text, 0));
    select available into v_avail from public.wallet_balance_of(v_credit.user_id);
    v_reversed := least(v_credit.amount, coalesce(v_avail, 0));
    if v_reversed > 0 then
      perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'true', true);
      insert into public.wallet_ledger (user_id, entry_type, status, amount, source, reverses_id, referral_id, order_id, note)
      values (v_credit.user_id, 'reversal', 'available', v_reversed, 'order_refund', v_credit.id, v_credit.referral_id, v_order.id,
              'Friend''s payment was reversed')
      on conflict (reverses_id) where entry_type = 'reversal' do nothing;
      perform set_config('app.trusted_order_write', 'false', true);
    end if;
    update public.referrals
       set status = 'rejected', reject_reason = 'friend_payment_reversed'
     where id = v_credit.referral_id and status <> 'rejected';
    if v_reversed < v_credit.amount then
      insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
      values (v_order.id, v_credit.user_id, 'referral_credit_unrecovered', 0, 0,
              jsonb_build_object(
                'credit_ledger_id', v_credit.id,
                'credit_amount', v_credit.amount,
                'reversed', v_reversed,
                'unrecovered', v_credit.amount - v_reversed,
                'order_id', v_order.id,
                'recommended_action',
                  'The friend''s payment was reversed but the referrer had already spent part of the credit. '
                  || 'Only what was still in their wallet was taken back; decide whether to recover the rest.'))
      on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    end if;
    v_status := jsonb_build_object('status', 'credit_reversed', 'ledger_id', v_credit.id,
                                   'amount', v_credit.amount, 'reversed', v_reversed);
  end if;

  return v_status || jsonb_build_object('wallet_restored', v_restored, 'purchases_revoked', v_revoked);
end;
$$;


revoke all on function public.reverse_play_payment(text) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.reverse_play_payment(text) to service_role;


===== supabase/migrations/20261012120000_ucb_partial_refunds.sql =====
-- Each processed Razorpay refund has its own durable Google report attempt.
-- A stable Razorpay refund ID is also the Google partialRefund.refundId.
begin;

create table if not exists public.ucb_external_refunds (
  refund_id text primary key,
  order_id text not null references public.orders(id),
  amount_paise bigint not null check (amount_paise > 0),
  pre_tax_paise bigint not null check (pre_tax_paise > 0),
  refund_time timestamptz not null,
  is_full boolean not null,
  status text not null default 'pending' check (status in ('pending','processing','failed','reported')),
  attempts integer not null default 0,
  attempted_at timestamptz,
  reported_at timestamptz,
  error text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists ucb_external_refunds_queue
  on public.ucb_external_refunds(status,created_at);
create index if not exists ucb_external_refunds_order_id
  on public.ucb_external_refunds(order_id);
alter table public.ucb_external_refunds enable row level security;
revoke all on public.ucb_external_refunds from public,anon,authenticated;
grant all on public.ucb_external_refunds to service_role;

create or replace function public.claim_ucb_external_refund(p_refund_id text)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_ref public.ucb_external_refunds%rowtype; v_order_id text;
begin
  select order_id into v_order_id from public.ucb_external_refunds where refund_id=p_refund_id;
  if v_order_id is null then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false); end if;
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('ucb-refund:' || v_order_id,0));
  select * into v_ref from public.ucb_external_refunds where refund_id=p_refund_id for update;
  if not found or v_ref.status='reported' then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false); end if;
  if v_ref.status='processing' and v_ref.attempted_at>now()-interval '2 minutes' then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok',false);
  end if;
  -- A later webhook can arrive while an earlier/later refund is already being
  -- sent to Google. Never send two refunds for one order concurrently.
  if exists(select 1 from public.ucb_external_refunds busy
     where busy.order_id=v_ref.order_id and busy.refund_id<>v_ref.refund_id
       and busy.status='processing' and busy.attempted_at>now()-interval '2 minutes') then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok',false);
  end if;
  -- Later refunds wait for earlier ones, so currentPreTaxAmount is a useful
  -- reconciliation value after an ambiguous Google response.
  if exists(select 1 from public.ucb_external_refunds prior
     where prior.order_id=v_ref.order_id and prior.refund_id<>v_ref.refund_id
       and (prior.refund_time,prior.refund_id)<(v_ref.refund_time,v_ref.refund_id)
       and prior.status<>'reported') then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false); end if;
  update public.ucb_external_refunds set status='processing',attempts=attempts+1,
    attempted_at=now(),error=null where refund_id=p_refund_id;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true);
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.claim_ucb_external_refund(text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.claim_ucb_external_refund(text) to service_role;

commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261013090000_ucb_atomic_completion.sql =====
-- Preserve the existing settlement rules; only add completion time in its transaction.
begin;
create or replace function public.settle_razorpay_payment(
  p_event_id text,
  p_razorpay_order_id text,
  p_razorpay_payment_id text,
  p_amount_paise bigint,
  p_paid_at timestamptz default null   -- when the customer started the payment (Razorpay payment.created_at)
)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_uid uuid;
  v_order public.orders%rowtype;
  v_product public.products%rowtype;
  v_existing_payment_order_id text;
  v_set public.referral_settings%rowtype;
  v_ref public.referrals%rowtype;
  v_balance numeric(10, 2);
  v_debit numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_stale boolean;
  v_first boolean;                 -- first settlement of this order (not a replay)
  v_debited boolean := false;
  v_discount_owner text;
  v_discount_dup boolean := false;
  v_owned_purchase text;           -- an existing successful purchase of the same product
  v_base jsonb;
begin
  if p_event_id is null or p_razorpay_order_id is null or p_razorpay_payment_id is null
    or p_amount_paise is null or p_amount_paise <= 0 then
    raise exception 'invalid Razorpay settlement parameters';
  end if;

  select user_id into v_uid from public.orders where razorpay_order_id = p_razorpay_order_id;
  if v_uid is not null then
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || v_uid::text, 0));
  end if;

  -- Row lock serialises a webhook retry with the client verification path.
  select * into v_order
  from public.orders
  where razorpay_order_id = p_razorpay_order_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Razorpay order % is not linked to an internal order', p_razorpay_order_id;
  end if;
  if round(v_order.amount * 100)::bigint <> p_amount_paise then
    raise exception 'Razorpay amount does not match order amount';
  end if;

  select order_id into v_existing_payment_order_id
  from public.payments
  where razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id;
  if found and v_existing_payment_order_id <> v_order.id then
    raise exception 'Razorpay payment is already linked to another order';
  end if;

  -- Account deleted while the payment was in flight: keep the accounting row,
  -- grant nothing, debit nothing, reward nothing (refund manually).
  if v_order.user_id is null then
    insert into public.payments (
      order_id, user_id, product_id, amount, razorpay_order_id,
      razorpay_payment_id, status, verified_at
    ) values (
      v_order.id, null, v_order.product_id, v_order.amount,
      p_razorpay_order_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'success', now()
    ) on conflict (razorpay_payment_id) do nothing;

    update public.orders
    set status = 'paid', razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id, updated_at = now(),
        payment_completed_at = case when external_transaction_token is not null
          then coalesce(payment_completed_at, clock_timestamp()) else payment_completed_at end
    where id = v_order.id and status <> 'refunded';

    insert into public.razorpay_webhook_events(event_id, razorpay_payment_id, event_type)
    values (p_event_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'payment.captured')
    on conflict (event_id) do nothing;

    raise warning 'grant_razorpay_payment: payment % for order % arrived after the account was deleted; no access granted - refund manually', p_razorpay_payment_id, v_order.id;
    return;
  end if;

  select * into v_product from public.products where id = v_order.product_id;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'Order % references unknown product %', v_order.id, v_order.product_id;
  end if;

  v_first := v_order.status not in ('paid', 'refunded');

  -- ---- Friend discount is usable ONCE per referral -------------------------
  -- The first discounted order to settle claims referrals.discount_order_id; any
  -- other discounted order is a second use of the same discount. Serialised per
  -- user by the wallet advisory lock above; replays of the winner see their own
  -- id and pass. A second use is still granted (the customer paid what checkout
  -- charged) but gets no referrer credit, and is flagged below.
  if v_order.referral_discount > 0 and v_order.referral_id is not null then
    update public.referrals set discount_order_id = v_order.id
     where id = v_order.referral_id and discount_order_id is null;
    select discount_order_id into v_discount_owner from public.referrals where id = v_order.referral_id;
    v_discount_dup := found and v_discount_owner is not null and v_discount_owner <> v_order.id;
  end if;

  insert into public.payments (
    order_id, user_id, product_id, amount, razorpay_order_id,
    razorpay_payment_id, status, verified_at
  ) values (
    v_order.id, v_order.user_id, v_order.product_id, v_order.amount,
    p_razorpay_order_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'success', now()
  ) on conflict (razorpay_payment_id) do nothing;

  -- ---- Already owns this product? -----------------------------------------
  select id into v_owned_purchase from public.purchases
   where user_id = v_order.user_id and product_id = v_product.id
     and status = 'success' and order_id is distinct from v_order.id
   limit 1;

  insert into public.purchases (
    user_id, order_id, product_id, product_title, scope, chapter_id,
    subject_id, year_id, year_ids, course_id, amount, status, razorpay_order_id
  ) values (
    v_order.user_id, v_order.id, v_product.id, coalesce(v_product.title, 'Your content'),
    v_product.scope, v_product.chapter_id, v_product.subject_id, v_product.year_id,
    v_product.year_ids, v_product.course_id, v_order.amount,
    case when v_owned_purchase is null then 'success' else 'duplicate' end,
    p_razorpay_order_id
  ) on conflict (order_id) do nothing;

  update public.orders
  set status = 'paid', razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id,
      course_id = v_product.course_id, updated_at = now(),
      payment_completed_at = case when external_transaction_token is not null
        then coalesce(payment_completed_at, clock_timestamp()) else payment_completed_at end
  where id = v_order.id and status <> 'refunded';

  -- Remember who bought (hashed email / phone) so a deleted-and-recreated account is not
  -- treated as a first-time buyer. Never removed on refund or account deletion.
  if v_owned_purchase is null then
    perform public.record_purchase_identity(v_order.user_id);
  end if;

  -- ---- Stale order? -------------------------------------------------------
  -- v_order is the row as it was BEFORE this settlement flipped it to 'paid'.
  -- Replays see 'paid' and rely on the flag written the first time.
  v_stale := exists (select 1 from public.order_review_flags
                      where order_id = v_order.id and reason = 'stale_order_paid')
          or v_order.status in ('cancelled', 'failed')
          or (v_order.status = 'created' and v_order.expires_at is not null
              and coalesce(p_paid_at, now()) > v_order.expires_at);

  -- ---- Wallet debit: ALWAYS, on the first settlement, clamped ---------------
  if v_first and v_order.wallet_amount > 0
     and not exists (select 1 from public.wallet_ledger
                      where order_id = v_order.id and entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment') then
    perform public.release_due_wallet_credits(v_order.user_id);
    select available into v_balance from public.wallet_balance_of(v_order.user_id);
    v_debit := least(v_order.wallet_amount, coalesce(v_balance, 0));
    if v_debit > 0 then
      insert into public.wallet_ledger (user_id, entry_type, status, amount, source, order_id, note)
      values (v_order.user_id, 'debit', 'available', v_debit, 'order_payment', v_order.id, 'Wallet used at checkout')
      on conflict (order_id) where entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment' do nothing;
      v_debited := true;
    end if;
  end if;

  -- ---- Review flags (one per order and reason; replays add nothing) ---------
  v_base := jsonb_build_object(
    'product_id', v_product.id,
    'product_title', v_product.title,
    'amount_paid', v_order.amount,
    'list_price', v_order.list_price,
    'razorpay_order_id', p_razorpay_order_id,
    'razorpay_payment_id', p_razorpay_payment_id);

  if v_first and v_order.wallet_amount > 0 and v_debit < v_order.wallet_amount then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'wallet_shortfall', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            v_base || jsonb_build_object(
              'wallet_amount_applied', v_order.wallet_amount,
              'wallet_debited', v_debit,
              'shortfall', v_order.wallet_amount - v_debit,
              'access_granted', true,
              'recommended_action',
                format('Checkout applied Rs %s of wallet balance but only Rs %s was still available, so Rs %s of the discount was not paid for. Access was granted. Decide whether to accept it or refund payment %s in Razorpay (a full refund revokes the access).',
                       v_order.wallet_amount, v_debit, v_order.wallet_amount - v_debit, p_razorpay_payment_id)))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % wanted % wallet credit but only % was available',
      v_order.id, v_order.wallet_amount, v_debit;
  end if;

  if v_stale and (v_order.wallet_amount > 0 or v_order.referral_discount > 0) then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'stale_order_paid', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            v_base || jsonb_build_object(
              'order_status', v_order.status, 'expires_at', v_order.expires_at, 'paid_at', p_paid_at,
              'wallet_debited', (select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from public.wallet_ledger
                                  where order_id = v_order.id and entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment'),
              'access_granted', true,
              'recommended_action',
                'This payment arrived for a checkout that was already cancelled or had expired. Access was granted and the wallet amount was debited as normal. No action needed unless the amount looks wrong.'))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % was % / expired when payment % arrived; flagged for review',
      v_order.id, v_order.status, p_razorpay_payment_id;
  end if;

  if v_discount_dup then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'discount_reused', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            v_base || jsonb_build_object(
              'discount_first_order_id', v_discount_owner,
              'discount_not_owed', v_order.referral_discount,
              'order_status', v_order.status,
              'access_granted', true,
              'referrer_credited', false,
              'recommended_action',
                format('Access was granted. This student already used their one friend discount on order %s, so this order was under-charged by Rs %s (paid Rs %s instead of Rs %s). To reverse it, issue a FULL refund of payment %s in the Razorpay dashboard: the refund webhook then revokes the access and gives back any wallet amount used, and the student can buy again at full price. Do nothing to keep the sale as it is.',
                       v_discount_owner, v_order.referral_discount, v_order.amount,
                       v_order.amount + v_order.referral_discount, p_razorpay_payment_id)))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % reuses the friend discount already used by order %; access granted, no referrer credit, flagged for review',
      v_order.id, v_discount_owner;
  end if;

  if v_owned_purchase is not null then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'duplicate_purchase', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            v_base || jsonb_build_object(
              'existing_purchase_id', v_owned_purchase,
              'access_granted', false,
              'recommended_action',
                format('The student already owned "%s" and paid for it again (Rs %s). The new purchase is stored as ''duplicate'' and adds no access. Refund payment %s in the Razorpay dashboard.',
                       v_product.title, v_order.amount, p_razorpay_payment_id)))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % is a duplicate purchase of product %; flagged for refund', v_order.id, v_product.id;
  end if;

  -- ---- Referrer credit ----------------------------------------------------
  -- Only the friend's FIRST successful purchase counts, and only once.
  select * into v_ref from public.referrals where referred_id = v_order.user_id for update;
  if found and not v_discount_dup and v_ref.first_order_id is null and v_ref.status in ('pending', 'qualified')
     and v_owned_purchase is null
     and not exists (select 1 from public.purchases
                      where user_id = v_order.user_id and order_id <> v_order.id and status = 'success') then
    select * into v_set from public.referral_settings where id = true;

    -- Batch 3 / F5: no credit unless BOTH sides have a verified mobile number at the
    -- moment of the purchase (a number changed after applying the code loses its
    -- verification). The referral is consumed: this was the friend's first purchase.
    if v_set.require_verified_phone
       and not (coalesce((select mobile_verified from public.profiles where id = v_order.user_id), false)
            and coalesce((select mobile_verified from public.profiles where id = v_ref.referrer_id), false)) then
      update public.referrals
         set first_order_id = v_order.id, status = 'rejected', reject_reason = 'phone_not_verified_at_purchase'
       where id = v_ref.id;
      raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: no referrer credit for order %: a mobile number was not verified', v_order.id;
      v_ref.status := 'rejected';
    elsif public.has_prior_purchase_identity(v_order.user_id) then
      -- Same email / phone already bought under another (maybe deleted) account.
      update public.referrals
         set first_order_id = v_order.id, status = 'rejected', reject_reason = 'returning_customer'
       where id = v_ref.id;
      raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: no referrer credit for order %: the buyer is a returning customer', v_order.id;
      v_ref.status := 'rejected';
    else
      update public.referrals
         set first_order_id = v_order.id, status = 'qualified', qualified_at = coalesce(qualified_at, now())
       where id = v_ref.id;
    end if;

    if v_ref.status <> 'rejected' and v_set.enabled and v_set.referrer_credit_amount > 0
       and exists (select 1 from public.profiles where id = v_ref.referrer_id and not blocked) then
      insert into public.wallet_ledger (
        user_id, entry_type, status, amount, source, referral_id, order_id,
        available_at, expires_at, note
      ) values (
        v_ref.referrer_id, 'credit', 'pending', v_set.referrer_credit_amount::numeric(10, 2),
        'referral_reward', v_ref.id, v_order.id,
        now() + make_interval(days => v_set.credit_hold_days),
        case when v_set.credit_expiry_days is null then null
             else now() + make_interval(days => v_set.credit_hold_days + v_set.credit_expiry_days) end,
        'Friend''s first purchase'
      ) on conflict (referral_id) where entry_type = 'credit' and source = 'referral_reward' do nothing;
    end if;
  end if;

  insert into public.razorpay_webhook_events(event_id, razorpay_payment_id, event_type)
  values (p_event_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'payment.captured')
  on conflict (event_id) do nothing;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.settle_razorpay_payment(text,text,text,bigint,timestamptz) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.settle_razorpay_payment(text,text,text,bigint,timestamptz) to service_role;

-- Repair historical paid choice orders from the server-verified payment record.
update public.orders o set payment_completed_at=p.first_verified_at
from (select order_id,min(verified_at) as first_verified_at from public.payments
      where status='success' and verified_at is not null group by order_id) p
where p.order_id=o.id and o.provider='razorpay' and o.status in ('paid','refunded')
  and o.external_transaction_token is not null and o.payment_completed_at is null
  and p.first_verified_at is not null;
commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261013100000_wallet_reservations.sql =====
-- Wallet reservations prevent more than one active checkout from consuming the same value.
begin;
create table if not exists public.wallet_order_reservations (
  order_id text primary key references public.orders(id) on delete cascade,
  user_id uuid not null,
  amount numeric(10,2) not null check (amount>0),
  expires_at timestamptz not null
);
create index if not exists wallet_order_reservations_user_idx on public.wallet_order_reservations(user_id);
alter table public.wallet_order_reservations enable row level security;
revoke all on public.wallet_order_reservations from public,anon,authenticated;
grant all on public.wallet_order_reservations to service_role;
-- A reservation is live only while its order is created and unexpired.
-- Cancellation, failure, expiry, payment, and refund release it by state.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_priced_order(p_user_id uuid, p_product_id text, p_use_wallet boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_set      public.referral_settings%rowtype;
  v_product  public.products%rowtype;
  v_ref      public.referrals%rowtype;
  v_price    numeric(10, 2);
  v_discount numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_wallet   numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_base     numeric(10, 2);
  v_cap      numeric(10, 2);
  v_balance  numeric(10, 2);
  v_final    numeric(10, 2);
  v_order_id text := gen_random_uuid()::text;
begin
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || p_user_id::text, 0));

  select * into v_product from public.products where id = p_product_id;
  if not found or not v_product.active or not (v_product.price > 0) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'product_unavailable');
  end if;
  v_price := v_product.price::numeric(10, 2);
  if v_price < 1 then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'invalid_price');
  end if;

  -- Already owns this exact product? Refuse before anything is reserved.
  if exists (select 1 from public.purchases
              where user_id = p_user_id and product_id = v_product.id and status = 'success') then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'already_owned');
  end if;

  select * into v_set from public.referral_settings where id = true;

  -- Friend discount: first purchase only, code applied at signup, program on.
  if v_set.enabled and v_set.friend_discount_percent > 0 then
    select r.* into v_ref
      from public.referrals r
      join public.profiles rp on rp.id = r.referrer_id and not rp.blocked
     where r.referred_id = p_user_id
       and r.status in ('pending', 'qualified')
       and r.first_order_id is null
       and not exists (select 1 from public.purchases pu
                        where pu.user_id = p_user_id and pu.status = 'success')
       -- a returning customer (same email / phone bought under an earlier, maybe deleted, account) is not a first-time buyer
       and not public.has_prior_purchase_identity(p_user_id);
    if found then
      v_discount := round(v_price * v_set.friend_discount_percent / 100, 2);
      if v_set.friend_discount_max is not null then
        v_discount := least(v_discount, v_set.friend_discount_max);
      end if;
      v_discount := greatest(0, least(v_discount, v_price - 1));
    end if;
  end if;

  v_base := v_price - v_discount;

  -- Wallet: eligible product types only (referral_settings), capped at wallet_max_percent of what is left
  -- after the friend discount, and never more than the available balance.
  -- Program off: a client-sent use_wallet is ignored (priced with no wallet), never an error.
  if p_use_wallet and v_set.enabled then
    if not (v_product.product_type = any (v_set.wallet_product_types)) then
      return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'wallet_not_allowed');
    end if;
    perform public.release_due_wallet_credits(p_user_id);
    select available into v_balance from public.wallet_balance_of(p_user_id);
    v_cap := floor(v_base * v_set.wallet_max_percent) / 100;
    v_wallet := greatest(0, least(v_cap, coalesce(v_balance, 0)));
  end if;

  v_final := v_price - v_discount - v_wallet;
  if v_final < 1 then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'invalid_price');
  end if;

  -- Validation passed: only now cancel every earlier unpaid order of this user.
  update public.orders
     set status = 'cancelled', updated_at = now()
   where user_id = p_user_id and status = 'created';

  insert into public.orders (
    id, user_id, product_id, scope, chapter_id, subject_id, year_id, year_ids, course_id,
    amount, list_price, referral_discount, wallet_amount, referral_id, status, expires_at
  ) values (
    v_order_id, p_user_id, v_product.id, v_product.scope, v_product.chapter_id, v_product.subject_id,
    v_product.year_id, v_product.year_ids, v_product.course_id,
    v_final, v_price, v_discount, v_wallet,
    case when v_discount > 0 then v_ref.id end, 'created',
    now() + make_interval(mins => v_set.checkout_expiry_minutes)
  );

  if v_wallet > 0 then
    insert into public.wallet_order_reservations(order_id,user_id,amount,expires_at)
    values (v_order_id,p_user_id,v_wallet,now() + make_interval(mins => v_set.checkout_expiry_minutes));
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true, 'order_id', v_order_id, 'title', v_product.title,
    'list_price', v_price, 'referral_discount', v_discount,
    'wallet_amount', v_wallet, 'amount', v_final,
    'timeout_seconds', v_set.checkout_expiry_minutes * 60
  );
end;
$function$;

revoke all on function public.create_priced_order(uuid,text,boolean) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.create_priced_order(uuid,text,boolean) to service_role;
create or replace function public.settle_razorpay_payment(
  p_event_id text,
  p_razorpay_order_id text,
  p_razorpay_payment_id text,
  p_amount_paise bigint,
  p_paid_at timestamptz default null   -- when the customer started the payment (Razorpay payment.created_at)
)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_uid uuid;
  v_order public.orders%rowtype;
  v_product public.products%rowtype;
  v_existing_payment_order_id text;
  v_set public.referral_settings%rowtype;
  v_ref public.referrals%rowtype;
  v_balance numeric(10, 2);
  v_debit numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_stale boolean;
  v_first boolean;                 -- first settlement of this order (not a replay)
  v_debited boolean := false;
  v_discount_owner text;
  v_discount_dup boolean := false;
  v_owned_purchase text;           -- an existing successful purchase of the same product
  v_base jsonb;
  v_other_reserved numeric(10,2);
begin
  if p_event_id is null or p_razorpay_order_id is null or p_razorpay_payment_id is null
    or p_amount_paise is null or p_amount_paise <= 0 then
    raise exception 'invalid Razorpay settlement parameters';
  end if;

  select user_id into v_uid from public.orders where razorpay_order_id = p_razorpay_order_id;
  if v_uid is not null then
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || v_uid::text, 0));
  end if;

  -- Row lock serialises a webhook retry with the client verification path.
  select * into v_order
  from public.orders
  where razorpay_order_id = p_razorpay_order_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Razorpay order % is not linked to an internal order', p_razorpay_order_id;
  end if;
  if round(v_order.amount * 100)::bigint <> p_amount_paise then
    raise exception 'Razorpay amount does not match order amount';
  end if;

  select order_id into v_existing_payment_order_id
  from public.payments
  where razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id;
  if found and v_existing_payment_order_id <> v_order.id then
    raise exception 'Razorpay payment is already linked to another order';
  end if;

  -- Account deleted while the payment was in flight: keep the accounting row,
  -- grant nothing, debit nothing, reward nothing (refund manually).
  if v_order.user_id is null then
    insert into public.payments (
      order_id, user_id, product_id, amount, razorpay_order_id,
      razorpay_payment_id, status, verified_at
    ) values (
      v_order.id, null, v_order.product_id, v_order.amount,
      p_razorpay_order_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'success', now()
    ) on conflict (razorpay_payment_id) do nothing;

    update public.orders
    set status = 'paid', razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id, updated_at = now(),
        payment_completed_at = case when external_transaction_token is not null
          then coalesce(payment_completed_at, clock_timestamp()) else payment_completed_at end
    where id = v_order.id and status <> 'refunded';

    insert into public.razorpay_webhook_events(event_id, razorpay_payment_id, event_type)
    values (p_event_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'payment.captured')
    on conflict (event_id) do nothing;

    raise warning 'grant_razorpay_payment: payment % for order % arrived after the account was deleted; no access granted - refund manually', p_razorpay_payment_id, v_order.id;
    return;
  end if;

  select * into v_product from public.products where id = v_order.product_id;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'Order % references unknown product %', v_order.id, v_order.product_id;
  end if;

  v_first := v_order.status not in ('paid', 'refunded');

  -- A cancelled/expired checkout may have released its reservation. Never
  -- grant a captured payment unless the whole wallet discount can be debited.
  if v_first and v_order.wallet_amount > 0 then
    perform public.release_due_wallet_credits(v_order.user_id);
    select available into v_balance from public.wallet_balance_of(v_order.user_id);
    select coalesce(sum(r.amount),0) into v_other_reserved
      from public.wallet_order_reservations r join public.orders o on o.id=r.order_id
      where r.user_id=v_order.user_id and r.order_id<>v_order.id
        and o.status='created' and r.expires_at>now();
    if coalesce(v_balance,0)-v_other_reserved < v_order.wallet_amount then
      raise exception 'wallet shortfall: captured payment requires manual refund or compensation';
    end if;
  end if;

  -- ---- Friend discount is usable ONCE per referral -------------------------
  -- The first discounted order to settle claims referrals.discount_order_id; any
  -- other discounted order is a second use of the same discount. Serialised per
  -- user by the wallet advisory lock above; replays of the winner see their own
  -- id and pass. A second use is still granted (the customer paid what checkout
  -- charged) but gets no referrer credit, and is flagged below.
  if v_order.referral_discount > 0 and v_order.referral_id is not null then
    update public.referrals set discount_order_id = v_order.id
     where id = v_order.referral_id and discount_order_id is null;
    select discount_order_id into v_discount_owner from public.referrals where id = v_order.referral_id;
    v_discount_dup := found and v_discount_owner is not null and v_discount_owner <> v_order.id;
  end if;

  insert into public.payments (
    order_id, user_id, product_id, amount, razorpay_order_id,
    razorpay_payment_id, status, verified_at
  ) values (
    v_order.id, v_order.user_id, v_order.product_id, v_order.amount,
    p_razorpay_order_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'success', now()
  ) on conflict (razorpay_payment_id) do nothing;

  -- ---- Already owns this product? -----------------------------------------
  select id into v_owned_purchase from public.purchases
   where user_id = v_order.user_id and product_id = v_product.id
     and status = 'success' and order_id is distinct from v_order.id
   limit 1;

  insert into public.purchases (
    user_id, order_id, product_id, product_title, scope, chapter_id,
    subject_id, year_id, year_ids, course_id, amount, status, razorpay_order_id
  ) values (
    v_order.user_id, v_order.id, v_product.id, coalesce(v_product.title, 'Your content'),
    v_product.scope, v_product.chapter_id, v_product.subject_id, v_product.year_id,
    v_product.year_ids, v_product.course_id, v_order.amount,
    case when v_owned_purchase is null then 'success' else 'duplicate' end,
    p_razorpay_order_id
  ) on conflict (order_id) do nothing;

  update public.orders
  set status = 'paid', razorpay_payment_id = p_razorpay_payment_id,
      course_id = v_product.course_id, updated_at = now(),
      payment_completed_at = case when external_transaction_token is not null
        then coalesce(payment_completed_at, clock_timestamp()) else payment_completed_at end
  where id = v_order.id and status <> 'refunded';

  -- Remember who bought (hashed email / phone) so a deleted-and-recreated account is not
  -- treated as a first-time buyer. Never removed on refund or account deletion.
  if v_owned_purchase is null then
    perform public.record_purchase_identity(v_order.user_id);
  end if;

  -- ---- Stale order? -------------------------------------------------------
  -- v_order is the row as it was BEFORE this settlement flipped it to 'paid'.
  -- Replays see 'paid' and rely on the flag written the first time.
  v_stale := exists (select 1 from public.order_review_flags
                      where order_id = v_order.id and reason = 'stale_order_paid')
          or v_order.status in ('cancelled', 'failed')
          or (v_order.status = 'created' and v_order.expires_at is not null
              and coalesce(p_paid_at, now()) > v_order.expires_at);

  -- ---- Wallet debit: ALWAYS, on the first settlement, clamped ---------------
  if v_first and v_order.wallet_amount > 0
     and not exists (select 1 from public.wallet_ledger
                      where order_id = v_order.id and entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment') then
    perform public.release_due_wallet_credits(v_order.user_id);
    select available into v_balance from public.wallet_balance_of(v_order.user_id);
    v_debit := v_order.wallet_amount;
    if v_debit > 0 then
      insert into public.wallet_ledger (user_id, entry_type, status, amount, source, order_id, note)
      values (v_order.user_id, 'debit', 'available', v_debit, 'order_payment', v_order.id, 'Wallet used at checkout')
      on conflict (order_id) where entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment' do nothing;
      v_debited := true;
    end if;
  end if;

  -- ---- Review flags (one per order and reason; replays add nothing) ---------
  v_base := jsonb_build_object(
    'product_id', v_product.id,
    'product_title', v_product.title,
    'amount_paid', v_order.amount,
    'list_price', v_order.list_price,
    'razorpay_order_id', p_razorpay_order_id,
    'razorpay_payment_id', p_razorpay_payment_id);

  if v_first and v_order.wallet_amount > 0 and v_debit < v_order.wallet_amount then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'wallet_shortfall', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            v_base || jsonb_build_object(
              'wallet_amount_applied', v_order.wallet_amount,
              'wallet_debited', v_debit,
              'shortfall', v_order.wallet_amount - v_debit,
              'access_granted', true,
              'recommended_action',
                format('Checkout applied Rs %s of wallet balance but only Rs %s was still available, so Rs %s of the discount was not paid for. Access was granted. Decide whether to accept it or refund payment %s in Razorpay (a full refund revokes the access).',
                       v_order.wallet_amount, v_debit, v_order.wallet_amount - v_debit, p_razorpay_payment_id)))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % wanted % wallet credit but only % was available',
      v_order.id, v_order.wallet_amount, v_debit;
  end if;

  if v_stale and (v_order.wallet_amount > 0 or v_order.referral_discount > 0) then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'stale_order_paid', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            v_base || jsonb_build_object(
              'order_status', v_order.status, 'expires_at', v_order.expires_at, 'paid_at', p_paid_at,
              'wallet_debited', (select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from public.wallet_ledger
                                  where order_id = v_order.id and entry_type = 'debit' and source = 'order_payment'),
              'access_granted', true,
              'recommended_action',
                'This payment arrived for a checkout that was already cancelled or had expired. Access was granted and the wallet amount was debited as normal. No action needed unless the amount looks wrong.'))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % was % / expired when payment % arrived; flagged for review',
      v_order.id, v_order.status, p_razorpay_payment_id;
  end if;

  if v_discount_dup then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'discount_reused', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            v_base || jsonb_build_object(
              'discount_first_order_id', v_discount_owner,
              'discount_not_owed', v_order.referral_discount,
              'order_status', v_order.status,
              'access_granted', true,
              'referrer_credited', false,
              'recommended_action',
                format('Access was granted. This student already used their one friend discount on order %s, so this order was under-charged by Rs %s (paid Rs %s instead of Rs %s). To reverse it, issue a FULL refund of payment %s in the Razorpay dashboard: the refund webhook then revokes the access and gives back any wallet amount used, and the student can buy again at full price. Do nothing to keep the sale as it is.',
                       v_discount_owner, v_order.referral_discount, v_order.amount,
                       v_order.amount + v_order.referral_discount, p_razorpay_payment_id)))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % reuses the friend discount already used by order %; access granted, no referrer credit, flagged for review',
      v_order.id, v_discount_owner;
  end if;

  if v_owned_purchase is not null then
    insert into public.order_review_flags (order_id, user_id, reason, wallet_amount, referral_discount, details)
    values (v_order.id, v_order.user_id, 'duplicate_purchase', v_order.wallet_amount, v_order.referral_discount,
            v_base || jsonb_build_object(
              'existing_purchase_id', v_owned_purchase,
              'access_granted', false,
              'recommended_action',
                format('The student already owned "%s" and paid for it again (Rs %s). The new purchase is stored as ''duplicate'' and adds no access. Refund payment %s in the Razorpay dashboard.',
                       v_product.title, v_order.amount, p_razorpay_payment_id)))
    on conflict (order_id, reason) where order_id is not null do nothing;
    raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: order % is a duplicate purchase of product %; flagged for refund', v_order.id, v_product.id;
  end if;

  -- ---- Referrer credit ----------------------------------------------------
  -- Only the friend's FIRST successful purchase counts, and only once.
  select * into v_ref from public.referrals where referred_id = v_order.user_id for update;
  if found and not v_discount_dup and v_ref.first_order_id is null and v_ref.status in ('pending', 'qualified')
     and v_owned_purchase is null
     and not exists (select 1 from public.purchases
                      where user_id = v_order.user_id and order_id <> v_order.id and status = 'success') then
    select * into v_set from public.referral_settings where id = true;

    -- Batch 3 / F5: no credit unless BOTH sides have a verified mobile number at the
    -- moment of the purchase (a number changed after applying the code loses its
    -- verification). The referral is consumed: this was the friend's first purchase.
    if v_set.require_verified_phone
       and not (coalesce((select mobile_verified from public.profiles where id = v_order.user_id), false)
            and coalesce((select mobile_verified from public.profiles where id = v_ref.referrer_id), false)) then
      update public.referrals
         set first_order_id = v_order.id, status = 'rejected', reject_reason = 'phone_not_verified_at_purchase'
       where id = v_ref.id;
      raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: no referrer credit for order %: a mobile number was not verified', v_order.id;
      v_ref.status := 'rejected';
    elsif public.has_prior_purchase_identity(v_order.user_id) then
      -- Same email / phone already bought under another (maybe deleted) account.
      update public.referrals
         set first_order_id = v_order.id, status = 'rejected', reject_reason = 'returning_customer'
       where id = v_ref.id;
      raise warning 'settle_razorpay_payment: no referrer credit for order %: the buyer is a returning customer', v_order.id;
      v_ref.status := 'rejected';
    else
      update public.referrals
         set first_order_id = v_order.id, status = 'qualified', qualified_at = coalesce(qualified_at, now())
       where id = v_ref.id;
    end if;

    if v_ref.status <> 'rejected' and v_set.enabled and v_set.referrer_credit_amount > 0
       and exists (select 1 from public.profiles where id = v_ref.referrer_id and not blocked) then
      insert into public.wallet_ledger (
        user_id, entry_type, status, amount, source, referral_id, order_id,
        available_at, expires_at, note
      ) values (
        v_ref.referrer_id, 'credit', 'pending', v_set.referrer_credit_amount::numeric(10, 2),
        'referral_reward', v_ref.id, v_order.id,
        now() + make_interval(days => v_set.credit_hold_days),
        case when v_set.credit_expiry_days is null then null
             else now() + make_interval(days => v_set.credit_hold_days + v_set.credit_expiry_days) end,
        'Friend''s first purchase'
      ) on conflict (referral_id) where entry_type = 'credit' and source = 'referral_reward' do nothing;
    end if;
  end if;

  insert into public.razorpay_webhook_events(event_id, razorpay_payment_id, event_type)
  values (p_event_id, p_razorpay_payment_id, 'payment.captured')
  on conflict (event_id) do nothing;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.settle_razorpay_payment(text,text,text,bigint,timestamptz) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.settle_razorpay_payment(text,text,text,bigint,timestamptz) to service_role;
commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261013110000_play_void_cursor.sql =====
begin;
create table if not exists public.play_void_sweep_state (
  id boolean primary key default true check (id),
  start_time_ms bigint not null,
  end_time_ms bigint not null,
  next_page_token text,
  lease_id uuid,
  lease_until timestamptz,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
alter table public.play_void_sweep_state enable row level security;
revoke all on public.play_void_sweep_state from public,anon,authenticated;
grant all on public.play_void_sweep_state to service_role;
insert into public.play_void_sweep_state(id,start_time_ms,end_time_ms)
values(true,(extract(epoch from now())*1000)::bigint-86400000,
  (extract(epoch from now())*1000)::bigint)
on conflict(id) do nothing;
create or replace view public.play_void_sweep_metrics as
select (select count(*) from public.orders o where o.provider='play' and o.status='paid'
  and (o.play_last_checked_at is null or o.play_last_checked_at<now()-interval '2 hours')) as unchecked_count,
  (select min(coalesce(o.play_last_checked_at,o.created_at)) from public.orders o
   where o.provider='play' and o.status='paid') as oldest_unchecked_at,
  (extract(epoch from now())*1000-s.end_time_ms)/1000 as cursor_lag_seconds,
  s.updated_at as cursor_updated_at
from public.play_void_sweep_state s where s.id=true;
revoke all on public.play_void_sweep_metrics from public,anon,authenticated;
grant select on public.play_void_sweep_metrics to service_role;
create or replace function public.claim_play_void_sweep()
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_state public.play_void_sweep_state%rowtype; v_lease uuid:=gen_random_uuid();
begin
  update public.play_void_sweep_state set lease_id=v_lease,
    lease_until=now()+interval '90 seconds',updated_at=now()
  where id=true and (lease_until is null or lease_until<now()) returning * into v_state;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','busy'); end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'lease_id',v_lease,'start_time_ms',v_state.start_time_ms,
    'end_time_ms',v_state.end_time_ms,'next_page_token',v_state.next_page_token);
end $$;
revoke all on function public.claim_play_void_sweep() from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.claim_play_void_sweep() to service_role;
commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261014100000_payment_audit_capture_inbox.sql =====
-- Durable provider facts precede entitlement. All writes are server-only.
begin;

  add column if not exists payment_time_fallback boolean not null default false;

  event_id text primary key,
  event_type text not null,
  razorpay_order_id text,
  payment_id text,
  provider_object_id text,
  payload_hash text not null check (payload_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  provider_time timestamptz,
  received_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
  status text not null default 'pending' check (status in ('pending','applied','parked')),

  reason text not null,

  attempts integer not null default 0,

  lease_until timestamptz,
  last_error text,

  user_id uuid primary key,
  referral_id uuid not null,

  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
alter table public.first_discount_reservations enable row level security;
