grant all on public.first_discount_reservations to service_role;

create or replace function public.orders_reserve_first_discount()
returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
begin
  if new.referral_discount > 0 and new.referral_id is not null then
    insert into public.first_discount_reservations(user_id,referral_id,order_id)
    values(new.user_id,new.referral_id,new.id) on conflict(user_id) do nothing;
    if not exists(select 1 from public.first_discount_reservations
      where user_id=new.user_id and order_id=new.id) then
      new.amount:=new.amount+new.referral_discount;
      new.referral_discount:=0;
      new.referral_id:=null;
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.orders_reserve_first_discount() from public,anon,authenticated;
drop trigger if exists orders_01_discount_reserve on public.orders;
create trigger orders_01_discount_reserve before insert on public.orders
  for each row execute function public.orders_reserve_first_discount();

-- Keep the last applied pricing body intact; return the price actually stored by
-- the reservation trigger, since a competing checkout may lose the discount.
do $$ begin
  if to_regprocedure('public.create_priced_order_legacy(uuid,text,boolean)') is null then
    alter function public.create_priced_order(uuid,text,boolean) rename to create_priced_order_legacy;
  end if;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.create_priced_order_legacy(uuid,text,boolean) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role;
create or replace function public.create_priced_order(p_user_id uuid,p_product_id text,p_use_wallet boolean default false)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_result jsonb; v_order public.orders%rowtype;
begin
  v_result:=public.create_priced_order_legacy(p_user_id,p_product_id,p_use_wallet);
  if coalesce((v_result->>'ok')::boolean,false) then
    select * into v_order from public.orders where id=v_result->>'order_id';
    v_result:=v_result || jsonb_build_object('amount',v_order.amount,
      'referral_discount',v_order.referral_discount,'wallet_amount',v_order.wallet_amount);
  end if;
  return v_result;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.create_priced_order(uuid,text,boolean) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.create_priced_order(uuid,text,boolean) to service_role;

do $$ begin
  if to_regprocedure('public.quote_my_order_legacy(text,boolean)') is null then
    alter function public.quote_my_order(text,boolean) rename to quote_my_order_legacy;
  end if;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.quote_my_order_legacy(text,boolean) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role;
create or replace function public.quote_my_order(p_product_id text,p_use_wallet boolean default false)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_result jsonb; v_discount numeric;
begin
  v_result:=public.quote_my_order_legacy(p_product_id,p_use_wallet);
  if coalesce((v_result->>'ok')::boolean,false) and exists
    (select 1 from public.first_discount_reservations where user_id=auth.uid()) then
    v_discount:=coalesce((v_result->>'referral_discount')::numeric,0);
    if v_discount>0 then
      v_result:=v_result || jsonb_build_object('referral_discount',0,
        'amount',(v_result->>'amount')::numeric+v_discount);
    end if;
  end if;
  return v_result;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.quote_my_order(text,boolean) from public,anon;
grant execute on function public.quote_my_order(text,boolean) to authenticated,service_role;

create or replace function public.record_provider_event(
  p_event_id text,p_event_type text,p_razorpay_order_id text,p_payment_id text,
  p_provider_object_id text,p_payload_hash text,p_provider_time timestamptz)
returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_hash text;
begin
  if p_event_id is null or p_event_id='' or p_event_type is null or p_event_type=''
    or p_payload_hash !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' then raise exception 'invalid provider event'; end if;
  insert into public.provider_events(event_id,event_type,razorpay_order_id,payment_id,
    provider_object_id,payload_hash,provider_time)
  values(p_event_id,p_event_type,p_razorpay_order_id,p_payment_id,p_provider_object_id,p_payload_hash,p_provider_time)
  on conflict(event_id) do nothing;
  select payload_hash into v_hash from public.provider_events where event_id=p_event_id;
  if v_hash is distinct from p_payload_hash then raise exception 'provider event id reused with another payload'; end if;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.record_provider_event(text,text,text,text,text,text,timestamptz) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.record_provider_event(text,text,text,text,text,text,timestamptz) to service_role;

create or replace function public.record_payment_capture(
  p_payment_id text,p_razorpay_order_id text,p_amount_paise bigint,p_provider_time timestamptz)
returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_order_id text; v_capture public.payment_captures%rowtype;
begin
  if p_payment_id is null or p_razorpay_order_id is null or p_amount_paise is null or p_amount_paise<=0
    then raise exception 'invalid capture'; end if;
  select id into v_order_id from public.orders where razorpay_order_id=p_razorpay_order_id;
  insert into public.payment_captures(payment_id,razorpay_order_id,order_id,amount_paise,provider_time)
  values(p_payment_id,p_razorpay_order_id,v_order_id,p_amount_paise,p_provider_time)
  on conflict(payment_id) do update set provider_time=coalesce(public.payment_captures.provider_time,excluded.provider_time),
    order_id=coalesce(public.payment_captures.order_id,excluded.order_id);
  select * into v_capture from public.payment_captures where payment_id=p_payment_id;
  if v_capture.razorpay_order_id<>p_razorpay_order_id or v_capture.amount_paise<>p_amount_paise
    then raise exception 'capture identity mismatch'; end if;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.record_payment_capture(text,text,bigint,timestamptz) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.record_payment_capture(text,text,bigint,timestamptz) to service_role;

-- The old settlement remains an internal implementation. This wrapper records
-- a real capture even when its entitlement subtransaction raises, and serializes
-- reversal checks against the grant on the same order row.
do $$ begin
  if to_regprocedure('public.settle_razorpay_payment_legacy(text,text,text,bigint,timestamptz)') is null then
    alter function public.settle_razorpay_payment(text,text,text,bigint,timestamptz) rename to settle_razorpay_payment_legacy;
  end if;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.settle_razorpay_payment_legacy(text,text,text,bigint,timestamptz) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role;
create or replace function public.settle_razorpay_payment(
  p_event_id text,p_razorpay_order_id text,p_razorpay_payment_id text,
  p_amount_paise bigint,p_paid_at timestamptz default null)
returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_order public.orders%rowtype; v_capture public.payment_captures%rowtype;
  v_reason text; v_reversal boolean; v_error text;
begin
  select * into v_order from public.orders where razorpay_order_id=p_razorpay_order_id for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'Razorpay order is not linked'; end if;
  if round(v_order.amount*100)::bigint<>p_amount_paise then raise exception 'capture amount mismatch'; end if;
  perform public.record_payment_capture(p_razorpay_payment_id,p_razorpay_order_id,p_amount_paise,null);
  select * into v_capture from public.payment_captures where payment_id=p_razorpay_payment_id for update;
  if v_capture.status in ('compensation_pending','compensated') then return; end if;
  if v_order.user_id is not null then
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || v_order.user_id::text,0));
  end if;
  select v_capture.status='reversed' or exists(select 1 from public.provider_events where payment_id=p_razorpay_payment_id
    and event_type in ('refund.processed','payment.dispute.created','payment.dispute.under_review',
      'payment.dispute.action_required','payment.dispute.lost') and status in ('pending','applied')) into v_reversal;
  if v_reversal then v_reason:='reversal_received';
  elsif v_order.user_id is null then v_reason:='account_deleted';
  elsif v_order.referral_discount>0 and (v_order.status in ('cancelled','failed')
      or (v_order.expires_at is not null and coalesce(p_paid_at,now())>v_order.expires_at)) then
    v_reason:='stale_discount';
  elsif v_order.referral_discount>0 and not exists(select 1 from public.first_discount_reservations
      where order_id=v_order.id and user_id=v_order.user_id) then v_reason:='discount_reused';
  elsif exists(select 1 from public.purchases where user_id=v_order.user_id
      and product_id=v_order.product_id and status='success' and order_id is distinct from v_order.id) then
    v_reason:='already_owned';
  elsif v_order.amount<>v_order.list_price-v_order.referral_discount-v_order.wallet_amount then
    v_reason:='underpriced_order';
  end if;
  if v_reason is null then
    begin
      perform public.settle_razorpay_payment_legacy(p_event_id,p_razorpay_order_id,
        p_razorpay_payment_id,p_amount_paise,p_paid_at);
    exception when others then
      v_error:=sqlerrm;
      if v_error like 'wallet shortfall:%' then v_reason:='wallet_shortfall';
      else raise; end if;
    end;
  end if;
  if v_reason is not null then
    update public.orders set status=case when v_reversal then 'refunded' else 'paid' end,
      razorpay_payment_id=p_razorpay_payment_id, updated_at=now(),
      payment_completed_at=coalesce(payment_completed_at,clock_timestamp())
      where id=v_order.id and status<>'refunded';
    insert into public.payment_compensations(payment_id,order_id,amount_paise,reason,refund_request_id)
      select p_razorpay_payment_id,v_order.id,p_amount_paise,v_reason,
        'medveda_comp_' || md5(p_razorpay_payment_id)
      where not v_reversal on conflict(payment_id) do nothing;
    update public.payment_captures set status=case when v_reversal then 'reversed' else 'compensation_pending' end,
      failure_reason=v_reason where payment_id=p_razorpay_payment_id;
  else
    update public.payment_captures set status='granted' where payment_id=p_razorpay_payment_id;
  end if;
  update public.orders set payment_provider_time=coalesce(payment_provider_time,v_capture.provider_time),
    payment_received_at=coalesce(payment_received_at,v_capture.received_at),
    payment_completed_at=coalesce(payment_completed_at,clock_timestamp()),
    payment_time_fallback=(v_capture.provider_time is null)
    where id=v_order.id;
  update public.provider_events set status='applied'
    where event_id=p_event_id and event_type='payment.captured';
end $$;
revoke all on function public.settle_razorpay_payment(text,text,text,bigint,timestamptz) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.settle_razorpay_payment(text,text,text,bigint,timestamptz) to service_role;

create or replace function public.grant_razorpay_payment(
  p_event_id text,p_razorpay_order_id text,p_razorpay_payment_id text,p_amount_paise bigint)
returns void language sql security definer set search_path=public as $$
  select public.settle_razorpay_payment(p_event_id,p_razorpay_order_id,
    p_razorpay_payment_id,p_amount_paise,null::timestamptz);
$$;
revoke all on function public.grant_razorpay_payment(text,text,text,bigint) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.grant_razorpay_payment(text,text,text,bigint) to service_role;
commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261014110000_payment_job_leases.sql =====
-- One lease/retry schedule for reporting, refunds, consumption and Play checks.
begin;
alter table public.orders add column if not exists play_last_attempt_at timestamptz;
create table if not exists public.payment_jobs (
  kind text not null check(kind in ('reports','refunds','consume','reconcile','compensate','events')),
  target_id text not null,
  status text not null default 'pending' check(status in ('pending','leased','done','parked')),
  deadline_at timestamptz not null,
  next_attempt_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  attempts integer not null default 0,
  lease_id uuid,
  lease_until timestamptz,
  last_error text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
  primary key(kind,target_id)
);
create index if not exists payment_jobs_due_idx on public.payment_jobs(kind,next_attempt_at,deadline_at)
  where status in ('pending','leased');
alter table public.payment_jobs enable row level security;
revoke all on public.payment_jobs from public,anon,authenticated;
grant all on public.payment_jobs to service_role;

create or replace function public.enqueue_payment_jobs() returns void
language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
begin
  insert into public.payment_jobs(kind,target_id,deadline_at)
  select 'reports',o.id,coalesce(o.payment_provider_time,o.payment_completed_at,o.created_at)+interval '24 hours'
  from public.orders o where o.external_transaction_token is not null
    and o.external_report_status in ('pending','failed') and o.status in ('paid','refunded')
  on conflict(kind,target_id) do update set deadline_at=excluded.deadline_at;
  insert into public.payment_jobs(kind,target_id,deadline_at)
  select 'refunds',r.refund_id,r.refund_time+interval '24 hours'
  from public.ucb_external_refunds r where r.status in ('pending','failed','processing')
  on conflict(kind,target_id) do nothing;
  insert into public.payment_jobs(kind,target_id,deadline_at)
  select 'consume',o.id,coalesce(o.payment_completed_at,o.created_at)+interval '24 hours'
  from public.orders o where o.provider='play' and o.status='paid'
    and o.play_consumption_status in ('pending','failed')
  on conflict(kind,target_id) do nothing;
  insert into public.payment_jobs(kind,target_id,deadline_at)
  select 'reconcile',o.id,coalesce(o.play_last_checked_at,o.created_at)+interval '2 hours'
  from public.orders o where o.provider='play' and o.status='paid' and o.purchase_token is not null
    and (o.play_last_checked_at is null or o.play_last_checked_at<now()-interval '2 hours')
  on conflict(kind,target_id) do update set status='pending', next_attempt_at=now(),
    deadline_at=excluded.deadline_at, attempts=0, lease_id=null, lease_until=null
    where public.payment_jobs.status='done';
  insert into public.payment_jobs(kind,target_id,deadline_at)
  select 'compensate',c.payment_id,c.created_at+interval '24 hours'
  from public.payment_compensations c where c.status in ('pending','processing')
  on conflict(kind,target_id) do nothing;
  insert into public.payment_jobs(kind,target_id,deadline_at)
  select 'events',e.event_id,e.received_at+interval '24 hours'
  from public.provider_events e where e.status='pending' and e.payment_id is not null
    and exists(select 1 from public.orders o where o.razorpay_payment_id=e.payment_id)
    and e.event_type in ('refund.processed','payment.dispute.created','payment.dispute.under_review',
      'payment.dispute.action_required','payment.dispute.won','payment.dispute.lost','payment.dispute.closed')
  on conflict(kind,target_id) do nothing;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.enqueue_payment_jobs() from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.enqueue_payment_jobs() to service_role;

create or replace function public.claim_payment_jobs(p_kind text,p_limit integer default 40)
returns table(target_id text,lease_id uuid,attempts integer)
language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
begin
  if p_kind not in ('reports','refunds','consume','reconcile','compensate','events')
    or p_limit<1 or p_limit>40 then raise exception 'invalid job claim'; end if;
  return query with due as (
    select j.kind,j.target_id from public.payment_jobs j
    where j.kind=p_kind and j.next_attempt_at<=now()
      and (j.status='pending' or (j.status='leased' and j.lease_until<now()))
    order by j.deadline_at,j.created_at,j.target_id
    for update skip locked limit p_limit
  ), claimed as (
    update public.payment_jobs j set status='leased',lease_id=gen_random_uuid(),
      lease_until=now()+interval '3 minutes',attempts=j.attempts+1
    from due d where j.kind=d.kind and j.target_id=d.target_id
    returning j.target_id,j.lease_id,j.attempts
  ) select c.target_id,c.lease_id,c.attempts from claimed c;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.claim_payment_jobs(text,integer) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.claim_payment_jobs(text,integer) to service_role;

create or replace function public.finish_payment_job(
  p_kind text,p_target_id text,p_lease_id uuid,p_success boolean,p_error text default null)
returns text language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_attempts integer; v_status text;
begin
  select attempts into v_attempts from public.payment_jobs
    where kind=p_kind and target_id=p_target_id and lease_id=p_lease_id and status='leased' for update;
  if not found then return 'lease_lost'; end if;
  v_status:=case when p_success then 'done' when v_attempts>=12 then 'parked' else 'pending' end;
  update public.payment_jobs set status=v_status,lease_id=null,lease_until=null,
    last_error=case when p_success then null else left(coalesce(p_error,'failed'),300) end,
    next_attempt_at=case when p_success then now() else
      now()+make_interval(secs=>least(3600,60*power(2,least(v_attempts-1,6)))::integer) end
    where kind=p_kind and target_id=p_target_id;
  return v_status;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.finish_payment_job(text,text,uuid,boolean,text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.finish_payment_job(text,text,uuid,boolean,text) to service_role;

create or replace view public.payment_queue_metrics as
select kind,count(*) filter(where status in ('pending','leased')) as backlog_count,
  min(created_at) filter(where status in ('pending','leased')) as oldest_queued_at,
  min(deadline_at) filter(where status in ('pending','leased')) as oldest_deadline_at,
  ceil(count(*) filter(where status in ('pending','leased'))::numeric/40)*60 as estimated_drain_seconds,
  count(*) filter(where status='parked') as parked_count
from public.payment_jobs group by kind;
revoke all on public.payment_queue_metrics from public,anon,authenticated;
grant select on public.payment_queue_metrics to service_role;
commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261015100000_play_payment_jobs.sql =====
-- Play-only recovery. Depends on migrations through 20261013110000 only.
-- Deliberately independent of payment_jobs and all Razorpay/UCB queues.
begin;

alter table public.orders add column if not exists play_last_attempt_at timestamptz;

create table public.play_payment_jobs (
  kind text not null check (kind in ('consume','reconcile')),
  order_id text not null references public.orders(id) on delete cascade,
  status text not null default 'pending' check (status in ('pending','leased','done','parked')),
  attempts integer not null default 0 check (attempts >= 0),
  next_attempt_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  lease_id uuid,
  lease_until timestamptz,
  last_error text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (kind,order_id),
  check ((status = 'leased') = (lease_id is not null and lease_until is not null))
);
create index play_payment_jobs_due_idx on public.play_payment_jobs(kind,next_attempt_at,created_at)
  where status in ('pending','leased');
alter table public.play_payment_jobs enable row level security;
revoke all on public.play_payment_jobs from public,anon,authenticated;
grant all on public.play_payment_jobs to service_role;

-- Retain observed void tokens so a void that precedes local settlement is not
-- lost when the Google page cursor advances. Tokens are service-role only.
create table public.play_void_tokens (
  purchase_token text primary key,
  first_seen_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
alter table public.play_void_tokens enable row level security;
revoke all on public.play_void_tokens from public,anon,authenticated;
grant all on public.play_void_tokens to service_role;

create function public.record_play_void_tokens(p_tokens text[]) returns void
language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
begin
  if p_tokens is null or cardinality(p_tokens)>40 or exists (
    select 1 from unnest(p_tokens) t where t is null or length(t)<10 or length(t)>4096
  ) then raise exception 'invalid Play void tokens'; end if;
  insert into public.play_void_tokens(purchase_token)
  select distinct t from unnest(p_tokens) t on conflict do nothing;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.record_play_void_tokens(text[]) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.record_play_void_tokens(text[]) to service_role;

create function public.enqueue_play_payment_jobs() returns void
language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
begin
  insert into public.play_payment_jobs(kind,order_id)
  select 'consume',o.id from public.orders o
  where o.provider='play' and o.status='paid' and o.purchase_token is not null
    and o.play_consumption_status in ('pending','failed')
  on conflict do nothing;

  insert into public.play_payment_jobs(kind,order_id)
  select 'reconcile',o.id from public.orders o
  where o.provider='play' and o.status='paid' and o.purchase_token is not null
    and (o.play_last_checked_at is null or o.play_last_checked_at < now()-interval '2 hours')
  on conflict (kind,order_id) do update set status='pending',attempts=0,
    next_attempt_at=now(),lease_id=null,lease_until=null,last_error=null,updated_at=now()
  where public.play_payment_jobs.status='done';
end $$;
revoke all on function public.enqueue_play_payment_jobs() from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.enqueue_play_payment_jobs() to service_role;

create function public.claim_play_payment_jobs(p_kind text,p_limit integer default 20)
returns table(order_id text,lease_id uuid,attempts integer)
language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
begin
  if p_kind not in ('consume','reconcile') or p_limit < 1 or p_limit > 20 then
    raise exception 'invalid Play job claim';
  end if;
  return query with due as (
    select j.kind,j.order_id from public.play_payment_jobs j
    where j.kind=p_kind and j.next_attempt_at<=now()
      and (j.status='pending' or (j.status='leased' and j.lease_until<now()))
    order by j.next_attempt_at,j.created_at,j.order_id
    for update skip locked limit p_limit
  ), claimed as (
    update public.play_payment_jobs j set status='leased',lease_id=gen_random_uuid(),
      lease_until=now()+interval '3 minutes',attempts=j.attempts+1,updated_at=now()
    from due d where j.kind=d.kind and j.order_id=d.order_id
    returning j.order_id,j.lease_id,j.attempts
  ) select c.order_id,c.lease_id,c.attempts from claimed c;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.claim_play_payment_jobs(text,integer) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.claim_play_payment_jobs(text,integer) to service_role;

create function public.finish_play_payment_job(p_kind text,p_order_id text,p_lease_id uuid,
  p_success boolean,p_error text default null) returns text
language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_attempts integer; v_status text;
begin
  select attempts into v_attempts from public.play_payment_jobs
    where kind=p_kind and order_id=p_order_id and lease_id=p_lease_id
      and status='leased' and lease_until>now() for update;
  if not found then return 'lease_lost'; end if;
  v_status:=case when p_success then 'done' when v_attempts>=12 then 'parked' else 'pending' end;
  update public.play_payment_jobs set status=v_status,lease_id=null,lease_until=null,
    last_error=case when p_success then null else left(coalesce(p_error,'failed'),300) end,
    next_attempt_at=case when p_success then now() else
      now()+make_interval(secs=>least(3600,60*power(2,least(v_attempts-1,6)))::integer) end,
    updated_at=now() where kind=p_kind and order_id=p_order_id;
  return v_status;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.finish_play_payment_job(text,text,uuid,boolean,text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.finish_play_payment_job(text,text,uuid,boolean,text) to service_role;

create table public.play_recovery_cursor (
  id boolean primary key default true check(id),
  start_time_ms bigint not null,
  end_time_ms bigint not null,
  next_page_token text,
  lease_id uuid,
  lease_until timestamptz,
  attempts integer not null default 0,
  next_attempt_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  last_error text,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  check ((lease_id is null) = (lease_until is null))
);
insert into public.play_recovery_cursor(id,start_time_ms,end_time_ms)
values(true,(extract(epoch from now())*1000)::bigint-86400000,
  (extract(epoch from now())*1000)::bigint);
alter table public.play_recovery_cursor enable row level security;
revoke all on public.play_recovery_cursor from public,anon,authenticated;
grant all on public.play_recovery_cursor to service_role;

create function public.claim_play_recovery_cursor() returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v public.play_recovery_cursor%rowtype;
begin
  update public.play_recovery_cursor set lease_id=gen_random_uuid(),
    lease_until=now()+interval '3 minutes',updated_at=now()
  where id=true and next_attempt_at<=now() and (lease_until is null or lease_until<now())
  returning * into v;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','busy'); end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'lease_id',v.lease_id,'start_time_ms',v.start_time_ms,
    'end_time_ms',v.end_time_ms,'next_page_token',v.next_page_token);
end $$;
revoke all on function public.claim_play_recovery_cursor() from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.claim_play_recovery_cursor() to service_role;

create function public.finish_play_recovery_cursor(p_lease_id uuid,p_success boolean,
  p_next_page_token text default null,p_error text default null) returns text
language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v public.play_recovery_cursor%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v from public.play_recovery_cursor where id=true and lease_id=p_lease_id
    and lease_until>now() for update;
  if not found then return 'lease_lost'; end if;
  if p_success then
    update public.play_recovery_cursor set
      start_time_ms=case when p_next_page_token is null then greatest(v.start_time_ms,v.end_time_ms-3600000) else v.start_time_ms end,
      end_time_ms=case when p_next_page_token is null then (extract(epoch from now())*1000)::bigint else v.end_time_ms end,
      next_page_token=p_next_page_token,lease_id=null,lease_until=null,attempts=0,
      next_attempt_at=now(),last_error=null,updated_at=now() where id=true;
    return 'done';
  end if;
  update public.play_recovery_cursor set lease_id=null,lease_until=null,attempts=v.attempts+1,
    next_attempt_at=now()+make_interval(secs=>least(3600,60*power(2,least(v.attempts,6)))::integer),
    last_error=left(coalesce(p_error,'failed'),300),updated_at=now() where id=true;
  return 'retry';
end $$;
revoke all on function public.finish_play_recovery_cursor(uuid,boolean,text,text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.finish_play_recovery_cursor(uuid,boolean,text,text) to service_role;

create view public.play_recovery_metrics as
select (select count(*) from public.play_payment_jobs where status in ('pending','leased')) as backlog_count,
  (select count(*) from public.play_payment_jobs where status='parked') as parked_count,
  (select min(created_at) from public.play_payment_jobs where status in ('pending','leased')) as oldest_job_at,
  (extract(epoch from now())*1000-c.end_time_ms)/1000 as cursor_lag_seconds,
  c.attempts as cursor_failures,c.last_error as cursor_error
from public.play_recovery_cursor c where c.id=true;
revoke all on public.play_recovery_metrics from public,anon,authenticated;
grant select on public.play_recovery_metrics to service_role;
commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261015120000_play_entitlement_order_snapshot.sql =====
-- A Play order snapshots the selected Notes entitlement when checkout begins.
-- Use that snapshot if catalog metadata changes before a delayed purchase settles.
-- Razorpay rows and existing purchase records are untouched.
begin;

create function public.play_purchase_entitlement_from_order()
returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_order public.orders%rowtype;
begin
  if new.order_id is null then return new; end if;
  select * into v_order from public.orders where id=new.order_id;
  if not found or v_order.provider <> 'play' then return new; end if;
  if new.user_id is distinct from v_order.user_id
     or new.product_id is distinct from v_order.product_id
     or new.amount is distinct from v_order.amount
     or v_order.scope not in ('chapter','subject','year','bundle') then
    raise exception 'Play purchase does not match order entitlement';
  end if;
  new.scope:=v_order.scope;
  new.chapter_id:=v_order.chapter_id;
  new.subject_id:=v_order.subject_id;
  new.year_id:=v_order.year_id;
  new.year_ids:=v_order.year_ids;
  new.course_id:=v_order.course_id;
  return new;
end $$;

revoke all on function public.play_purchase_entitlement_from_order() from public,anon,authenticated;
create trigger purchases_play_order_snapshot before insert on public.purchases
  for each row execute function public.play_purchase_entitlement_from_order();

commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261016090000_free_video_access.sql =====
-- All educational videos are free. Keep the existing signed-link endpoint

begin;
