returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path=public as $$
  select p_user is not null
    and exists(select 1 from public.profiles pr where pr.id=p_user and not coalesce(pr.blocked,false))
    and exists(select 1 from public.videos v where v.id=p_video_id and v.active);
$$;
revoke all on function public.user_can_access_video(uuid,text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.user_can_access_video(uuid,text) to service_role;
commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261016100000_play_catalog_sync.sql =====
-- Review before applying. No product prices or existing purchase records are changed.
begin;

-- A price can have several historical SKUs. Orders retain the SKU they bought.
alter table public.play_price_tiers drop constraint if exists play_price_tiers_pkey;
alter table public.play_price_tiers add primary key (play_sku);
alter table public.play_price_tiers add column if not exists purchase_option_id text;
alter table public.play_price_tiers add column if not exists currency_code text not null default 'INR';
alter table public.play_price_tiers add column if not exists region_code text not null default 'IN';
alter table public.play_price_tiers add column if not exists verified_at timestamptz;
alter table public.play_price_tiers drop constraint if exists play_price_tiers_play_sku_check;
create unique index if not exists play_one_active_verified_tier_per_price
  on public.play_price_tiers (price_inr) where active and verified_at is not null;
-- The existing (kind, order_id) primary key cannot serve order_id-only
-- lookups or the foreign-key check when an order is removed.
create index if not exists play_payment_jobs_order_id_idx
  on public.play_payment_jobs (order_id);

create table public.play_price_sync (
  price_inr numeric(10,2) primary key check (price_inr > 0),
  status text not null default 'pending' check (status in ('pending','running','ready','failed')),
  candidate_sku text not null unique,
  purchase_option_id text not null default 'buy',
  attempts integer not null default 0,
  next_attempt_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  lease_id uuid,
  lease_until timestamptz,
  last_error text,
  last_synced_at timestamptz,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create table public.play_price_sync_logs (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  price_inr numeric(10,2) not null,
  play_sku text not null,
  event text not null check (event in ('queued','claimed','verified','retry','failed','rotated')),
  detail text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index play_price_sync_due on public.play_price_sync(next_attempt_at) where status in ('pending','running');
create index play_price_sync_logs_price on public.play_price_sync_logs(price_inr, created_at desc);
alter table public.play_price_sync enable row level security;
alter table public.play_price_sync_logs enable row level security;
revoke all on public.play_price_sync, public.play_price_sync_logs from public, anon, authenticated;
grant all on public.play_price_sync, public.play_price_sync_logs to service_role;
grant usage, select on sequence public.play_price_sync_logs_id_seq to service_role;

-- A Play product sells paid PDFs only. Scope links to notes through chapters;
-- videos have no product relationship. An explicit Admin classification is
-- required, including for legacy rows whose default product_type is 'other'.
create or replace function public.play_notes_product_eligible(p public.products)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path=public as $$
  select p.active and p.price > 0 and p.course_id is not null
    and ((p.scope in ('chapter','subject','year') and p.product_type='notes')
      or (p.scope='bundle' and p.product_type='notes_bundle'
        and cardinality(p.year_ids) between 2 and 3))
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.notes n join public.chapters c on c.id=n.chapter_id
        join public.subjects s on s.id=c.subject_id join public.years y on y.id=s.year_id
      where n.active and not n.is_free_preview and nullif(btrim(n.pdf_url),'') is not null
        and c.active and s.active and y.active
        and c.course_id=p.course_id and s.course_id=p.course_id and y.course_id=p.course_id
        and ((p.scope='chapter' and c.id=p.chapter_id)
          or (p.scope='subject' and c.subject_id=p.subject_id)
          or (p.scope='year' and c.year_id=p.year_id)
          or (p.scope='bundle' and c.year_id=any(p.year_ids)))
    )
    and (p.scope<>'bundle' or (
      select count(distinct c.year_id) from public.notes n
        join public.chapters c on c.id=n.chapter_id
        join public.subjects s on s.id=c.subject_id join public.years y on y.id=s.year_id
      where n.active and not n.is_free_preview and nullif(btrim(n.pdf_url),'') is not null
        and c.active and s.active and y.active
        and c.course_id=p.course_id and s.course_id=p.course_id and y.course_id=p.course_id
        and c.year_id=any(p.year_ids)
    )=cardinality(p.year_ids));
$$;
revoke all on function public.play_notes_product_eligible(public.products) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.play_notes_product_eligible(public.products) to service_role,authenticated;

create or replace function public.play_price_has_eligible_product(p_price numeric)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path=public as $$
  select exists(select 1 from public.products p where p.price=p_price
    and public.play_notes_product_eligible(p));
$$;
revoke all on function public.play_price_has_eligible_product(numeric) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.play_price_has_eligible_product(numeric) to service_role;

-- Legacy 'other' rows remain unchanged and are excluded by the eligibility
-- helper. Owner classification can happen after this migration is deployed.

create or replace function public.queue_play_price_sync(p_price numeric)
returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare v_sku text;
begin
  if p_price is null or p_price <= 0 then return; end if;
  select play_sku into v_sku from public.play_price_tiers
    where price_inr = p_price and active order by created_at desc limit 1;
  if v_sku is null then
    v_sku := 'notes_' || replace(p_price::numeric(10,2)::text, '.', '_') || '_v_' || replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', '');
  end if;
  insert into public.play_price_sync(price_inr, candidate_sku)
    values (p_price, v_sku)
    on conflict(price_inr) do update set
      status = case when public.play_price_sync.status = 'ready' then 'ready' else 'pending' end,
      next_attempt_at = case when public.play_price_sync.status = 'ready' then public.play_price_sync.next_attempt_at else now() end,
      updated_at = now();
  insert into public.play_price_sync_logs(price_inr, play_sku, event)
    values(p_price, v_sku, 'queued');
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.queue_play_price_sync(numeric) from public, anon, authenticated;
-- This trigger does not change products.active or products.price.
create or replace function public.queue_product_play_price()
returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    if public.play_notes_product_eligible(new) then perform public.queue_play_price_sync(new.price); end if;
  elsif public.play_notes_product_eligible(new) and
      (new.price is distinct from old.price or new.active is distinct from old.active
       or new.product_type is distinct from old.product_type or new.scope is distinct from old.scope
       or new.chapter_id is distinct from old.chapter_id or new.subject_id is distinct from old.subject_id
       or new.year_id is distinct from old.year_id or new.year_ids is distinct from old.year_ids) then
    perform public.queue_play_price_sync(new.price);
  end if;
  return new;
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.queue_product_play_price() from public, anon, authenticated;
create trigger products_queue_play_price after insert or update of price, active, product_type, scope,
  chapter_id, subject_id, year_id, year_ids on public.products
  for each row execute function public.queue_product_play_price();

-- A product may be classified before its first paid PDF is published.
create or replace function public.queue_notes_play_price()
returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
begin
  if new.active and not new.is_free_preview then
    perform public.queue_play_price_sync(p.price)
      from public.products p join public.chapters c on c.id=new.chapter_id
      where public.play_notes_product_eligible(p) and c.course_id=p.course_id
        and ((p.scope='chapter' and p.chapter_id=c.id)
          or (p.scope='subject' and p.subject_id=c.subject_id)
          or (p.scope='year' and p.year_id=c.year_id)
          or (p.scope='bundle' and c.year_id=any(p.year_ids)));
  end if;
  return new;
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.queue_notes_play_price() from public,anon,authenticated;
create trigger notes_queue_play_price after insert or update of active,is_free_preview,chapter_id,pdf_url on public.notes
  for each row execute function public.queue_notes_play_price();

-- Only authenticated admins can request a safe recheck; no browser gets service credentials.
create or replace function public.retry_play_price_sync(p_price numeric)
returns boolean language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
begin
  if not public.am_i_admin() then raise exception 'Admin access required' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  if not exists(select 1 from public.products p where p.price=p_price
    and public.play_notes_product_eligible(p)) then return false; end if;
  update public.play_price_sync set status='pending', next_attempt_at=now(), last_error=null, updated_at=now()
    where price_inr=p_price and (lease_until is null or lease_until < now());
  if not found then return false; end if;
  insert into public.play_price_sync_logs(price_inr,play_sku,event,detail)
    select price_inr,candidate_sku,'queued','admin retry' from public.play_price_sync where price_inr=p_price;
  return true;
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.retry_play_price_sync(numeric) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.retry_play_price_sync(numeric) to authenticated;

create or replace function public.claim_play_price_sync()
returns table(price_inr numeric, candidate_sku text, purchase_option_id text, lease_id uuid)
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare v_row public.play_price_sync%rowtype; v_lease uuid := gen_random_uuid();
begin
  select * into v_row from public.play_price_sync s
    where ((s.status = 'pending' and s.next_attempt_at <= now())
       or (s.status='running' and s.lease_until < now()))
    and exists(select 1 from public.products p where p.price=s.price_inr
      and public.play_notes_product_eligible(p))
    order by s.next_attempt_at, s.price_inr for update skip locked limit 1;
  if not found then return; end if;
  update public.play_price_sync s set status='running', lease_id=v_lease,
    lease_until=now()+interval '3 minutes', attempts=s.attempts+1, updated_at=now()
    where s.price_inr=v_row.price_inr;
  insert into public.play_price_sync_logs(price_inr,play_sku,event)
    values(v_row.price_inr,v_row.candidate_sku,'claimed');
  price_inr:=v_row.price_inr; candidate_sku:=v_row.candidate_sku;
  purchase_option_id:=v_row.purchase_option_id; lease_id:=v_lease;
  return next;
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.claim_play_price_sync() from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.claim_play_price_sync() to service_role;

create or replace function public.requeue_stale_play_price_sync()
returns integer language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_count integer;
begin
  update public.play_price_sync s set status='pending',next_attempt_at=now(),updated_at=now()
    where s.status='ready' and s.last_synced_at < now()-interval '24 hours'
      and exists(select 1 from public.products p where p.price=s.price_inr
        and public.play_notes_product_eligible(p));
  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
  return v_count;
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.requeue_stale_play_price_sync() from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.requeue_stale_play_price_sync() to service_role;

-- A reused or externally modified SKU is never repriced. Reserve a fresh version.
create or replace function public.rotate_play_price_sku(p_price numeric,p_lease uuid,p_reason text)
returns text language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_new text;
begin
  v_new := 'notes_' || replace(p_price::numeric(10,2)::text, '.', '_') || '_v_' || replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', '');
  update public.play_price_sync set candidate_sku=v_new, updated_at=now()
    where price_inr=p_price and lease_id=p_lease and status='running' and lease_until>now();
  if not found then raise exception 'Play sync lease lost'; end if;
  update public.play_price_tiers set active=false where price_inr=p_price and active;
  insert into public.play_price_sync_logs(price_inr,play_sku,event,detail)
    values(p_price,v_new,'rotated',left(p_reason,200));
  return v_new;
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.rotate_play_price_sku(numeric,uuid,text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.rotate_play_price_sku(numeric,uuid,text) to service_role;

create or replace function public.finish_play_price_sync(p_price numeric,p_lease uuid,p_sku text,p_option text)
returns boolean language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
begin
  perform 1 from public.play_price_sync where price_inr=p_price and lease_id=p_lease
    and candidate_sku=p_sku and purchase_option_id=p_option and status='running' and lease_until>now() for update;
  if not found then return false; end if;
  if not exists(select 1 from public.products p where p.price=p_price
    and public.play_notes_product_eligible(p)) then return false; end if;
  update public.play_price_tiers set active=false where price_inr=p_price and play_sku<>p_sku and active;
  insert into public.play_price_tiers(price_inr,play_sku,active,purchase_option_id,currency_code,region_code,verified_at)
    values(p_price,p_sku,true,p_option,'INR','IN',now())
    on conflict(play_sku) do update set active=true,purchase_option_id=excluded.purchase_option_id,
      currency_code='INR',region_code='IN',verified_at=now();
  update public.play_price_sync set status='ready',lease_id=null,lease_until=null,last_error=null,
    last_synced_at=now(),updated_at=now() where price_inr=p_price;
  insert into public.play_price_sync_logs(price_inr,play_sku,event) values(p_price,p_sku,'verified');
  return true;
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.finish_play_price_sync(numeric,uuid,text,text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.finish_play_price_sync(numeric,uuid,text,text) to service_role;

create or replace function public.fail_play_price_sync(p_price numeric,p_lease uuid,p_reason text,p_retry boolean)
returns boolean language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_sku text; v_attempts integer;
begin
  select candidate_sku,attempts into v_sku,v_attempts from public.play_price_sync
    where price_inr=p_price and lease_id=p_lease and status='running' for update;
  if not found then return false; end if;
  update public.play_price_sync set status=case when p_retry and v_attempts<12 then 'pending' else 'failed' end,
    next_attempt_at=now()+make_interval(secs=>least(3600, 15 * power(2,least(v_attempts,8)))::integer),
    lease_id=null,lease_until=null,last_error=left(p_reason,300),updated_at=now() where price_inr=p_price;
  insert into public.play_price_sync_logs(price_inr,play_sku,event,detail)
    values(p_price,v_sku,case when p_retry and v_attempts<12 then 'retry' else 'failed' end,left(p_reason,300));
  return true;
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.fail_play_price_sync(numeric,uuid,text,boolean) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.fail_play_price_sync(numeric,uuid,text,boolean) to service_role;

-- Admin status is a read-only view. It never exposes credentials or purchase tokens.
create view public.admin_play_billing_status with (security_invoker=true) as
select p.id as product_id,p.title,p.price,p.active as catalog_active,
  case when not p.active then 'catalog_inactive'
       when not public.play_notes_product_eligible(p) then 'not_billable_notes'
       when p.price <= 0 then 'unsupported_price'
       when t.verified_at > now()-interval '24 hours' and t.active and s.status='ready' then 'ready'
       when s.status='ready' then 'stale'
       else coalesce(s.status,'pending') end as billing_status,
  t.play_sku,t.purchase_option_id,t.price_inr as synced_price,t.currency_code,
  s.last_synced_at,s.last_error,s.attempts
from public.products p
left join public.play_price_sync s on s.price_inr=p.price
left join public.play_price_tiers t on t.play_sku=s.candidate_sku and t.active and t.verified_at is not null
where public.am_i_admin();
revoke all on public.admin_play_billing_status from public,anon,authenticated;
grant select on public.admin_play_billing_status to authenticated;
-- The invoker still needs RLS access to the underlying restricted tier tables.
create policy admin_read_play_tiers on public.play_price_tiers for select to authenticated using (public.am_i_admin());
create policy admin_read_play_sync on public.play_price_sync for select to authenticated using (public.am_i_admin());
grant select on public.play_price_tiers,public.play_price_sync to authenticated;

-- Backfill by price only; all Admin product values remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
select public.queue_play_price_sync(price) from (
  select distinct p.price from public.products p where public.play_notes_product_eligible(p)
) eligible;

-- Override the order gate with a verified tier and snapshot its BUY option.
alter table public.orders add column if not exists play_purchase_option_id text;
create or replace function public.orders_play_option_immutable()
returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path=public as $$
begin
  if new.play_purchase_option_id is distinct from old.play_purchase_option_id then
    raise exception 'orders.play_purchase_option_id is immutable' using errcode='42501';
  end if;
  return new;
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.orders_play_option_immutable() from public,anon,authenticated;
create trigger orders_play_option_immutable before update on public.orders
  for each row execute function public.orders_play_option_immutable();
create or replace function public.create_play_order(p_user_id uuid, p_product_id text)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare v_product public.products%rowtype; v_profile public.profiles%rowtype;
  v_sku text; v_option text; v_order_id text := gen_random_uuid()::text; v_minutes integer;
begin
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || p_user_id::text, 0));
  select * into v_profile from public.profiles where id=p_user_id;
  if not found or v_profile.blocked then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','account_unavailable'); end if;
  select * into v_product from public.products where id=p_product_id and active;
  if not found or v_product.course_id is distinct from v_profile.course_id then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','product_unavailable'); end if;
  if not public.play_notes_product_eligible(v_product) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','not_billable_notes');
  end if;
  if exists(select 1 from public.purchases where user_id=p_user_id and product_id=p_product_id and status='success') then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','already_owned'); end if;
  select t.play_sku,t.purchase_option_id into v_sku,v_option
    from public.play_price_tiers t join public.play_price_sync s on s.candidate_sku=t.play_sku
    where t.price_inr=v_product.price and t.active and t.verified_at > now()-interval '24 hours'
      and t.currency_code='INR' and t.region_code='IN' and s.status='ready';
  if v_sku is null then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','price_tier_pending'); end if;
  select checkout_expiry_minutes into v_minutes from public.referral_settings where id=true;
  update public.orders set status='cancelled',updated_at=now() where user_id=p_user_id and status='created' and provider='play' and purchase_token is null;
  insert into public.orders(id,user_id,product_id,scope,chapter_id,subject_id,year_id,year_ids,course_id,
    amount,list_price,provider,play_sku,play_purchase_option_id,status,expires_at)
  values(v_order_id,p_user_id,p_product_id,v_product.scope,v_product.chapter_id,v_product.subject_id,v_product.year_id,
    v_product.year_ids,v_product.course_id,v_product.price,v_product.price,'play',v_sku,v_option,'created',now()+make_interval(mins=>coalesce(v_minutes,30)));
  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'order_id',v_order_id,'play_sku',v_sku,'purchase_option_id',v_option);
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.create_play_order(uuid,text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.create_play_order(uuid,text) to service_role;

commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261018100000_verified_quiz_attempts.sql =====
-- Server-scored MCQ attempts. Legacy quiz_scores rows remain readable but are
-- not migrated into verified results because their client scores are untrusted.
begin;

alter table public.quiz_tests
  add column if not exists question_revision bigint not null default 1;

create or replace function public.bump_quiz_question_revision()
returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
begin
  new.question_revision := old.question_revision +
    case when new.questions is distinct from old.questions then 1 else 0 end;
  return new;
end $$;
drop trigger if exists bump_quiz_question_revision on public.quiz_tests;
create trigger bump_quiz_question_revision before update on public.quiz_tests
  for each row execute function public.bump_quiz_question_revision();
revoke all on function public.bump_quiz_question_revision() from public, anon, authenticated;

create table if not exists public.verified_quiz_attempts (
  id text primary key check (length(id) between 8 and 160),
  user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  -- Preserve the source identity after an admin deletes an obsolete test;
  -- duplicate retries must still resolve to the original verified result.
  test_id text not null,
  test_title text not null,
  subject_id text,
  question_revision bigint not null,
  answers jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(answers) = 'array'),
  score integer not null check (score >= 0),
  total integer not null check (total > 0 and score <= total),
  percentage integer not null check (percentage between 0 and 100),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists verified_quiz_attempts_user_recent_idx
  on public.verified_quiz_attempts(user_id, created_at desc);
create index if not exists verified_quiz_attempts_test_idx
  on public.verified_quiz_attempts(test_id);
alter table public.verified_quiz_attempts enable row level security;
revoke all on public.verified_quiz_attempts from public, anon, authenticated;
grant select on public.verified_quiz_attempts to authenticated;
drop policy if exists verified_quiz_attempts_read on public.verified_quiz_attempts;
create policy verified_quiz_attempts_read on public.verified_quiz_attempts
  for select to authenticated
  using (user_id = (select auth.uid()) or (select public.am_i_admin()));

create or replace function public.submit_quiz_attempt(
  p_attempt_id text, p_test_id text, p_question_revision bigint, p_answers jsonb
) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare
  v_user uuid := auth.uid();
  v_test public.quiz_tests%rowtype;
  v_existing public.verified_quiz_attempts%rowtype;
  v_question jsonb;
  v_selected jsonb;
  v_option_index integer;
  v_total integer;
  v_score integer := 0;
  v_i integer;
begin
  if v_user is null then
    raise exception 'Sign in required' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if not exists (select 1 from public.profiles where id = v_user and not coalesce(blocked, false)) then
    raise exception 'Account unavailable' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if p_attempt_id is null or length(p_attempt_id) not between 8 and 160
     or p_test_id is null or p_question_revision is null
     or p_answers is null or jsonb_typeof(p_answers) <> 'array' then
    raise exception 'Invalid attempt' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  -- A dropped response can be retried even after the test has since changed.
  select * into v_existing from public.verified_quiz_attempts where id = p_attempt_id;
  if found then
    if v_existing.user_id <> v_user or v_existing.test_id is distinct from p_test_id
       or v_existing.question_revision <> p_question_revision or v_existing.answers <> p_answers then
      raise exception 'Attempt id belongs to another submission' using errcode = '23505';
    end if;
    return jsonb_build_object('status','verified','score',v_existing.score,
      'total',v_existing.total,'percentage',v_existing.percentage);
  end if;

  if not public.rate_limit_hit('verified-quiz:' || v_user::text, 120, 3600) then
    return jsonb_build_object('status','rate_limited');
  end if;

  select * into v_test from public.quiz_tests where id = p_test_id and active;
  if not found or not exists (
    select 1 from public.subjects s where s.id = v_test.subject_id
      and s.year_id = v_test.year_id and s.course_id = v_test.course_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'Test unavailable' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  if v_test.question_revision <> p_question_revision then
    return jsonb_build_object('status','stale');
  end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(v_test.questions) <> 'array' then
    raise exception 'Test questions invalid' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  v_total := jsonb_array_length(v_test.questions);
  if v_total < 1 or v_total > 100 or jsonb_array_length(p_answers) <> v_total then
    raise exception 'Answer count mismatch' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  for v_i in 0..v_total-1 loop
    v_question := v_test.questions -> v_i;
    v_selected := p_answers -> v_i;
    if jsonb_typeof(v_question) <> 'object'
       or jsonb_typeof(v_question->'options') <> 'array'
       or jsonb_typeof(v_question->'answer') <> 'string'
       or jsonb_array_length(v_question->'options') < 2 then
      raise exception 'Test question invalid' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;
    if v_selected = 'null'::jsonb then continue; end if;
    if jsonb_typeof(v_selected) <> 'number' or (v_selected #>> '{}') !~ '^[0-9]+$' then
      raise exception 'Answer index invalid' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;
    v_option_index := (v_selected #>> '{}')::integer;
    if v_option_index >= jsonb_array_length(v_question->'options') then
      raise exception 'Answer index out of range' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;
    if v_question->'options'->>v_option_index = v_question->>'answer' then
      v_score := v_score + 1;
    end if;
  end loop;

  insert into public.verified_quiz_attempts
    (id,user_id,test_id,test_title,subject_id,question_revision,answers,score,total,percentage)
  values (p_attempt_id,v_user,p_test_id,v_test.title,v_test.subject_id,p_question_revision,
    p_answers,v_score,v_total,round(v_score * 100.0 / v_total)::integer)
  on conflict (id) do nothing;

  select * into v_existing from public.verified_quiz_attempts where id = p_attempt_id;
  if v_existing.user_id <> v_user or v_existing.test_id is distinct from p_test_id
     or v_existing.question_revision <> p_question_revision or v_existing.answers <> p_answers then
    raise exception 'Attempt id belongs to another submission' using errcode = '23505';
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('status','verified','score',v_existing.score,
    'total',v_existing.total,'percentage',v_existing.percentage);
end $$;
revoke all on function public.submit_quiz_attempt(text,text,bigint,jsonb) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.submit_quiz_attempt(text,text,bigint,jsonb) to authenticated;

commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261018110000_trusted_note_uploads.sql =====
-- Keep existing PDF objects and note URLs intact. New uploads are recorded
-- before Storage is written and attached to a note in one database transaction.
begin;

alter table public.notes add column if not exists description text not null default '';

create table if not exists public.note_upload_requests (
  request_id uuid primary key,
  admin_user_id uuid not null,
  sha256 text not null check (sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  object_path text not null unique,
  pdf_url text not null,
  status text not null default 'reserved' check (status in ('reserved','uploaded','attached')),
  note_id text references public.notes(id) on delete set null,
  save_payload jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists note_upload_requests_unattached_idx
  on public.note_upload_requests(created_at) where status <> 'attached';
create index if not exists note_upload_requests_note_idx
  on public.note_upload_requests(note_id);
alter table public.note_upload_requests enable row level security;
revoke all on public.note_upload_requests from public, anon, authenticated;

-- Restrictive policies still apply if another permissive Storage policy exists.
-- Only the service role used by upload-note-pdf can write to this bucket.
drop policy if exists notes_server_insert_only on storage.objects;
create policy notes_server_insert_only on storage.objects as restrictive
  for insert to public with check (bucket_id <> 'notes');
drop policy if exists notes_server_update_only on storage.objects;
create policy notes_server_update_only on storage.objects as restrictive
  for update to public using (bucket_id <> 'notes') with check (bucket_id <> 'notes');
drop policy if exists notes_server_delete_only on storage.objects;
create policy notes_server_delete_only on storage.objects as restrictive
  for delete to public using (bucket_id <> 'notes');
update storage.buckets set public = false,
  file_size_limit = 52428800,
  allowed_mime_types = array['application/pdf']::text[]
where id = 'notes';

create or replace function public.save_note_with_upload(
  p_request_id uuid, p_note_id text, p_title text, p_description text,
  p_chapter_id text, p_order integer, p_active boolean, p_is_free_preview boolean
) returns text language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare
  v_upload public.note_upload_requests%rowtype;
  v_payload jsonb;
  v_note_id text;
begin
  if not public.am_i_admin() then
    raise exception 'Admin access required' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if p_request_id is null or p_title is null or length(btrim(p_title)) not between 1 and 200
     or p_description is null or length(p_description) > 2000
     or p_chapter_id is null or p_order is null or p_order < 1
     or p_active is null or p_is_free_preview is null then
    raise exception 'Invalid note data' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  v_payload := jsonb_build_object('note_id',p_note_id,'title',btrim(p_title),
    'description',p_description,'chapter_id',p_chapter_id,'order',p_order,
    'active',p_active,'is_free_preview',p_is_free_preview);
  select * into v_upload from public.note_upload_requests
    where request_id = p_request_id for update;
  if not found or v_upload.admin_user_id <> auth.uid() then
    raise exception 'Upload request unavailable' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if v_upload.status = 'attached' then
    if v_upload.save_payload is distinct from v_payload then
      raise exception 'Upload request already used for another note change' using errcode = '23505';
    end if;
    return v_upload.note_id;
  end if;
  if v_upload.status <> 'uploaded' then
    raise exception 'PDF upload is incomplete' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  if p_note_id is null then
    insert into public.notes(title,description,pdf_url,chapter_id,"order",active,is_free_preview)
    values(btrim(p_title),p_description,v_upload.pdf_url,p_chapter_id,p_order,p_active,p_is_free_preview)
    returning id into v_note_id;
  else
    update public.notes set title=btrim(p_title),description=p_description,
      pdf_url=v_upload.pdf_url,chapter_id=p_chapter_id,"order"=p_order,
      active=p_active,is_free_preview=p_is_free_preview
    where id=p_note_id returning id into v_note_id;
    if v_note_id is null then
      raise exception 'Note unavailable' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;
  end if;
  update public.note_upload_requests set status='attached',note_id=v_note_id,
    save_payload=v_payload,updated_at=now() where request_id=p_request_id;
  return v_note_id;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.save_note_with_upload(uuid,text,text,text,text,integer,boolean,boolean) from public,anon;
grant execute on function public.save_note_with_upload(uuid,text,text,text,text,integer,boolean,boolean) to authenticated;

commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261018120000_note_upload_deleted_retry.sql =====
-- Forward repair: never report success for an attached upload whose note was deleted.
begin;
create or replace function public.save_note_with_upload(
  p_request_id uuid, p_note_id text, p_title text, p_description text,
  p_chapter_id text, p_order integer, p_active boolean, p_is_free_preview boolean
) returns text language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare
  v_upload public.note_upload_requests%rowtype;
  v_payload jsonb;
  v_note_id text;
begin
  if not public.am_i_admin() then
    raise exception 'Admin access required' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if p_request_id is null or p_title is null or length(btrim(p_title)) not between 1 and 200
     or p_description is null or length(p_description) > 2000
     or p_chapter_id is null or p_order is null or p_order < 1
     or p_active is null or p_is_free_preview is null then
    raise exception 'Invalid note data' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  v_payload := jsonb_build_object('note_id',p_note_id,'title',btrim(p_title),
    'description',p_description,'chapter_id',p_chapter_id,'order',p_order,
    'active',p_active,'is_free_preview',p_is_free_preview);
  select * into v_upload from public.note_upload_requests
    where request_id = p_request_id for update;
  if not found or v_upload.admin_user_id <> auth.uid() then
    raise exception 'Upload request unavailable' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if v_upload.status = 'attached' then
    if v_upload.save_payload is distinct from v_payload then
      raise exception 'Upload request already used for another note change' using errcode = '23505';
    end if;
    if v_upload.note_id is null or not exists (
      select 1 from public.notes where id = v_upload.note_id
    ) then
      raise exception 'Previously saved note was deleted; start a new upload request' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;
    return v_upload.note_id;
  end if;
  if v_upload.status <> 'uploaded' then
    raise exception 'PDF upload is incomplete' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  if p_note_id is null then
    insert into public.notes(title,description,pdf_url,chapter_id,"order",active,is_free_preview)
    values(btrim(p_title),p_description,v_upload.pdf_url,p_chapter_id,p_order,p_active,p_is_free_preview)
    returning id into v_note_id;
  else
    update public.notes set title=btrim(p_title),description=p_description,
      pdf_url=v_upload.pdf_url,chapter_id=p_chapter_id,"order"=p_order,
      active=p_active,is_free_preview=p_is_free_preview
    where id=p_note_id returning id into v_note_id;
    if v_note_id is null then
      raise exception 'Note unavailable' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;
  end if;
  update public.note_upload_requests set status='attached',note_id=v_note_id,
    save_payload=v_payload,updated_at=now() where request_id=p_request_id;
  return v_note_id;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.save_note_with_upload(uuid,text,text,text,text,integer,boolean,boolean) from public,anon;
grant execute on function public.save_note_with_upload(uuid,text,text,text,text,integer,boolean,boolean) to authenticated;

commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261018130000_note_pdf_quarantine.sql =====
-- Large PDFs bypass Edge body buffering, but never bypass trusted validation.
begin;
insert into storage.buckets(id,name,public,file_size_limit,allowed_mime_types)
values('note-quarantine','note-quarantine',false,52428800,array['application/pdf'])
on conflict(id) do nothing;
do $$ begin
  if not exists(select 1 from storage.buckets where id='note-quarantine'
    and not public and file_size_limit=52428800
    and allowed_mime_types=array['application/pdf']::text[]) then
    raise exception 'Existing quarantine bucket settings differ; review before deployment';
  end if;
end $$;
-- No client can read/write quarantine through ordinary Storage APIs. Signed
-- upload capability is issued only after authenticated admin authorization.
create policy note_quarantine_private on storage.objects as restrictive
  for all to public using(bucket_id <> 'note-quarantine') with check(bucket_id <> 'note-quarantine');
create table public.note_pdf_validation_jobs (
  request_id uuid primary key references public.note_upload_requests(request_id),
  expected_bytes bigint not null check(expected_bytes between 1 and 52428800),
  status text not null default 'pending' check(status in ('pending','working','complete','rejected')),
  lease_id uuid,
  lease_until timestamptz,
  attempts integer not null default 0,
  last_error text,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
alter table public.note_pdf_validation_jobs enable row level security;
revoke all on public.note_pdf_validation_jobs from public,anon,authenticated;
grant all on public.note_pdf_validation_jobs to service_role;
create index note_pdf_validation_jobs_pending_idx on public.note_pdf_validation_jobs(updated_at)
  where status in ('pending','working');

create function public.reserve_note_pdf_validation(p_request_id uuid,p_admin uuid,p_hash text,p_bytes bigint,p_url text)
returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public,pg_temp as $$
declare u public.note_upload_requests%rowtype; v_path text;
begin
  v_path := 'validated/' || p_admin || '/' || p_request_id || '.pdf';
  insert into public.note_upload_requests(request_id,admin_user_id,sha256,object_path,pdf_url)
    values(p_request_id,p_admin,p_hash,v_path,p_url) on conflict(request_id) do nothing;
  select * into u from public.note_upload_requests where request_id=p_request_id for update;
  if u.admin_user_id<>p_admin or u.sha256<>p_hash or u.object_path<>v_path or u.pdf_url<>p_url then
    raise exception 'Request ID already used' using errcode='23505';
  end if;
  insert into public.note_pdf_validation_jobs(request_id,expected_bytes)
    values(p_request_id,p_bytes) on conflict(request_id) do nothing;
  if (select expected_bytes from public.note_pdf_validation_jobs where request_id=p_request_id)<>p_bytes then
    raise exception 'Request size changed' using errcode='23505';
  end if;
  -- Explicit same-file admin retry rearms exhausted transient failures only.
  update public.note_pdf_validation_jobs set status='pending',attempts=0,
    lease_id=null,lease_until=null,last_error=null,updated_at=now()
    where request_id=p_request_id and attempts>=5 and
      (status='pending' or (status='working' and lease_until<now()));
end $$;

create function public.claim_note_pdf_validation()
returns table(request_id uuid,lease_id uuid,expected_bytes bigint,sha256 text,object_path text)
language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public,pg_temp as $$
declare v_id uuid; v_lease uuid := gen_random_uuid();
begin
  select j.request_id into v_id from public.note_pdf_validation_jobs j
    where (j.status='pending' or (j.status='working' and j.lease_until<now()))
    and j.updated_at <= now() and j.attempts<5
    order by j.updated_at for update skip locked limit 1;
  if v_id is null then return; end if;
  update public.note_pdf_validation_jobs j set status='working',lease_id=v_lease,
    lease_until=now()+interval '10 minutes',attempts=attempts+1,updated_at=now() where j.request_id=v_id;
  return query select u.request_id,v_lease,j.expected_bytes,u.sha256,u.object_path
    from public.note_upload_requests u join public.note_pdf_validation_jobs j using(request_id)
    where u.request_id=v_id;
end $$;

create function public.finish_note_pdf_validation(p_request_id uuid,p_lease uuid,p_outcome text,p_error text default null)
returns boolean language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public,pg_temp as $$
begin
  if p_outcome not in ('complete','rejected','pending') or p_outcome is null then
    raise exception 'Invalid validation outcome' using errcode='22023';
  end if;
  perform 1 from public.note_pdf_validation_jobs where request_id=p_request_id
    and status='working' and lease_id=p_lease and lease_until>now() for update;
  if not found then return false; end if;
  if p_outcome='complete' then
    update public.note_upload_requests set status='uploaded',updated_at=now()
      where request_id=p_request_id and status='reserved';
  end if;
  update public.note_pdf_validation_jobs set status=p_outcome,lease_until=null,lease_id=null,
    last_error=left(p_error,300),updated_at=now()+case when p_outcome='pending' then interval '1 minute' else interval '0' end
    where request_id=p_request_id;
  return true;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.reserve_note_pdf_validation(uuid,uuid,text,bigint,text) from public,anon,authenticated;
revoke all on function public.claim_note_pdf_validation() from public,anon,authenticated;
revoke all on function public.finish_note_pdf_validation(uuid,uuid,text,text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.reserve_note_pdf_validation(uuid,uuid,text,bigint,text) to service_role;
grant execute on function public.claim_note_pdf_validation() to service_role;
grant execute on function public.finish_note_pdf_validation(uuid,uuid,text,text) to service_role;
commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261019150000_play_catalog_queue_fences.sql =====
-- Preserve existing jobs, Admin prices and entitlements. Apply only after review.
begin;

create or replace function public.queue_play_price_sync(p_price numeric)
returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_sku text;
begin
  if p_price is null or p_price <= 0 then return; end if;
  select play_sku into v_sku from public.play_price_tiers
    where price_inr=p_price and active order by created_at desc limit 1;
  if v_sku is null then
    v_sku := 'notes_' || replace(p_price::numeric(10,2)::text, '.', '_') || '_v_' || replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', '');
  end if;
  -- Product/PDF edits only ensure that a job exists. They must not revoke an
  -- active lease, bypass backoff, or retry a terminal authorization failure.
  -- Existing ready tiers are rechecked by requeue_stale_play_price_sync;
  -- failed jobs require the explicit, admin-authorized retry RPC.
  insert into public.play_price_sync(price_inr,candidate_sku)
    values(p_price,v_sku) on conflict(price_inr) do nothing;
  if found then
    insert into public.play_price_sync_logs(price_inr,play_sku,event)
      values(p_price,v_sku,'queued');
  end if;
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.queue_play_price_sync(numeric) from public,anon,authenticated;

create or replace function public.fail_play_price_sync(p_price numeric,p_lease uuid,p_reason text,p_retry boolean)
returns boolean language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_sku text; v_attempts integer;
begin
  select candidate_sku,attempts into v_sku,v_attempts from public.play_price_sync
    where price_inr=p_price and lease_id=p_lease and status='running' and lease_until>now() for update;
  if not found then return false; end if;
  update public.play_price_sync set status=case when p_retry and v_attempts<12 then 'pending' else 'failed' end,
    next_attempt_at=now()+make_interval(secs=>least(3600,15*power(2,least(v_attempts,8)))::integer),
    lease_id=null,lease_until=null,last_error=left(p_reason,300),updated_at=now() where price_inr=p_price;
  insert into public.play_price_sync_logs(price_inr,play_sku,event,detail)
    values(p_price,v_sku,case when p_retry and v_attempts<12 then 'retry' else 'failed' end,left(p_reason,300));
  return true;
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.fail_play_price_sync(numeric,uuid,text,boolean) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.fail_play_price_sync(numeric,uuid,text,boolean) to service_role;
commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261019151000_play_duplicate_settlement_result.sql =====
-- Preserve the duplicate-charge result on idempotent verification replays.
-- No prices, existing purchases, or Razorpay functions are modified.
begin;

create or replace function public.settle_play_purchase(
  p_user_id uuid,p_order_id text,p_product_id text,p_play_sku text,p_purchase_token text,p_paid_at timestamptz
)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_order public.orders%rowtype; v_product public.products%rowtype;
  v_other_order text; v_owned_purchase text;
  v_ref public.referrals%rowtype; v_set public.referral_settings%rowtype;
begin
  if p_purchase_token is null or length(p_purchase_token)<10 or length(p_purchase_token)>4096
     or p_paid_at is null then raise exception 'Invalid Play settlement inputs'; end if;
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || p_user_id::text,0));
  select * into v_order from public.orders where id=p_order_id for update;
  if not found or v_order.user_id is distinct from p_user_id or v_order.product_id is distinct from p_product_id
     or v_order.provider<>'play' or v_order.play_sku is distinct from p_play_sku
     or v_order.external_transaction_token is not null or v_order.external_choice_bound_order_id is not null then
    raise exception 'Play order ownership or product mismatch';
  end if;
  if v_order.status='paid' then
    if v_order.purchase_token=p_purchase_token then
      return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'already_settled',true,'amount',v_order.amount,
        'duplicate',exists(select 1 from public.purchases
          where order_id=v_order.id and status='duplicate'));
    end if;
    raise exception 'Play order already paid with different token';
  end if;
  -- A pending Play purchase can complete after the local checkout timer; once
  -- Google binds its token to this order, charging the user must still unlock it.
  if v_order.status not in ('created','cancelled') then
    raise exception 'Play order unavailable';
  end if;
  select order_id into v_other_order from public.payments where purchase_token=p_purchase_token;
  if found and v_other_order<>p_order_id then raise exception 'Play token already used for another order'; end if;
  select * into v_product from public.products where id=v_order.product_id;
  if not found then raise exception 'Play product unavailable'; end if;
  if not exists(select 1 from public.play_price_tiers where play_sku=v_order.play_sku and price_inr=v_order.amount)
     or v_order.list_price is distinct from v_order.amount or v_order.wallet_amount<>0
     or v_order.referral_discount<>0 then raise exception 'Play order price mismatch'; end if;

  insert into public.payments(order_id,user_id,product_id,amount,provider,purchase_token,play_sku,status,verified_at)
  values(v_order.id,v_order.user_id,v_order.product_id,v_order.amount,'play',p_purchase_token,v_order.play_sku,'success',now());
  select id into v_owned_purchase from public.purchases
   where user_id=v_order.user_id and product_id=v_product.id and status='success' and order_id is distinct from v_order.id limit 1;
  insert into public.purchases(user_id,order_id,product_id,product_title,scope,chapter_id,subject_id,year_id,
    year_ids,course_id,amount,status)
  values(v_order.user_id,v_order.id,v_product.id,coalesce(v_product.title,'Your content'),v_product.scope,
    v_product.chapter_id,v_product.subject_id,v_product.year_id,v_product.year_ids,v_product.course_id,
    v_order.amount,case when v_owned_purchase is null then 'success' else 'duplicate' end);
  update public.orders set status='paid',purchase_token=p_purchase_token,play_consumption_status='pending',
    payment_completed_at=p_paid_at,updated_at=now() where id=v_order.id;
  if v_owned_purchase is null then perform public.record_purchase_identity(v_order.user_id); end if;

  -- Mirror the referral section of settle_razorpay_payment exactly: a duplicate
  -- paid product is not a first purchase and never earns another credit.
  select * into v_ref from public.referrals where referred_id=v_order.user_id for update;
  if found and v_ref.first_order_id is null and v_ref.status in ('pending','qualified')
     and v_owned_purchase is null
     and not exists(select 1 from public.purchases where user_id=v_order.user_id
                    and order_id<>v_order.id and status='success') then
    select * into v_set from public.referral_settings where id=true;
    if v_set.require_verified_phone
       and not (coalesce((select mobile_verified from public.profiles where id=v_order.user_id),false)
            and coalesce((select mobile_verified from public.profiles where id=v_ref.referrer_id),false)) then
      update public.referrals set first_order_id=v_order.id,status='rejected',
        reject_reason='phone_not_verified_at_purchase' where id=v_ref.id;
      v_ref.status:='rejected';
    elsif public.has_prior_purchase_identity(v_order.user_id) then
      update public.referrals set first_order_id=v_order.id,status='rejected',
        reject_reason='returning_customer' where id=v_ref.id;
      v_ref.status:='rejected';
    else
      update public.referrals set first_order_id=v_order.id,status='qualified',
        qualified_at=coalesce(qualified_at,now()) where id=v_ref.id;
    end if;
    if v_ref.status<>'rejected' and v_set.enabled and v_set.referrer_credit_amount>0
       and exists(select 1 from public.profiles where id=v_ref.referrer_id and not blocked) then
      insert into public.wallet_ledger(user_id,entry_type,status,amount,source,referral_id,order_id,
        available_at,expires_at,note)
      values(v_ref.referrer_id,'credit','pending',v_set.referrer_credit_amount::numeric(10,2),
        'referral_reward',v_ref.id,v_order.id,
        now()+make_interval(days=>v_set.credit_hold_days),
        case when v_set.credit_expiry_days is null then null
          else now()+make_interval(days=>v_set.credit_hold_days+v_set.credit_expiry_days) end,
        'Friend''s first purchase')
      on conflict (referral_id) where entry_type='credit' and source='referral_reward' do nothing;
    end if;
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'already_settled',false,'amount',v_order.amount,
    'duplicate',v_owned_purchase is not null);
end; $$;

revoke all on function public.settle_play_purchase(uuid,text,text,text,text,timestamptz) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.settle_play_purchase(uuid,text,text,text,text,timestamptz) to service_role;
commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261020100000_notes_service_reads.sql =====
-- SEC-02: students obtain paid and free-preview URLs only via get-note-url,
-- which calls user_can_access_note (including the blocked-account check).
-- Admin preview SELECT policies remain in place. Service-role signing bypasses RLS.
begin;
drop policy if exists notes_read_if_purchased on storage.objects;
-- Restrictive policy also prevents another permissive SELECT/ALL policy from
-- accidentally reopening the notes bucket to students.
drop policy if exists notes_service_reads_only on storage.objects;
create policy notes_service_reads_only on storage.objects as restrictive
  for select to public
  using (bucket_id <> 'notes' or public.am_i_admin());
commit;

-- Rollback: prefer a forward correction. To undo, drop notes_service_reads_only
-- and recreate notes_read_if_purchased from 20260930110000_low_grants_tightening.sql.
-- WARNING: that restores the blocked-account bypass; do not use as a routine rollback.
-- Existing signed URLs remain usable until their existing expiry.


===== supabase/migrations/20261020101000_maintenance_mode_read.sql =====

returns boolean

set search_path = ''

$$;

===== supabase/migrations/20261020102000_correct_stale_store_url.sql =====
-- MOB-02: preserve valid/custom URLs, missing rows and the current package.
-- Match the Play host/path and exact id parameter, including reordered params.
begin;
update public.app_config
set value = regexp_replace(value,
  '([?&]id=)com\.(medveda|ayurpulse)\.app(&|$)',
  '\1in.medveda.app\3')
where key = 'store_url'
  and value ~ '^https://play\.google\.com/store/apps/details\?'
  and value ~ '[?&]id=com\.(medveda|ayurpulse)\.app(&|$)';
commit;

===== supabase/migrations/20261020103000_first_purchase_identity_retention.sql =====
-- DB-01: REVIEW ONLY. No purge invocation or cron scheduling in this migration.
-- Fixed 180-day lifetime from first_purchase_at, not from account deletion.
-- This also bounds retention after account deletion to at most 180 days.
-- Deleting the entire row removes both hashes and account_id. Do not NULL only
-- account_id while retaining hashes: has_prior_purchase_identity uses <> p_uid,
-- so NULL would silently bypass that guard. Existing billing RPCs stay intact.
create index if not exists first_purchase_identities_retention_idx
  on public.first_purchase_identities (first_purchase_at);

create or replace function public.purge_expired_first_purchase_identities()
returns bigint
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_deleted bigint;
begin
  delete from public.first_purchase_identities
    where first_purchase_at < now() - interval '180 days';
  get diagnostics v_deleted = row_count;
  return v_deleted;
end;
$$;
revoke all on function public.purge_expired_first_purchase_identities() from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.purge_expired_first_purchase_identities() to service_role;

-- Prepared cron pattern (see existing *_cron_setup.sql); deliberately commented.
-- An owner must approve operation/cadence and monitor failures before publishing
-- the retention promise. A daily job can lag the cutoff by up to one day; choose
-- a suitable operational cadence and deletion deadline before enabling it.
-- select cron.schedule('first-purchase-identity-retention', '0 * * * *',
--   'select public.purge_expired_first_purchase_identities();');
-- No existing job is changed. No extension is installed.
--
-- Rollback via NEW forward migration only:
-- 1. If separately enabled, unschedule only this named job:
--    select cron.unschedule('first-purchase-identity-retention');
-- 2. drop function public.purge_expired_first_purchase_identities();
-- 3. drop index public.first_purchase_identities_retention_idx;
-- Purged rows cannot be recovered by rollback. Do not backfill old hashes from
-- financial records: that would restart the approved retention window.


===== supabase/migrations/20261020104000_course_wide_content_browsing.sql =====
-- Registration year is profile metadata, never a catalogue visibility rule.
-- Keep the helper signature and existing admin/purchase branches for compatibility.
-- Publication is independent of registration year and purchased entitlements.
-- Existing permissive RLS/write policies and protected PDF storage stay intact.
begin;

-- A shared, fail-closed ancestor check for catalogue RLS and service-role URLs.
-- SECURITY DEFINER avoids recursive RLS when checking the same parent tables.
-- Videos/tests have a subject parent, not a chapter parent, in this schema.
create or replace function public.content_is_published(
  p_course_id text, p_year_id text, p_subject_id text default null, p_chapter_id text default null
)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select
    exists (select 1 from public.courses co where co.id = p_course_id and co.active)
    and (p_year_id is null or exists (
      select 1 from public.years y
      where y.id = p_year_id and y.course_id = p_course_id and y.active
    ))
    and (p_subject_id is null or exists (
      select 1 from public.subjects s
      where s.id = p_subject_id and s.course_id = p_course_id and s.year_id = p_year_id and s.active
    ))
    and (p_chapter_id is null or exists (
      select 1 from public.chapters c
      join public.subjects s on s.id = c.subject_id and s.active
        and s.course_id = p_course_id and s.year_id = p_year_id
      where c.id = p_chapter_id and c.course_id = p_course_id and c.year_id = p_year_id and c.active
        and (p_subject_id is null or c.subject_id = p_subject_id)
    ));
$$;
revoke all on function public.content_is_published(text, text, text, text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.content_is_published(text, text, text, text) to authenticated, service_role;

create or replace function public.has_content_access(p_course_id text, p_year_id text)
returns boolean
language sql
security definer
stable
set search_path = public
as $$
  select
    public.am_i_admin()
    or (public.content_is_published(p_course_id, p_year_id) and (exists (
      select 1 from public.profiles pr
      where pr.id = auth.uid()
        and pr.course_id = p_course_id
    )
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.purchases pu
      left join public.chapters ch on pu.scope = 'chapter' and ch.id = pu.chapter_id
      left join public.subjects sb on pu.scope = 'subject' and sb.id = pu.subject_id
      where pu.user_id = auth.uid()
        and pu.status = 'success'
        and pu.course_id = p_course_id
        and (
          p_year_id is null
          or (pu.scope = 'year' and pu.year_id = p_year_id)
          or (pu.scope = 'bundle' and p_year_id = any(pu.year_ids))
          or (pu.scope = 'chapter' and ch.year_id = p_year_id)
          or (pu.scope = 'subject' and sb.year_id = p_year_id)
        )
    )));
$$;

-- Restrictive SELECT guards compose with the existing entitlement/course policies.
-- The admin exception preserves draft management; it grants no student access
-- and does not change INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies or purchase records.
create policy subjects_published_ancestry on public.subjects as restrictive
  for select to authenticated using (
    public.am_i_admin() or (active and public.content_is_published(course_id, year_id, id))
  );
create policy chapters_published_ancestry on public.chapters as restrictive
  for select to authenticated using (
    public.am_i_admin() or (active and public.content_is_published(course_id, year_id, subject_id, id))
  );
create policy notes_published_ancestry on public.notes as restrictive
  for select to authenticated using (
    public.am_i_admin() or (active and public.content_is_published(course_id, year_id, null, chapter_id))
  );
create policy videos_published_ancestry on public.videos as restrictive
  for select to authenticated using (
    public.am_i_admin() or (active and public.content_is_published(course_id, year_id, subject_id))
  );
create policy quiz_tests_published_ancestry on public.quiz_tests as restrictive
  for select to authenticated using (
    public.am_i_admin() or (active and public.content_is_published(course_id, year_id, subject_id))
  );
create policy products_published_ancestry on public.products as restrictive
  for select to authenticated using (
    public.am_i_admin() or (active and case scope
      when 'chapter' then exists (
        select 1 from public.chapters c where c.id = products.chapter_id
          and public.content_is_published(products.course_id, c.year_id, c.subject_id, c.id)
      )
      when 'subject' then exists (
        select 1 from public.subjects s where s.id = products.subject_id
          and public.content_is_published(products.course_id, s.year_id, s.id)
      )
      when 'year' then year_id is not null and public.content_is_published(course_id, year_id)
      when 'bundle' then public.content_is_published(course_id, null)
        and cardinality(year_ids) > 0 and not exists (
          select 1 from unnest(year_ids) y(id)
          where y.id is null or not public.content_is_published(products.course_id, y.id)
        )
      else false
    end)
  );

-- Service-role URL endpoints must enforce course isolation explicitly.
create or replace function public.user_can_access_note(p_user uuid, p_note_id text)
returns boolean
language sql
security definer
stable
set search_path = public
as $$
  select
    p_user is not null
    and exists (select 1 from public.profiles pr where pr.id = p_user and not coalesce(pr.blocked, false))
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.notes n
      join public.chapters c on c.id = n.chapter_id
      where n.id = p_note_id
        and n.active
        and public.content_is_published(n.course_id, n.year_id, c.subject_id, n.chapter_id)
        and (
          (n.is_free_preview and exists (select 1 from public.profiles pr
            where pr.id = p_user and pr.course_id = n.course_id))
          or exists (select 1 from public.admins a where a.id = p_user)
          or exists (
            select 1
            from public.purchases p
            where p.user_id = p_user
              and p.status = 'success'
              and p.course_id = c.course_id
              and (
                (p.scope = 'chapter' and p.chapter_id = c.id)
                or (p.scope = 'subject' and p.subject_id = c.subject_id)
                or (p.scope = 'year' and p.year_id = c.year_id)
                or (p.scope = 'bundle' and c.year_id = any (p.year_ids))
              )
          )
        )
    );
$$;

create or replace function public.user_can_access_video(p_user uuid, p_video_id text)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select p_user is not null
    and exists (select 1 from public.profiles pr where pr.id = p_user and not coalesce(pr.blocked, false))
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.videos v where v.id = p_video_id and v.active
        and public.content_is_published(v.course_id, v.year_id, v.subject_id)
        and (
          exists (select 1 from public.profiles pr where pr.id = p_user and pr.course_id = v.course_id)
          or exists (select 1 from public.admins a where a.id = p_user)
          or exists (
            select 1 from public.purchases pu
            left join public.chapters ch on pu.scope = 'chapter' and ch.id = pu.chapter_id
            left join public.subjects sb on pu.scope = 'subject' and sb.id = pu.subject_id
            where pu.user_id = p_user and pu.status = 'success' and pu.course_id = v.course_id
              and ((pu.scope = 'year' and pu.year_id = v.year_id)
                or (pu.scope = 'bundle' and v.year_id = any(pu.year_ids))
                or (pu.scope = 'chapter' and ch.year_id = v.year_id)
                or (pu.scope = 'subject' and sb.year_id = v.year_id))
          )
        )
    );
$$;

-- SECURITY DEFINER quiz submissions must check catalogue access themselves.
create or replace function public.submit_quiz_attempt(
  p_attempt_id text, p_test_id text, p_question_revision bigint, p_answers jsonb
) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare
  v_user uuid := auth.uid();
  v_test public.quiz_tests%rowtype;
  v_existing public.verified_quiz_attempts%rowtype;
  v_question jsonb;
  v_selected jsonb;
  v_option_index integer;
  v_total integer;
  v_score integer := 0;
  v_i integer;
begin
  if v_user is null then
    raise exception 'Sign in required' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if not exists (select 1 from public.profiles where id = v_user and not coalesce(blocked, false)) then
    raise exception 'Account unavailable' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if p_attempt_id is null or length(p_attempt_id) not between 8 and 160
     or p_test_id is null or p_question_revision is null
     or p_answers is null or jsonb_typeof(p_answers) <> 'array' then
    raise exception 'Invalid attempt' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  -- A dropped response can be retried even after the test has since changed.
  select * into v_existing from public.verified_quiz_attempts where id = p_attempt_id;
  if found then
    if v_existing.user_id <> v_user or v_existing.test_id is distinct from p_test_id
       or v_existing.question_revision <> p_question_revision or v_existing.answers <> p_answers then
      raise exception 'Attempt id belongs to another submission' using errcode = '23505';
    end if;
    return jsonb_build_object('status','verified','score',v_existing.score,
      'total',v_existing.total,'percentage',v_existing.percentage);
  end if;

  if not public.rate_limit_hit('verified-quiz:' || v_user::text, 120, 3600) then
    return jsonb_build_object('status','rate_limited');
  end if;

  select * into v_test from public.quiz_tests where id = p_test_id and active;
  if not found
     or not public.content_is_published(v_test.course_id, v_test.year_id, v_test.subject_id)
     or not public.has_content_access(v_test.course_id, v_test.year_id) or not exists (
    select 1 from public.subjects s where s.id = v_test.subject_id
      and s.year_id = v_test.year_id and s.course_id = v_test.course_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'Test unavailable' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  if v_test.question_revision <> p_question_revision then
    return jsonb_build_object('status','stale');
  end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(v_test.questions) <> 'array' then
    raise exception 'Test questions invalid' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  v_total := jsonb_array_length(v_test.questions);
  if v_total < 1 or v_total > 100 or jsonb_array_length(p_answers) <> v_total then
    raise exception 'Answer count mismatch' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  for v_i in 0..v_total-1 loop
    v_question := v_test.questions -> v_i;
    v_selected := p_answers -> v_i;
    if jsonb_typeof(v_question) <> 'object'
       or jsonb_typeof(v_question->'options') <> 'array'
       or jsonb_typeof(v_question->'answer') <> 'string'
       or jsonb_array_length(v_question->'options') < 2 then
      raise exception 'Test question invalid' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;
    if v_selected = 'null'::jsonb then continue; end if;
    if jsonb_typeof(v_selected) <> 'number' or (v_selected #>> '{}') !~ '^[0-9]+$' then
      raise exception 'Answer index invalid' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;
    v_option_index := (v_selected #>> '{}')::integer;
    if v_option_index >= jsonb_array_length(v_question->'options') then
      raise exception 'Answer index out of range' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;
    if v_question->'options'->>v_option_index = v_question->>'answer' then
      v_score := v_score + 1;
    end if;
  end loop;

  insert into public.verified_quiz_attempts
    (id,user_id,test_id,test_title,subject_id,question_revision,answers,score,total,percentage)
  values (p_attempt_id,v_user,p_test_id,v_test.title,v_test.subject_id,p_question_revision,
    p_answers,v_score,v_total,round(v_score * 100.0 / v_total)::integer)
  on conflict (id) do nothing;

  select * into v_existing from public.verified_quiz_attempts where id = p_attempt_id;
  if v_existing.user_id <> v_user or v_existing.test_id is distinct from p_test_id
     or v_existing.question_revision <> p_question_revision or v_existing.answers <> p_answers then
    raise exception 'Attempt id belongs to another submission' using errcode = '23505';
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('status','verified','score',v_existing.score,
    'total',v_existing.total,'percentage',v_existing.percentage);
end $$;

-- CREATE OR REPLACE retains existing grants; explicitly retain service-only URLs.
revoke all on function public.user_can_access_note(uuid, text) from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all on function public.user_can_access_video(uuid, text) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.user_can_access_note(uuid, text) to service_role;
grant execute on function public.user_can_access_video(uuid, text) to service_role;
commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261020105000_quiz_answer_read_boundary.sql =====
-- Students may read quiz metadata, but only this RPC may return questions.
-- Keep the grading key in quiz_tests.questions for submit_quiz_attempt.
begin;

revoke select on public.quiz_tests from public, anon, authenticated;
grant select (id, title, subject_id, year_id, course_id, "order", active,
  created_at, question_revision) on public.quiz_tests to authenticated;

create function public.get_public_quiz_tests(
  p_subject_id text default null, p_test_id text default null
) returns setof jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', q.id, 'title', q.title, 'subject_id', q.subject_id,
    'year_id', q.year_id, 'course_id', q.course_id, 'order', q."order",
    'active', q.active, 'question_revision', q.question_revision,
    'subjects', jsonb_build_object('title', s.title),
    'years', jsonb_build_object('title', y.title),
    'questions', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'question', item.value->'question', 'options', item.value->'options'
      ) order by item.ordinality)
      from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(q.questions) = 'array'
        then q.questions else '[]'::jsonb end)
        with ordinality as item(value, ordinality)
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  from public.quiz_tests q
  join public.subjects s on s.id = q.subject_id
  join public.years y on y.id = q.year_id
  where (p_subject_id is not null or p_test_id is not null)
    and (p_subject_id is null or q.subject_id = p_subject_id)
    and (p_test_id is null or q.id = p_test_id)
    and q.active
    and exists (select 1 from public.profiles pr
      where pr.id = auth.uid() and not coalesce(pr.blocked, false))
    and public.content_is_published(q.course_id, q.year_id, q.subject_id)
    and public.has_content_access(q.course_id, q.year_id)
  order by q."order", q.id;
$$;
revoke all on function public.get_public_quiz_tests(text, text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.get_public_quiz_tests(text, text) to authenticated;

-- The admin editor needs the key to edit a test. The same AAL2 gate used by
-- admin RLS also protects this definer endpoint.
create function public.get_admin_quiz_tests(
  p_course_id text default null, p_year_id text default null
) returns setof public.quiz_tests language plpgsql stable security definer
  set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
begin
  if not public.am_i_admin() then
    raise exception 'Admin access required' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  return query select q.* from public.quiz_tests q
    where (p_course_id is null or q.course_id = p_course_id)
      and (p_year_id is null or q.year_id = p_year_id)
    order by q.created_at desc, q.id;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.get_admin_quiz_tests(text, text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.get_admin_quiz_tests(text, text) to authenticated;

commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261020110000_admin_url_mfa.sql =====
-- The two-argument service helpers remain for older deployed handlers, but
-- never confer admin-only access when MFA is required. New handlers pass the
-- AAL from the same verified bearer token that identified p_user.
begin;

create or replace function public.user_can_access_note(p_user uuid, p_note_id text)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select p_user is not null
    and exists (select 1 from public.profiles pr
      where pr.id = p_user and not coalesce(pr.blocked, false))
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.notes n
      join public.chapters c on c.id = n.chapter_id
      where n.id = p_note_id and n.active
        and public.content_is_published(n.course_id, n.year_id, c.subject_id, n.chapter_id)
        and (
          (n.is_free_preview and exists (select 1 from public.profiles pr
            where pr.id = p_user and pr.course_id = n.course_id))
          or (not public.admin_mfa_required()
            and exists (select 1 from public.admins a where a.id = p_user))
          or exists (
            select 1 from public.purchases p
            where p.user_id = p_user and p.status = 'success'
              and p.course_id = c.course_id
              and ((p.scope = 'chapter' and p.chapter_id = c.id)
                or (p.scope = 'subject' and p.subject_id = c.subject_id)
                or (p.scope = 'year' and p.year_id = c.year_id)
                or (p.scope = 'bundle' and c.year_id = any(p.year_ids)))
          )
        )
    );
$$;

create or replace function public.user_can_access_video(p_user uuid, p_video_id text)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select p_user is not null
    and exists (select 1 from public.profiles pr
      where pr.id = p_user and not coalesce(pr.blocked, false))
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.videos v where v.id = p_video_id and v.active
        and public.content_is_published(v.course_id, v.year_id, v.subject_id)
        and (
          exists (select 1 from public.profiles pr
            where pr.id = p_user and pr.course_id = v.course_id)
          or (not public.admin_mfa_required()
            and exists (select 1 from public.admins a where a.id = p_user))
          or exists (
            select 1 from public.purchases pu
            left join public.chapters ch on pu.scope = 'chapter' and ch.id = pu.chapter_id
            left join public.subjects sb on pu.scope = 'subject' and sb.id = pu.subject_id
            where pu.user_id = p_user and pu.status = 'success' and pu.course_id = v.course_id
              and ((pu.scope = 'year' and pu.year_id = v.year_id)
                or (pu.scope = 'bundle' and v.year_id = any(pu.year_ids))
                or (pu.scope = 'chapter' and ch.year_id = v.year_id)
                or (pu.scope = 'subject' and sb.year_id = v.year_id))
          )
        )
    );
$$;

create function public.user_can_access_note_with_aal(
  p_user uuid, p_note_id text, p_aal text
) returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select public.user_can_access_note(p_user, p_note_id)
    or (p_aal = 'aal2' and public.admin_mfa_required()
      and exists (select 1 from public.profiles pr
        where pr.id = p_user and not coalesce(pr.blocked, false))
      and exists (select 1 from public.admins a where a.id = p_user)
      and exists (select 1 from public.notes n
        join public.chapters c on c.id = n.chapter_id
        where n.id = p_note_id and n.active
          and public.content_is_published(n.course_id, n.year_id, c.subject_id, n.chapter_id)));
$$;

create function public.user_can_access_video_with_aal(
  p_user uuid, p_video_id text, p_aal text
) returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select public.user_can_access_video(p_user, p_video_id)
    or (p_aal = 'aal2' and public.admin_mfa_required()
      and exists (select 1 from public.profiles pr
        where pr.id = p_user and not coalesce(pr.blocked, false))
      and exists (select 1 from public.admins a where a.id = p_user)
      and exists (select 1 from public.videos v
        where v.id = p_video_id and v.active
          and public.content_is_published(v.course_id, v.year_id, v.subject_id)));
$$;

revoke all on function public.user_can_access_note(uuid, text) from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all on function public.user_can_access_video(uuid, text) from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all on function public.user_can_access_note_with_aal(uuid, text, text) from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all on function public.user_can_access_video_with_aal(uuid, text, text) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.user_can_access_note(uuid, text) to service_role;
grant execute on function public.user_can_access_video(uuid, text) to service_role;
grant execute on function public.user_can_access_note_with_aal(uuid, text, text) to service_role;
grant execute on function public.user_can_access_video_with_aal(uuid, text, text) to service_role;

commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261104100000_razorpay_snapshot_discount_retry.sql =====
-- Forward-only payment correctness fix. No historical purchases are rewritten.
-- Existing order fields already contain the authorized entitlement snapshot.
begin;

create function public.orders_entitlement_immutable()
returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path=public as $$
begin
  if row(new.scope,new.chapter_id,new.subject_id,new.year_id,new.year_ids,new.course_id)
     is distinct from row(old.scope,old.chapter_id,old.subject_id,old.year_id,old.year_ids,old.course_id) then
    raise exception 'orders entitlement snapshot is immutable' using errcode='42501';
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.orders_entitlement_immutable() from public,anon,authenticated;
create trigger orders_02_entitlement_immutable before update on public.orders
  for each row execute function public.orders_entitlement_immutable();

-- Catalog/course validation belongs to order creation. Revalidating it on an
-- update rejects legitimate delayed captures after a product moves course.
create or replace function public.orders_derive_course()
returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_course_id text;
begin
  if auth.uid() is not null and new.status='paid'
     and (tg_op='INSERT' or old.status is distinct from 'paid')
     and not public.am_i_admin() then
    raise exception 'Orders can only be marked paid by the payment system';
  end if;
  if tg_op='UPDATE' then return new; end if;
  select course_id into v_course_id from public.products where id=new.product_id;
  if v_course_id is null then raise exception 'Unknown product_id % on orders',new.product_id; end if;
  if new.course_id is null then new.course_id:=v_course_id;
  elsif new.course_id is distinct from v_course_id then
    raise exception 'orders.course_id (%) does not match product course (%)',new.course_id,v_course_id;
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;

-- Defense in depth for every service-side Razorpay purchase insertion.
create function public.razorpay_purchase_entitlement_from_order()
returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_order public.orders%rowtype;
begin
  if new.order_id is null then return new; end if;
  select * into v_order from public.orders where id=new.order_id;
  if not found or v_order.provider<>'razorpay' then return new; end if;
  if new.user_id is distinct from v_order.user_id
     or new.product_id is distinct from v_order.product_id
     or new.amount is distinct from v_order.amount
     or v_order.scope is null or v_order.scope not in ('chapter','subject','year','bundle') then
    raise exception 'Razorpay purchase does not match order entitlement';
  end if;
  new.scope:=v_order.scope;
  new.chapter_id:=v_order.chapter_id;
  new.subject_id:=v_order.subject_id;
  new.year_id:=v_order.year_id;
  new.year_ids:=v_order.year_ids;
  new.course_id:=v_order.course_id;
  return new;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.razorpay_purchase_entitlement_from_order() from public,anon,authenticated;
create trigger purchases_razorpay_order_snapshot before insert on public.purchases
