create function public.nonplay_test_user_allowed(p_user uuid) returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path=public,pg_temp as $$
  select exists(select 1 from public.nonplay_test_config where enabled)
    and exists(select 1 from public.nonplay_test_users t join auth.users u on u.id=t.user_id
      join public.profiles p on p.id=u.id
      where t.user_id=p_user and t.active and not coalesce(p.blocked,true)
        and u.raw_app_meta_data->>'medveda_nonplay_test'='true'
        and u.deleted_at is null and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<=now()));
$$;
create function public.nonplay_test_product_allowed(p_user uuid,p_product text) returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path=public,pg_temp as $$
  select public.nonplay_test_user_allowed(p_user) and exists(
    select 1 from public.nonplay_test_products t join public.profiles p on p.id=p_user
      join public.subjects s on s.id=t.subject_id join public.years y on y.id=t.year_id
    where t.id=p_product and t.active and t.course_id=p.course_id
      and s.year_id=y.id and s.course_id=t.course_id and y.course_id=t.course_id and s.active and y.active
      and not exists(select 1 from public.chapters c where c.id=t.chapter_id)
      and not exists(select 1 from public.products r where r.id=t.id));
$$;
create function public.nonplay_test_quote(p_user uuid,p_product text) returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public,pg_temp as $$
declare t public.nonplay_test_products%rowtype;
begin
  if not public.nonplay_test_product_allowed(p_user,p_product) then raise exception 'test checkout unavailable' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  select * into strict t from public.nonplay_test_products where id=p_product;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'listPrice',t.price_paise/100.0,'amount',t.price_paise/100.0,
    'referralDiscount',0,'walletEligible',false,'walletAvailable',0,'walletMaxUsable',0,'walletAmount',0);
end $$;

create function public.nonplay_test_prepare_order(p_user uuid,p_product text,p_key uuid,p_key_id text) returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public,pg_temp as $$
declare o public.nonplay_test_orders%rowtype; t public.nonplay_test_products%rowtype; claimed boolean:=false;
begin
  if not public.nonplay_test_product_allowed(p_user,p_product) or p_key is null or p_key_id !~ '^rzp_test_[A-Za-z0-9]+$' then
    raise exception 'test checkout unavailable' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('nonplay_test:'||p_user::text,0));
  select * into o from public.nonplay_test_orders where user_id=p_user and idempotency_key=p_key for update;
  if found and (o.product_id<>p_product or o.key_id<>p_key_id) then raise exception 'idempotency conflict'; end if;
  if o.id is null then
    update public.nonplay_test_orders set status='expired' where user_id=p_user and product_id=p_product
      and status in ('pending','created') and expires_at<=now();
    select * into o from public.nonplay_test_orders where user_id=p_user and product_id=p_product
      and status in ('pending','created') for update;
  end if;
  if o.id is null then
    if exists(select 1 from public.nonplay_test_entitlements where user_id=p_user and product_id=p_product) then
      raise exception 'test product already fulfilled; reconcile existing entitlement'; end if;
    select * into strict t from public.nonplay_test_products where id=p_product;
    insert into public.nonplay_test_orders(user_id,product_id,idempotency_key,key_id,amount_paise,title)
      values(p_user,p_product,p_key,p_key_id,t.price_paise,t.title) returning * into o;
    insert into public.nonplay_test_checkouts(order_id) values(o.id);
    insert into public.nonplay_test_audit(order_id,event) values(o.id,'reserved');
    claimed:=true;
  end if;
  if o.key_id<>p_key_id then raise exception 'test credential rotation requires reconciliation'; end if;
  return to_jsonb(o)||jsonb_build_object('claimed',claimed);
end $$;

create function public.nonplay_test_attach_order(p_user uuid,p_order uuid,p_provider text) returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public,pg_temp as $$
declare o public.nonplay_test_orders%rowtype;
begin
  select * into strict o from public.nonplay_test_orders where id=p_order and user_id=p_user for update;
  if not public.nonplay_test_product_allowed(p_user,o.product_id) or p_provider !~ '^order_[A-Za-z0-9]+$'
    or o.status not in ('pending','created') or o.expires_at<=now() then raise exception 'test order unavailable'; end if;
  if o.razorpay_order_id is not null and o.razorpay_order_id<>p_provider then raise exception 'provider binding conflict'; end if;
  update public.nonplay_test_orders set razorpay_order_id=p_provider,status='created' where id=o.id returning * into o;
  update public.nonplay_test_checkouts set state='open',updated_at=now() where order_id=o.id and state='pending';
  insert into public.nonplay_test_audit(order_id,event) values(o.id,'attached');
  return to_jsonb(o);
end $$;

create function public.nonplay_test_observe_payment(p_order uuid,p_payment text,p_status text,p_amount integer,p_currency text,p_provider text,p_created timestamptz) returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public,pg_temp as $$
declare o public.nonplay_test_orders%rowtype; a public.nonplay_test_attempts%rowtype; e public.nonplay_test_entitlements%rowtype;
begin
  select * into strict o from public.nonplay_test_orders where id=p_order for update;
  if not public.nonplay_test_product_allowed(o.user_id,o.product_id) or p_amount is distinct from o.amount_paise
    or p_currency is distinct from 'INR' or p_provider is distinct from o.razorpay_order_id
    or p_payment is null or p_payment !~ '^pay_[A-Za-z0-9]+$'
    or p_status is null or p_status not in ('created','authorized','captured','failed','refunded')
    or p_created is null or p_created<o.created_at-interval '60 seconds' or p_created>now()+interval '60 seconds' then
    raise exception 'provider facts do not match test order'; end if;
  select * into a from public.nonplay_test_attempts where payment_id=p_payment for update;
  if found and a.order_id<>o.id then raise exception 'payment ownership conflict'; end if;
  insert into public.nonplay_test_attempts(payment_id,order_id,status,amount_paise) values(p_payment,o.id,p_status,p_amount)
    on conflict(payment_id) do update set status=case
      when nonplay_test_attempts.status='refunded' then 'refunded'
      when nonplay_test_attempts.status='captured' and excluded.status<>'refunded' then 'captured'
      else excluded.status end,observed_at=now() returning * into a;
  insert into public.nonplay_test_audit(order_id,event) values(o.id,a.status);
  if a.status='refunded' then
    update public.nonplay_test_entitlements set revoked_at=coalesce(revoked_at,now()) where order_id=o.id and payment_id=p_payment;
    if not exists(select 1 from public.nonplay_test_entitlements where order_id=o.id and payment_id<>p_payment and revoked_at is null) then
      update public.nonplay_test_orders set status='reversed' where id=o.id;
      update public.nonplay_test_checkouts set state='reversed',updated_at=now() where order_id=o.id;
    end if;
  elsif a.status='captured' and p_created<=o.expires_at and o.status<>'reversed' then
    insert into public.nonplay_test_entitlements(user_id,product_id,order_id,payment_id)
      values(o.user_id,o.product_id,o.id,p_payment) on conflict(user_id,product_id) do nothing;
    select * into e from public.nonplay_test_entitlements where user_id=o.user_id and product_id=o.product_id;
    if e.order_id=o.id and e.payment_id=p_payment and e.revoked_at is null then
      update public.nonplay_test_orders set status='paid' where id=o.id;
      update public.nonplay_test_checkouts set state='complete',updated_at=now() where order_id=o.id;
      return jsonb_build_object('success',true,'orderId',o.id,'amount',o.amount_paise/100.0);
    end if;
    return jsonb_build_object('success',false,'pending',false,'message','A different test capture already fulfilled this product.');
  end if;
  select * into e from public.nonplay_test_entitlements where order_id=o.id and revoked_at is null;
  if found and o.status<>'reversed' then return jsonb_build_object('success',true,'orderId',o.id,'amount',o.amount_paise/100.0); end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('success',false,'pending',a.status in ('created','authorized') and now()<o.expires_at,
    'message',case when a.status='failed' then 'Test payment failed.' when a.status='refunded' then 'Test payment reversed.' else 'Test payment is not captured.' end);
end $$;

create function public.nonplay_test_immutable_order() returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path=public,pg_temp as $$
begin
  if row(new.id,new.user_id,new.product_id,new.idempotency_key,new.environment,new.key_id,new.amount_paise,new.currency,new.title,new.created_at,new.expires_at)
    is distinct from row(old.id,old.user_id,old.product_id,old.idempotency_key,old.environment,old.key_id,old.amount_paise,old.currency,old.title,old.created_at,old.expires_at)
    or (old.razorpay_order_id is not null and new.razorpay_order_id is distinct from old.razorpay_order_id) then raise exception 'immutable test order'; end if;
  return new;
end $$;
create trigger nonplay_test_order_snapshot before update on public.nonplay_test_orders for each row execute function public.nonplay_test_immutable_order();

-- All new RPCs are service-only; clients must pass through the dedicated handlers.
do $$ declare f record; begin
  for f in select p.oid::regprocedure signature from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace
    where n.nspname='public' and p.proname like 'nonplay\_test\_%' escape '\' loop
    execute format('revoke all on function %s from public,anon,authenticated',f.signature);
    execute format('grant execute on function %s to service_role',f.signature);
  end loop;
end $$;

insert into storage.buckets(id,name,public,file_size_limit,allowed_mime_types)
  values('nonplay-test-notes','nonplay-test-notes',false,10485760,array['application/pdf']);
-- Restrictive policy also defeats a broader pre-existing permissive storage policy.
create policy nonplay_test_no_direct_storage on storage.objects as restrictive for all to anon,authenticated
  using(bucket_id<>'nonplay-test-notes') with check(bucket_id<>'nonplay-test-notes');
$install$;
  end if;

with acl as (
  select 'relation' kind,c.oid,
    jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(
      case when a.grantor=c.relowner then '$owner' else pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor) end,
      case when a.grantee=0 then 'PUBLIC' when a.grantee=c.relowner then '$owner' else pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) end,
      a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable) order by a.grantor=c.relowner,a.grantee=0,a.grantee=c.relowner,pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee),a.privilege_type) grants
  from pg_class c cross join lateral aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl,acldefault(case when c.relkind='S' then 'S'::"char" else 'r'::"char" end,c.relowner))) a
  where c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace and c.relname like 'nonplay\_test\_%' escape '\'
  group by c.oid
  union all
  select 'function',p.oid,
    jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(
      case when a.grantor=p.proowner then '$owner' else pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor) end,
      case when a.grantee=0 then 'PUBLIC' when a.grantee=p.proowner then '$owner' else pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) end,
      a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable) order by a.grantor=p.proowner,a.grantee=0,a.grantee=p.proowner,pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee),a.privilege_type)
  from pg_proc p cross join lateral aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a
  where p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace and p.proname like 'nonplay\_test\_%' escape '\'
  group by p.oid
), objects as (
  select 'relation '||c.relname name,jsonb_build_object(
    'kind',c.relkind,'owner',c.relowner=(select oid from pg_roles where rolname=current_user),
    'persistence',c.relpersistence,'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'force_rls',c.relforcerowsecurity,
    'options',c.reloptions,'replica_identity',c.relreplident,'grants',acl.grants,
    'columns',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(a.attname,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),
      a.attnotnull,a.attidentity,a.attgenerated,co.collname,pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid),a.attacl::text)
      order by a.attnum) from pg_attribute a left join pg_attrdef d on d.adrelid=a.attrelid and d.adnum=a.attnum
      left join pg_collation co on co.oid=a.attcollation where a.attrelid=c.oid and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped),
    'constraints',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(k.conname,pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid),k.convalidated,
      k.condeferrable,k.condeferred,k.connoinherit) order by k.conname)
      from pg_constraint k where k.conrelid=c.oid and k.contype<>'n'),
    'indexes',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(i.relname,pg_get_indexdef(i.oid),x.indisvalid,x.indisready,
      x.indislive,i.reloptions) order by i.relname) from pg_index x join pg_class i on i.oid=x.indexrelid where x.indrelid=c.oid),
    'triggers',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(t.tgname,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid),t.tgenabled)
      order by t.tgname) from pg_trigger t where t.tgrelid=c.oid and not t.tgisinternal),
    'policies',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) order by p.policyname) from pg_policies p where p.schemaname='public' and p.tablename=c.relname),
    'rules',(select jsonb_agg(pg_get_ruledef(r.oid) order by r.rulename) from pg_rewrite r where r.ev_class=c.oid),
    'sequence',(select jsonb_build_array(format_type(s.seqtypid,null),s.seqstart,s.seqincrement,s.seqmax,s.seqmin,s.seqcache,s.seqcycle)
      from pg_sequence s where s.seqrelid=c.oid)
  ) definition from pg_class c left join acl on acl.kind='relation' and acl.oid=c.oid
  where c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace and c.relname like 'nonplay\_test\_%' escape '\'
    and c.relkind not in ('i','I')
  union all
  select 'function '||p.proname||'('||pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)||')',
    jsonb_build_object('definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'owner',p.proowner=(select oid from pg_roles where rolname=current_user),
      'grants',acl.grants)
  from pg_proc p left join acl on acl.kind='function' and acl.oid=p.oid
  where p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace and p.proname like 'nonplay\_test\_%' escape '\'
  union all
  select 'storage policy',coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) order by p.policyname),'[]'::jsonb)
  from pg_policies p where p.schemaname='storage' and p.tablename='objects' and p.policyname='nonplay_test_no_direct_storage'
  union all
  select 'storage bucket',coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(id,name,public,file_size_limit,allowed_mime_types) order by id),'[]'::jsonb)
  from storage.buckets where id='nonplay-test-notes' or name='nonplay-test-notes'
  union all
  select 'standalone types',coalesce(jsonb_agg(t.typname order by t.typname),'[]'::jsonb)
  from pg_type t where t.typnamespace='public'::regnamespace and t.typrelid=0 and t.typname like 'nonplay\_test\_%' escape '\'
)
select jsonb_object_agg(name,md5(definition::text)) into actual from objects;
  if actual is distinct from expected then
    select key into conflicting_object from (
      select jsonb_object_keys(expected) key union select jsonb_object_keys(actual)
    ) keys where actual->key is distinct from expected->key order by key limit 1;
    raise exception 'Isolated non-Play migration incompatible or incomplete object: %',conflicting_object
      using errcode='55000',
        detail=format('Expected definition/security digest %s; observed %s.',
          coalesce(expected->>conflicting_object,'absent'),coalesce(actual->>conflicting_object,'absent')),
        hint='No existing objects were replaced or repaired. Review the conflicting definition, ownership, grants and RLS; retain records and keep both gates OFF.';
  end if;
  if (select count(*)<>1 or coalesce(bool_or(enabled),true) from public.nonplay_test_config)
    or not exists(select 1 from public.nonplay_test_config where environment='production-isolated-razorpay-test-v1' and not enabled) then
    raise exception 'Isolated non-Play migration requires the existing configuration row to be present and OFF'
      using errcode='55000',hint='Review unexpected configuration state; this migration never resets an existing enable gate.';
  end if;
end $migration$;
commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261110100000_mv003_razorpay_entitlement_commitment.sql =====
-- MV003: additive proof for the production void settlement contract.
-- Standalone on production through 20261104110000; no billing-choice/recovery
-- migrations, capture backfill, entitlement repair or financial writes required.
begin;
create or replace function public.razorpay_entitlement_committed(p_order_id text,p_payment_id text)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.orders o
    join public.payments m on m.order_id=o.id
    join public.purchases p on p.order_id=o.id
    where o.id=p_order_id and p_payment_id is not null and p_payment_id<>''
      and o.provider='razorpay' and o.status='paid'
      and o.razorpay_payment_id=p_payment_id
      and o.razorpay_order_id is not null and o.razorpay_order_id<>''
      and o.user_id is not null and o.product_id is not null
      and o.amount>0 and o.course_id is not null
      and o.scope in ('chapter','subject','year','bundle')
      and case o.scope
        when 'chapter' then o.chapter_id is not null
        when 'subject' then o.subject_id is not null
        when 'year' then o.year_id is not null
        when 'bundle' then coalesce(cardinality(o.year_ids),0)>0
          and array_position(o.year_ids,null) is null
        else false end
      and m.provider='razorpay' and m.status='success'
      and m.razorpay_payment_id=p_payment_id and m.razorpay_order_id=o.razorpay_order_id
      and m.user_id=o.user_id and m.product_id=o.product_id and m.amount=o.amount
      and p.status='success' and p.user_id=o.user_id
      and p.product_id=o.product_id and p.amount=o.amount
      and p.razorpay_order_id=o.razorpay_order_id
      and row(p.scope,p.chapter_id,p.subject_id,p.year_id,p.year_ids,p.course_id)
        is not distinct from row(o.scope,o.chapter_id,o.subject_id,o.year_id,o.year_ids,o.course_id)
      -- Absence is allowed for historical purchases. An existing capture must
      -- match exactly and must not be awaiting or have completed reversal.
      and not exists (select 1 from public.payment_captures c
        where c.payment_id=p_payment_id and (
          c.order_id is distinct from o.id or c.razorpay_order_id is distinct from o.razorpay_order_id
          or c.amount_paise is distinct from round(o.amount*100)::bigint
          or c.status not in ('captured','granted')))
      -- Even parked compensation is unresolved; no compensation state grants.
      and not exists (select 1 from public.payment_compensations c where c.payment_id=p_payment_id)
      -- On the production contract pending/parked reversal facts cannot yet be
      -- classified as partial refund or resolved dispute. Fail closed for retry.
      -- Applied refunds/disputes are reflected in the durable purchase state;
      -- blocking all applied events would reject partial refunds and disputes won.
      and not exists (select 1 from public.provider_events e
        where e.payment_id=p_payment_id and e.status in ('pending','parked')
          and e.event_type in ('refund.processed','payment.dispute.created',
            'payment.dispute.under_review','payment.dispute.action_required','payment.dispute.lost'))
  );
$$;
revoke all on function public.razorpay_entitlement_committed(text,text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.razorpay_entitlement_committed(text,text) to service_role;
commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261110120000_mv005_razorpay_order_transitions.sql =====
-- Prevention only: no historical financial DML or entitlement reader changes.
begin;

create or replace function public.guard_razorpay_order_transition()
returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp
as $$
begin
  if old.provider <> 'razorpay' or new.status is not distinct from old.status then
    return new;
  end if;

  -- UPDATE holds the order row lock. A writer waiting behind settlement sees
  -- the committed paid version, including under READ COMMITTED rechecking.
  -- No role/admin bypass: privileged error handlers must obey this too.
  if (old.status = 'refunded' and new.status <> 'refunded')
     or (old.status = 'paid' and new.status not in ('paid', 'refunded'))
     or (new.status in ('created', 'pending', 'failed', 'cancelled') and exists (
       select 1 from public.payment_captures c
       where c.razorpay_order_id = old.razorpay_order_id
     )) then
    raise exception 'Razorpay order transition conflicts with captured or terminal state'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;
  -- Unpaid failures can still settle later through the existing verified,
  -- atomic service-only settlement RPC. Full refunds remain paid -> refunded.
  return new;
end;
$$;
revoke all on function public.guard_razorpay_order_transition() from public, anon, authenticated;
drop trigger if exists orders_03_razorpay_transition on public.orders;
create trigger orders_03_razorpay_transition
before update of status on public.orders
for each row execute function public.guard_razorpay_order_transition();

commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261110130000_mv006_purchase_ownership_guard.sql =====
-- Prevention only. Preserve existing successes, legacy NULL keys and financial
-- history. Do not remove the historical partial-index exception here.
begin;

create or replace function public.guard_purchase_success_ownership()
returns trigger
language plpgsql volatile security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp
as $$
begin
  if new.status <> 'success' then return new; end if;

  -- Metadata writes on existing ownership (including the historical duplicate)
  -- are not a new grant. Refund/reversal transitions never enter this branch.
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' then
    if old.status = 'success'
       and new.user_id is not distinct from old.user_id
       and new.product_id is not distinct from old.product_id then
      return new;
    end if;
  end if;

  -- Legacy purchases can lack product/user identities. Keep their established
  -- scope-based access/restoration semantics; never infer a product from scope.
  -- All current verified settlements supply both keys.
  if new.user_id is null or new.product_id is null then return new; end if;

  -- A transaction-snapshot reader could miss a grant committed while waiting
  -- for the lock. Fail closed rather than accept stale REPEATABLE READ data.
  if current_setting('transaction_isolation') <> 'read committed' then
    raise exception 'Purchase ownership grant requires read committed isolation'
      using errcode = '40001';
  end if;

  -- Same lock namespace/order as create, settle, refund and dispute routines.
  -- This VOLATILE trigger's SELECT takes a fresh READ COMMITTED snapshot after
  -- acquiring the lock, including when another transaction just committed.
  perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    pg_catalog.hashtextextended('wallet:' || new.user_id::text, 0));
  if exists (
    select 1 from public.purchases p
    where p.user_id = new.user_id and p.product_id = new.product_id
      and p.status = 'success'
      and (tg_op = 'INSERT' or p.id is distinct from old.id)
      -- Same-order insert replays cannot add a row: the unchanged unique
      -- order index enforces that even under concurrent ON CONFLICT writes.
      -- Keep this check AFTER the lock, so concurrent replays see the winner.
      and (tg_op <> 'INSERT' or new.order_id is null
           or p.order_id is distinct from new.order_id)
  ) then
    -- No silent conversion, compensation, deletion or historical repair here.
    -- The caller's complete transaction rolls back on a conflicting grant.
    raise exception 'Successful purchase ownership already exists'
      using errcode = '23505';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;
revoke all on function public.guard_purchase_success_ownership() from public, anon, authenticated;
drop trigger if exists purchases_zz_success_ownership on public.purchases;
create trigger purchases_zz_success_ownership
before insert or update on public.purchases
for each row execute function public.guard_purchase_success_ownership();

commit;

===== supabase/migrations/20261111110000_phase_c_play_entitlement_snapshot.sql =====
-- Phase C: new Play grants must use the purchased order's immutable scope,
-- even if the catalog changes before receipt verification. No historical DML.
-- Requires billing_settlement_recovery and the existing order snapshot columns.
begin;
create or replace function public.play_purchase_entitlement_from_order()
returns trigger language plpgsql security definer
set search_path=pg_catalog,public,pg_temp as $$
declare o public.orders%rowtype;
begin
  if new.order_id is null then return new; end if;
  select * into o from public.orders where id=new.order_id;
  if not found or o.provider<>'play' then return new; end if;
  if new.user_id is distinct from o.user_id or new.product_id is distinct from o.product_id
    or new.amount is distinct from o.amount or o.course_id is null
    or o.scope not in ('chapter','subject','year','bundle') or o.scope is null
    or (o.scope='chapter' and o.chapter_id is null)
    or (o.scope='subject' and o.subject_id is null)
    or (o.scope='year' and o.year_id is null)
    or (o.scope='bundle' and (coalesce(cardinality(o.year_ids),0)=0 or array_position(o.year_ids,null) is not null)) then
    raise exception 'Play purchase does not match order entitlement';
  end if;
  new.scope:=o.scope; new.chapter_id:=o.chapter_id; new.subject_id:=o.subject_id;
  new.year_id:=o.year_id; new.year_ids:=o.year_ids; new.course_id:=o.course_id;
  return new;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.play_purchase_entitlement_from_order() from public,anon,authenticated;
drop trigger if exists purchases_play_order_snapshot on public.purchases;
create trigger purchases_play_order_snapshot before insert on public.purchases
for each row execute function public.play_purchase_entitlement_from_order();

create or replace function public.play_entitlement_committed(p_order_id text,p_token text)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer
set search_path=pg_catalog,public,pg_temp as $$
 select exists(select 1 from public.orders o
   join public.payments m on m.order_id=o.id and m.purchase_token=p_token
   join public.purchases p on p.order_id=o.id
   where o.id=p_order_id and p_token is not null and p_token<>''
     and o.provider='play' and o.status='paid' and o.purchase_token=p_token
     and o.user_id is not null and o.product_id is not null and o.amount>0
     and o.play_sku is not null and o.course_id is not null
     and o.scope in ('chapter','subject','year','bundle')
     and case o.scope when 'chapter' then o.chapter_id is not null
       when 'subject' then o.subject_id is not null when 'year' then o.year_id is not null
       when 'bundle' then coalesce(cardinality(o.year_ids),0)>0 and array_position(o.year_ids,null) is null else false end
     and m.provider='play' and m.play_sku=o.play_sku and m.status='success'
     and m.user_id=o.user_id and m.product_id=o.product_id and m.amount=o.amount
     and p.status='success' and p.user_id=o.user_id and p.product_id=o.product_id and p.amount=o.amount
     and row(p.scope,p.chapter_id,p.subject_id,p.year_id,p.year_ids,p.course_id)
       is not distinct from row(o.scope,o.chapter_id,o.subject_id,o.year_id,o.year_ids,o.course_id));
$$;
revoke all on function public.play_entitlement_committed(text,text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.play_entitlement_committed(text,text) to service_role;
commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261111120000_p0_classified_reversal_commitment.sql =====
-- P0 forward-only candidate. Requires complete atomic C1-C4 first.
-- Preserve every exact MV003 identity/snapshot/capture/compensation predicate.
-- No financial/history DML. Only service-role provider classification can clear
-- a pending reversal hold; parked and unknown facts still fail closed.
begin;
create or replace function public.razorpay_entitlement_committed(p_order_id text,p_payment_id text)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.orders o
    join public.payments m on m.order_id=o.id
    join public.purchases p on p.order_id=o.id
    where o.id=p_order_id and p_payment_id is not null and p_payment_id<>''
      and o.provider='razorpay' and o.status='paid'
      and o.razorpay_payment_id=p_payment_id
      and o.razorpay_order_id is not null and o.razorpay_order_id<>''
      and o.user_id is not null and o.product_id is not null
      and o.amount>0 and o.course_id is not null
      and o.scope in ('chapter','subject','year','bundle')
      and case o.scope
        when 'chapter' then o.chapter_id is not null
        when 'subject' then o.subject_id is not null
        when 'year' then o.year_id is not null
        when 'bundle' then coalesce(cardinality(o.year_ids),0)>0
          and array_position(o.year_ids,null) is null
        else false end
      and m.provider='razorpay' and m.status='success'
      and m.razorpay_payment_id=p_payment_id and m.razorpay_order_id=o.razorpay_order_id
      and m.user_id=o.user_id and m.product_id=o.product_id and m.amount=o.amount
      and p.status='success' and p.user_id=o.user_id
      and p.product_id=o.product_id and p.amount=o.amount
      and p.razorpay_order_id=o.razorpay_order_id
      and row(p.scope,p.chapter_id,p.subject_id,p.year_id,p.year_ids,p.course_id)
        is not distinct from row(o.scope,o.chapter_id,o.subject_id,o.year_id,o.year_ids,o.course_id)
      -- Absence is allowed for historical purchases. An existing capture must
      -- match exactly and must not be awaiting or have completed reversal.
      and not exists (select 1 from public.payment_captures c
        where c.payment_id=p_payment_id and (
          c.order_id is distinct from o.id or c.razorpay_order_id is distinct from o.razorpay_order_id
          or c.amount_paise is distinct from round(o.amount*100)::bigint
          or c.status not in ('captured','granted')))
      -- Even parked compensation is unresolved; no compensation state grants.
      and not exists (select 1 from public.payment_compensations c where c.payment_id=p_payment_id)
      -- C recovery classifies provider facts before linking/settlement. A
      -- verified partial refund or won dispute may still await inbox application
      -- when the exact purchase transaction checks this proof. Unclassified,
      -- blocking and parked reversals continue to deny commitment.
      and not exists (select 1 from public.provider_events e
        where e.payment_id=p_payment_id and e.status in ('pending','parked')
          and (e.status='parked' or e.blocks_entitlement is distinct from false)
          and e.event_type in ('refund.processed','payment.dispute.created',
            'payment.dispute.under_review','payment.dispute.action_required','payment.dispute.lost'))
  );
$$;
revoke all on function public.razorpay_entitlement_committed(text,text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.razorpay_entitlement_committed(text,text) to service_role;
commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261111175746_all_row_foreign_key_indexes.sql =====
-- Nonunique all-row lookup coverage. Active/status/source partial indexes cannot
-- cover every referencing row during FK checks or historical ownership reads.
-- No financial DML, entitlement changes, or removal of the legacy unique index.
-- Separate from the frozen 74-version A/B/C/D delivery; requires its own review.
BEGIN;
SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '2s';
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '60s';

CREATE INDEX notes_chapter_id_all_rows_idx ON public.notes (chapter_id);
CREATE INDEX purchases_user_id_all_rows_idx ON public.purchases (user_id);
CREATE INDEX quiz_tests_subject_id_all_rows_idx ON public.quiz_tests (subject_id);
CREATE INDEX videos_subject_id_all_rows_idx ON public.videos (subject_id);
CREATE INDEX wallet_ledger_referral_id_all_rows_idx ON public.wallet_ledger (referral_id);
CREATE INDEX wallet_ledger_order_id_all_rows_idx ON public.wallet_ledger (order_id);
CREATE INDEX wallet_ledger_reverses_id_all_rows_idx ON public.wallet_ledger (reverses_id);

COMMIT;


===== supabase/migrations/20261112104610_audit_batch1_refund_revocation.sql =====
-- AUD-012: forward-only function changes. No historical data rewrite.
-- Apply before the batch's webhook/verifier bundles. Existing clients remain compatible.
begin;
create or replace function public.reverse_refunded_capture(p_payment_id text)
returns void language plpgsql security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp
as $$
declare c public.payment_captures%rowtype; o public.orders%rowtype; v_uid uuid; v_chargeback boolean;
begin
  select * into c from public.payment_captures where payment_id=p_payment_id;
  if not found then raise exception 'verified capture required'; end if;
  -- Same wallet -> order -> capture lock order as settlement; no capture lock
  -- may be taken first, even when this RPC races a capture retry.
  select user_id into v_uid from public.orders where razorpay_order_id=c.razorpay_order_id;
  if v_uid is not null then
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || v_uid::text,0));
  end if;
  select * into o from public.orders where razorpay_order_id=c.razorpay_order_id for update;
  if found and o.provider='razorpay' and round(o.amount*100)::bigint=c.amount_paise
      and (o.razorpay_payment_id is null or o.razorpay_payment_id=p_payment_id) then
    update public.orders set razorpay_payment_id=p_payment_id
      where id=o.id and razorpay_payment_id is null;
    select exists(select 1 from public.purchases where order_id=o.id and status='chargeback')
      or exists(select 1 from public.provider_events e
        where e.payment_id=p_payment_id and e.blocks_entitlement
          and e.event_type='payment.dispute.lost' and e.status in ('pending','applied')) into v_chargeback;
    perform public.reverse_payment(p_payment_id,
      case when v_chargeback then 'chargeback' else 'refunded' end,not v_chargeback);
    -- reverse_payment historically only transitions paid orders. A refunded
    -- capture received before settlement must also be terminal without a grant.
    update public.orders set status='refunded',updated_at=now() where id=o.id and status<>'refunded';
  end if;
  update public.payment_captures set status='reversed',failure_reason='provider_already_refunded'
    where payment_id=p_payment_id;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.reverse_refunded_capture(text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.reverse_refunded_capture(text) to service_role;

-- Publish a compensation and its capture disposition atomically, under the
-- same locks used by settlement. A stale Edge lookup cannot refund a grant.
create or replace function public.queue_capture_compensation(p_payment_id text)
returns text language plpgsql security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp
as $$
declare c public.payment_captures%rowtype; o public.orders%rowtype; v_uid uuid; v_reason text;
begin
  select * into c from public.payment_captures where payment_id=p_payment_id;
  if not found then raise exception 'verified capture required'; end if;
  select user_id into v_uid from public.orders where razorpay_order_id=c.razorpay_order_id;
  if v_uid is not null then
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || v_uid::text,0));
  end if;
  select * into o from public.orders where razorpay_order_id=c.razorpay_order_id for update;
  select * into c from public.payment_captures where payment_id=p_payment_id for update;
  if c.status='reversed' then return 'reversed'; end if;
  if c.status='compensated' then return 'compensated'; end if;
  if c.status='compensation_pending' then return 'queued'; end if;
  if c.status<>'captured' then return 'retry'; end if;
  -- Newly attached or changed order requires a fresh full settlement check.
  if o.id is not null and round(o.amount*100)::bigint=c.amount_paise then return 'retry'; end if;
  v_reason:=case when o.id is null then 'unknown_order' else 'amount_mismatch' end;
  insert into public.payment_compensations(payment_id,order_id,amount_paise,reason,refund_request_id)
    values(p_payment_id,o.id,c.amount_paise,v_reason,'medveda_comp_' || md5(p_payment_id))
    on conflict(payment_id) do nothing;
  update public.payment_captures set status='compensation_pending',failure_reason=v_reason
    where payment_id=p_payment_id;
  return 'queued';
end $$;
revoke all on function public.queue_capture_compensation(text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.queue_capture_compensation(text) to service_role;

create or replace function public.settle_razorpay_payment(
  p_event_id text,p_razorpay_order_id text,p_razorpay_payment_id text,
  p_amount_paise bigint,p_paid_at timestamptz default null)
returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_order public.orders%rowtype; v_capture public.payment_captures%rowtype;
  v_reason text; v_reversal boolean; v_error text; v_uid uuid; v_chargeback boolean;
begin
  -- Match creation, refund and legacy settlement lock order: user, then order.
  select user_id into v_uid from public.orders where razorpay_order_id=p_razorpay_order_id;
  if v_uid is not null then
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || v_uid::text,0));
  end if;
  select * into v_order from public.orders where razorpay_order_id=p_razorpay_order_id for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'Razorpay order is not linked'; end if;
  if round(v_order.amount*100)::bigint<>p_amount_paise then raise exception 'capture amount mismatch'; end if;
  perform public.record_payment_capture(p_razorpay_payment_id,p_razorpay_order_id,p_amount_paise,null);
  select * into v_capture from public.payment_captures where payment_id=p_razorpay_payment_id for update;
  if v_capture.status in ('compensation_pending','compensated') then
    update public.provider_events set status='applied'
      where event_id=p_event_id and event_type='payment.captured';
    return;
  end if;
  if v_order.razorpay_payment_id is not null and v_order.razorpay_payment_id<>p_razorpay_payment_id then
    insert into public.payment_compensations(payment_id,order_id,amount_paise,reason,refund_request_id)
      values(p_razorpay_payment_id,v_order.id,p_amount_paise,'additional_capture',
        'medveda_comp_' || md5(p_razorpay_payment_id)) on conflict(payment_id) do nothing;
    update public.payment_captures set status='compensation_pending',failure_reason='additional_capture'
      where payment_id=p_razorpay_payment_id;
    update public.provider_events set status='applied' where event_id=p_event_id and event_type='payment.captured';
    return;
  end if;
  -- Link the verified capture so an earlier reversal inbox can be reconciled
  -- even while entitlement is held. This does not mark the order paid.
  update public.orders set razorpay_payment_id=p_razorpay_payment_id
    where id=v_order.id and razorpay_payment_id is null;
  -- A successful capture replay must not become stale merely because time passed.
  -- Reversals still take precedence and never restore access.
  if v_capture.status='granted' and v_order.status='paid' then
    update public.provider_events set status='applied'
      where event_id=p_event_id and event_type='payment.captured';
    return;
  end if;
  -- Unknown reversal facts and open disputes HOLD settlement. A later won
  -- dispute clears the hold; an authenticated full refund/lost dispute reverses.
  -- Never infer a full refund from a refund.processed event alone.
  if v_order.status<>'refunded' and v_capture.status<>'reversed' and exists(
    select 1 from public.provider_events e where e.payment_id=p_razorpay_payment_id
      and e.status in ('pending','applied')
      and e.event_type in ('refund.processed','payment.dispute.created','payment.dispute.under_review',
        'payment.dispute.action_required','payment.dispute.lost')
      and (e.blocks_entitlement is null or (e.blocks_entitlement and
        e.event_type in ('payment.dispute.created','payment.dispute.under_review','payment.dispute.action_required')))) then
    return;
  end if;
  select v_order.status='refunded' or v_capture.status='reversed' or exists(
    select 1 from public.provider_events e where e.payment_id=p_razorpay_payment_id
      and e.blocks_entitlement and e.status in ('pending','applied')
      and e.event_type in ('refund.processed','payment.dispute.lost')) into v_reversal;
  if v_reversal then v_reason:='reversal_received';
  elsif v_order.user_id is null then v_reason:='account_deleted';
  elsif v_order.scope is null or v_order.scope not in ('chapter','subject','year','bundle')
      or (v_order.scope='chapter' and v_order.chapter_id is null)
      or (v_order.scope='subject' and v_order.subject_id is null)
      or (v_order.scope='year' and v_order.year_id is null)
      or (v_order.scope='bundle' and coalesce(array_length(v_order.year_ids,1),0)=0)
      or v_order.course_id is null then v_reason:='missing_entitlement_snapshot';
  elsif v_order.referral_discount>0 and (v_order.status in ('cancelled','failed')
      or (v_order.expires_at is not null and coalesce(p_paid_at,now())>v_order.expires_at)) then
    v_reason:='stale_discount';
  elsif v_order.referral_discount>0 and not exists(select 1 from public.first_discount_reservations
      where order_id=v_order.id and user_id=v_order.user_id) then v_reason:='discount_reused';
  elsif exists(select 1 from public.purchases where user_id=v_order.user_id
      and product_id=v_order.product_id and status='success' and order_id is distinct from v_order.id) then
    v_reason:='already_owned';
  elsif v_order.amount<>v_order.list_price-v_order.referral_discount-v_order.wallet_amount then
    v_reason:='underpriced_order';
  end if;
  if v_reason is null then
    begin
      perform public.settle_razorpay_payment_legacy(p_event_id,p_razorpay_order_id,
        p_razorpay_payment_id,p_amount_paise,p_paid_at);
    exception when others then
      v_error:=sqlerrm;
      if v_error like 'wallet shortfall:%' then v_reason:='wallet_shortfall';
      else raise; end if;
    end;
  end if;
  if v_reason is not null then
    if v_reversal then
      -- Linkage is already locked above. Revoke an existing purchase as well
      -- as preventing a new grant; lost disputes never restore buyer wallet.
      select exists(select 1 from public.purchases where order_id=v_order.id and status='chargeback')
        or exists(select 1 from public.provider_events e
          where e.payment_id=p_razorpay_payment_id and e.blocks_entitlement
            and e.event_type='payment.dispute.lost' and e.status in ('pending','applied')) into v_chargeback;
      perform public.reverse_payment(p_razorpay_payment_id,
        case when v_chargeback then 'chargeback' else 'refunded' end,not v_chargeback);
    end if;
    update public.orders set status=case when v_reversal then 'refunded' else 'paid' end,
      razorpay_payment_id=p_razorpay_payment_id, updated_at=now(),
      payment_completed_at=coalesce(payment_completed_at,clock_timestamp())
      where id=v_order.id and status<>'refunded';
    insert into public.payment_compensations(payment_id,order_id,amount_paise,reason,refund_request_id)
      select p_razorpay_payment_id,v_order.id,p_amount_paise,v_reason,
        'medveda_comp_' || md5(p_razorpay_payment_id)
      where not v_reversal on conflict(payment_id) do nothing;
    update public.payment_captures set status=case when v_reversal then 'reversed' else 'compensation_pending' end,
      failure_reason=v_reason where payment_id=p_razorpay_payment_id;
  else
    if not public.razorpay_entitlement_committed(v_order.id,p_razorpay_payment_id) then
      raise exception 'Razorpay entitlement not committed';
    end if;
    update public.payment_captures set status='granted' where payment_id=p_razorpay_payment_id;
  end if;
  update public.orders set payment_provider_time=coalesce(payment_provider_time,v_capture.provider_time),
    payment_received_at=coalesce(payment_received_at,v_capture.received_at),
    payment_completed_at=coalesce(payment_completed_at,clock_timestamp()),
    payment_time_fallback=(v_capture.provider_time is null)
    where id=v_order.id;
  update public.provider_events set status='applied'
    where event_id=p_event_id and event_type='payment.captured';
end $$;
revoke all on function public.settle_razorpay_payment(text,text,text,bigint,timestamptz) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.settle_razorpay_payment(text,text,text,bigint,timestamptz) to service_role;
create or replace function public.user_can_access_note(p_user uuid, p_note_id text)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select p_user is not null
    and exists (select 1 from public.profiles pr
      where pr.id = p_user and not coalesce(pr.blocked, false))
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.notes n
      join public.chapters c on c.id = n.chapter_id
      where n.id = p_note_id and n.active
        and public.content_is_published(n.course_id, n.year_id, c.subject_id, n.chapter_id)
        and (
          (n.is_free_preview and exists (select 1 from public.profiles pr
            where pr.id = p_user and pr.course_id = n.course_id))
          or (not public.admin_mfa_required()
            and exists (select 1 from public.admins a where a.id = p_user))
          or exists (
            select 1 from public.purchases p
            where p.user_id = p_user and p.status = 'success'
              -- Refunded historical orders cannot grant a paid URL even if a
              -- missed event left the purchase row marked successful.
              and not exists (
                select 1 from public.orders o
                left join public.payment_captures pc on pc.payment_id=o.razorpay_payment_id
                where o.id=p.order_id and (o.status='refunded' or pc.status in ('reversed','compensated'))
              )
              and p.course_id = c.course_id
              and ((p.scope = 'chapter' and p.chapter_id = c.id)
                or (p.scope = 'subject' and p.subject_id = c.subject_id)
                or (p.scope = 'year' and p.year_id = c.year_id)
                or (p.scope = 'bundle' and c.year_id = any(p.year_ids)))
          )
        )
    );
$$;
revoke all on function public.user_can_access_note(uuid,text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.user_can_access_note(uuid,text) to service_role;
commit;


===== supabase/migrations/20261112150427_audit_checkout_publication_guard.sql =====
-- Admission only: existing order snapshots and settlement remain recoverable.
begin;
-- Locks publication ancestors through order insertion. Service-only, never a client
-- authorization substitute. No historical order/purchase/content rows are rewritten.
create or replace function public.lock_checkout_publication(p_product_id text)
returns boolean language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare p public.products%rowtype; n integer; wanted integer;
begin
  select * into p from public.products where id=p_product_id for share;
  if not found or not p.active then return false; end if;
  perform 1 from public.courses where id=p.course_id and active for share;
  if not found then return false; end if;
  if p.scope='chapter' then
    perform 1 from public.chapters c join public.subjects s on s.id=c.subject_id
      join public.years y on y.id=s.year_id
      where c.id=p.chapter_id and c.active and s.active and y.active
        and c.course_id=p.course_id and s.course_id=p.course_id and y.course_id=p.course_id
      for share of c,s,y;
    return found;
  elsif p.scope='subject' then
    perform 1 from public.subjects s join public.years y on y.id=s.year_id
      where s.id=p.subject_id and s.active and y.active
        and s.course_id=p.course_id and y.course_id=p.course_id for share of s,y;
    return found;
  elsif p.scope='year' then
    perform 1 from public.years y where y.id=p.year_id and y.active and y.course_id=p.course_id for share;
    return found;
  elsif p.scope='bundle' then
    wanted:=cardinality(p.year_ids);
    if wanted is null or wanted=0 then return false; end if;
    perform 1 from public.years y where y.id=any(p.year_ids) and y.active and y.course_id=p.course_id for share;
    get diagnostics n=row_count;
    return n=wanted;
  end if;
  return false;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.lock_checkout_publication(text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.lock_checkout_publication(text) to service_role;

create or replace function public.create_priced_order(p_user_id uuid,p_product_id text,p_use_wallet boolean default false)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$
declare v_result jsonb; v_order public.orders%rowtype;
begin
  if not public.lock_checkout_publication(p_product_id) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','product_unavailable');
  end if;
  v_result:=public.create_priced_order_legacy(p_user_id,p_product_id,p_use_wallet);
  if coalesce((v_result->>'ok')::boolean,false) then
    select * into v_order from public.orders where id=v_result->>'order_id';
    v_result:=v_result || jsonb_build_object('amount',v_order.amount,
      'referral_discount',v_order.referral_discount,'wallet_amount',v_order.wallet_amount);
  end if;
  return v_result;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.create_priced_order(uuid,text,boolean) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.create_priced_order(uuid,text,boolean) to service_role;

create or replace function public.create_play_order(p_user_id uuid, p_product_id text)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare v_product public.products%rowtype; v_profile public.profiles%rowtype;
  v_sku text; v_option text; v_order_id text := gen_random_uuid()::text; v_minutes integer;
begin
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('wallet:' || p_user_id::text, 0));
  select * into v_profile from public.profiles where id=p_user_id;
  if not found or v_profile.blocked then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','account_unavailable'); end if;
  if not public.lock_checkout_publication(p_product_id) then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','product_unavailable'); end if;
  select * into v_product from public.products where id=p_product_id and active;
  if not found or v_product.course_id is distinct from v_profile.course_id then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','product_unavailable'); end if;
  if not public.play_notes_product_eligible(v_product) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','not_billable_notes');
  end if;
  if exists(select 1 from public.purchases where user_id=p_user_id and product_id=p_product_id and status='success') then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','already_owned'); end if;
  select t.play_sku,t.purchase_option_id into v_sku,v_option
    from public.play_price_tiers t join public.play_price_sync s on s.candidate_sku=t.play_sku
    where t.price_inr=v_product.price and t.active and t.verified_at > now()-interval '24 hours'
      and t.currency_code='INR' and t.region_code='IN' and s.status='ready';
  if v_sku is null then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'code','price_tier_pending'); end if;
  select checkout_expiry_minutes into v_minutes from public.referral_settings where id=true;
  update public.orders set status='cancelled',updated_at=now() where user_id=p_user_id and status='created' and provider='play' and purchase_token is null;
  insert into public.orders(id,user_id,product_id,scope,chapter_id,subject_id,year_id,year_ids,course_id,
    amount,list_price,provider,play_sku,play_purchase_option_id,status,expires_at)
  values(v_order_id,p_user_id,p_product_id,v_product.scope,v_product.chapter_id,v_product.subject_id,v_product.year_id,
    v_product.year_ids,v_product.course_id,v_product.price,v_product.price,'play',v_sku,v_option,'created',now()+make_interval(mins=>coalesce(v_minutes,30)));
  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'order_id',v_order_id,'play_sku',v_sku,'purchase_option_id',v_option);
end; $$;
revoke all on function public.create_play_order(uuid,text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.create_play_order(uuid,text) to service_role;

commit;
